items.l1_lead: 自闭症患者面临严重心理健康危机，四分之一曾有自杀念头，呼吁社会关注和保护以改善他们的生活质量。
items.l2_summary:
杰森·阿尔代在其文章中呼吁社会关注自闭症患者的心理健康问题，指出这一群体正面临严重的心理健康危机。研究显示，约四分之一的自闭症患者曾计划或尝试自杀，这一惊人的数据反映出自闭症患者的脆弱性和心理健康的紧迫性。此外，文章强调了自闭症患者在日常生活中遭受的持续欺凌现象，这不仅加剧了他们的心理负担，也使得他们在社会中更加孤立。因此，保护措施的实施显得尤为重要，以确保这些脆弱个体能够获得必要的支持和帮助。

阿尔代通过引用相关数据和案例，进一步阐述了自闭症患者在心理健康方面所面临的挑战，强调了社会各界对这一问题的关注和支持的重要性。他指出，改善自闭症患者的生活质量和心理健康状况，需要全社会的共同努力，包括教育、医疗和心理支持等多方面的协作。文章的核心论点在于，只有通过增强对自闭症患者的理解和支持，才能有效减少他们所面临的心理健康危机，帮助他们更好地融入社会，提升生活质量。总之，阿尔代的呼吁不仅是对自闭症患者的关怀，更是对整个社会责任感的提醒，促使我们共同关注和改善这一群体的心理健康问题。

items.title: Jason Arday death 'tragedy on so many levels' says PM - BBC
items.body:
原话：“He was an incredibly, kind and gentle and caring man.”
论点：Jason Arday是一个非常善良和温柔的人。
items.attribution_basis: Google News 全名命中 + LLM 同一人核验（BBC） + 论点方向独立复核
quotes: He was an incredibly, kind and gentle and caring man.
items.claim_zh: Jason Arday是一个非常善良和温柔的人。
items.article_body:
Share Save Add as preferred on Google Ruth Comerford Death of Jason Arday 'a tragedy on so many levels', says PM Andy Burnham has described the death of former Cambridge professor Jason Arday as "a tragedy on so many levels", as he called for a "moment for reflection".
Arday was found dead at an address in Battersea, south London, on Friday afternoon.
"It's not a moment for any rushing to judgement. It's a moment for reflection, I would say, reflecting on how things came to this," the prime minister told broadcasters during a visit to Cornwall.
In a statement issued by his publisher Simon & Schuster UK, Arday's family said they were "in shock to have lost this amazing father, partner, brother, uncle and son".
They said a "campaign of misinformation" had been too much for him.
Arday, 41, resigned as a Cambridge professor of sociology of education last week after allegations of plagiarism and questions about some of his achievements. He had denied the claims.
A friend told the BBC Arday had described feeling "destroyed" and had told him his authorisation to travel to the US had been revoked.
Eamonn McCrystal, who became his friend at St Mary's University, Twickenham, tried to reassure him what he was going through would pass, but Arday replied "it does not feel like it will."
McCrystal told the BBC "He was the nicest person. So kind and such a gentle soul.
"We shared an office at university, when I set up the student radio station, and he used to speak on the station a lot."
The University of Cambridge vice-chancellor Prof Deborah Prentice led the tributes, saying the faculty was "desperately saddened" to learn of his death.
"Our heartfelt sympathies go to Jason Arday's family and friends at this incredibly difficult time," she added.
Education Secretary Lucy Powell said she was "deeply shocked and saddened" and urged people to "remember there are real people with loved ones involved".
Mayor of London Sir Sadiq Khan said Arday was subjected to unrelenting media scrutiny.
He said he had faced "an unacceptable public hounding and campaign of abuse" and was the victim of "a pernicious public shaming".
"His death was a tragedy, but once again it should be a wake up call for all of us," he posted on X.
A donation page, set up by Windrush campaigner Sir Patrick Vernon, has raised more than £10,000 to help cover funeral costs for Arday's family.
"Today should be about compassion, dignity and solidarity with a grieving family," Vernon wrote.
"Jason's life was bigger than the controversy that surrounded his final weeks."
A vigil will be held on Monday evening on the steps of the National Gallery in Trafalgar Square, held by the organisation Stand Up To Racism.
The group's co-convenor, Weyman Bennett, said Arday's death "was the result of a racist witch hunt".
Jo Grady, general secretary of the University and College Union, said the "level of harassment he suffered and the racism he was subjected to has been sickening" and "must be investigated".
Lord Paul Boateng, who became the UK's first black cabinet minister in 2002, told BBC Newsnight he was "horrified, shocked and deeply saddened".
"Racism in academia is a fact of life and needs to be addressed," he added in a written statement.
In a statement on Saturday, National Education Union general secretary Daniel Kebede said Arday had been subjected to "a public and brutal takedown that unleashed a tirade of racism".
"The effect has been chilling. It tells black people and others from underrepresented backgrounds that entering prominent public positions will make you a target," he said.
Prof Simon Baron-Cohen, director of the Autism Research Centre at the University of Cambridge, told BBC Radio 4's Today programme Arday had been "bombarded by every media outlet to paint him as a fraud".
"He was an incredibly, kind and gentle and caring man," he said.
He spoke to Arday the morning of his death, and said the academic had felt unable to leave the house.
"He has experienced what he described as a campaign against him, for the last three years," he previously told BBC News.
"What he was saying to me was 'they've destroyed my life' - it's not clear who they were but I think he was referring to the media.
"The personal attacks on him have been so immense."
Former colleague of Arday says they spoke on morning of his death Speaking to BBC Newsnight, Professor of Black Studies Kehinde Andrews, a friend of Arday, described him as "very down" after resigning from Cambridge.
"He was very upset. He felt that there was no way out. He effectively wasn't leaving the house. He had lost a lot of weight," Andrews said.
"There should be a wakeup call to just how bad black academics actually have it in academia."
Labour MP Bell Ribeiro-Addy also told the programme "the idea that an academic would be dragged through this amount of media scrutiny is unheard of".
On Saturday Scotland's First Minister John Swinney said that people who "made many hard comments must now consider the impact of their words", describing it as a "deeply concerning and very sad case".
Prior to his appointment at Cambridge, Arday had worked as a professor at the University of Glasgow.
Shadow communities secretary Sir James Cleverly said he was angered by the "tragic" death and said "a number of people at a number of academic institutions have serious questions to answer".
When asked by the BBC on Saturday if the University of Cambridge needed to answer questions over its duty of care, Cleverly said the university should "ask themselves how he got into this position, how he ended up being in the eye of the storm, what could and should have happened to prevent this long before it got to this tragic situation".
Arday had denied plagiarism - but admitted errors in his work - and said the recent controversy had led to "an unrelenting level of public scrutiny and personal attack".
The row first erupted after another academic - self-defined "race realist" Nathan Cofnas, who was sacked from his Cambridge role in 2024 - said he found numerous instances of plagiarism in the professor's work.
Arday said some errors in his early academic work arose because of his autism, as he relied on using mimicry to make sense of information. Similar scrutiny would find similar errors in work by other academics, he said.
Questions were also raised about parts of his life story, including that he ran 600 miles in six days and that he had raised £5.5m for charity.
He later said the run was actually completed over a 12-day period to allow for rest days - and that the huge sum was raised with the help of others.
Arday's appointment as Cambridge's youngest ever black professor at the age of 37 in 2023 was hailed at the time.
Announcing his resignation last week, Arday said the "personal cost" of the scrutiny of him had become "too great".
He said: "While criticism is an inevitable part of academic life, what I have experienced has gone far beyond scholarly disagreement.
"The relentless accusations, speculation and public commentary have taken a profound toll on me and on those I love."
He stressed that his resignation should not "be mistaken for an acceptance of the narratives that have surrounded me".
Earlier this week, Cambridge announced an independent investigation around the circumstances of Arday's appointment.
Liverpool John Moores University - which awarded Arday his PhD in 2015 - concluded that he had not plagiarised work.
In a statement on Saturday, a spokesperson for the university said it was "saddened to hear of the tragic loss of Professor Jason Arday".
Jason Arday speaks with former tutor in 2023 If you've been affected by the issues in this story, help and support is available via the BBC Action Line Additional reporting by Emma Vardy
items.title_zh: 杰森·阿尔代去世引发多重悲剧感慨
items.summary_zh: 杰森·阿尔代（Jason Arday）被描述为一个非常善良和温柔的人。英国首相在谈及他的去世时表示，这一事件在多个层面上都是一场悲剧。阿尔代的离世不仅让身边的人感到失落，也引发了对他所代表的价值观和人际关系的深思。他的善良品质和温柔性格使他在社会中留下了深刻的印记，令人惋惜。
items.l1_lead: 杰森·阿尔代的去世引发了对人际关系和社会价值观的深刻反思，令人感到多重悲剧的惋惜。
items.l2_summary: 杰森·阿尔代的去世引发了深刻的悲剧感慨，令人们对他所代表的价值观和人际关系进行了反思。阿尔代被描述为一个非常善良和温柔的人，这种品质使他在社会中留下了深刻的印记。他的离世不仅让身边的人感到失落，也让人们意识到善良和温柔在当今社会中的重要性。英国首相在谈及阿尔代的去世时指出，这一事件在多个层面上都是一场悲剧，反映了人际关系的脆弱和对美好品质的珍视。阿尔代的生活和价值观激励了许多人，他的离去让人们更加珍惜与他人之间的联系和情感。总的来说，阿尔代的去世不仅是个人的损失，更是社会对善良与温柔的深刻思考，提醒我们在日常生活中应更加关注和弘扬这些美德。

items.article_body:
Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Jason Arday in London in 2023. Ken McKay / ITV via Shutterstock Share Add NBC News to Google Aug. 14, 2026, 4:28 PM EDT / Updated Aug. 15, 2026, 10:45 AM EDT By Marlene Lenthang A former Cambridge professor was found dead at his London home on Friday, one week after he resigned from his position at the esteemed university following accusations of plagiarism.
Jason Arday, 41, became the youngest Black professor at Cambridge when he was hired as a professor of sociology of education in 2023.
London’s Metropolitan Police force said it responded to a report of a man found unresponsive inside a property on Friday and that the man was pronounced dead at the scene, without naming Arday. Authorities said the death is being treated as “unexpected, but is not believed to be suspicious.”
“We are desperately saddened to hear this tragic news. Our heartfelt sympathies go to Jason Arday’s family and friends at this incredibly difficult time,” University of Cambridge Vice-Chancellor Deborah Prentice said Friday.
Arday was known for his neurodivergence; he had said he was diagnosed with autism as a child and was unable to speak until the age of 11. He went on to forge a path in academia as a scholar of race, inequality and education.
Arday had resigned on Aug. 5 following scrutiny over alleged plagiarism in his academic work and questions about his accomplishments.
Last month, questions regarding his qualifications were raised publicly by Nathan Cofnas, a former Cambridge philosophy researcher who left the institution after critiquing diversity, equity and inclusion programs.
The Times of London had subsequently published an analysis of Arday’s 2015 Ph.D. thesis highlighting passages that it said were “identical or near-identical” to an earlier paper written by another researcher.
In the weeks since, British media outlets led intense and prolonged scrutiny of Arday’s work, also interrogating a history of claims about his childhood and personal life.
A statement from Arday’s family said he was “a gentle man and who always wanted to see the best in everyone,” condemning critics who they said “would leave no stone unturned in their quest to undermine him.”
Cambridge professor Simon Baron-Cohen, director of the university’s Autism Research Centre, told the BBC he was in touch with Arday hours before his death.
He said Arday “was being subjected to relentless scrutiny, including ridicule, discrediting absolutely every detail of his life,” adding that he “wasn’t coping with the loss of his career, the loss of his reputation, and he felt he couldn’t go on.”
Baron-Cohen said that Arday had believed “there was a racist playbook to discredit Black academics in universities, and that they used accusations of plagiarism to try and bring down Black academics,” adding that Arday referred to former Harvard President Claudine Gay , who resigned two years ago while facing plagiarism allegations and criticism over her comments on antisemitism.
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Saturday that the death was “a tragedy on so many levels,” adding that “it’s not a moment for any rushing to judgment. It’s a moment for reflection, I would say.”

London Mayor Sadiq Khan said on X that Arday had faced “an unacceptable public hounding and campaign of abuse” and that he “was the victim of a pernicious public shaming that other people in his position simply wouldn’t have faced.”
Hacked Off, a campaign group that supports regulation of the media, called for an “inquiry into the culture and behaviour of the British press” following the death, saying scrutiny “went far beyond any limited public interest considerations around academic standards.”
While Cambridge initially defended Arday, on Aug. 5 it opened an investigation “following new information about Professor Arday’s qualifications and honorary appointments.”
In his resignation statement last week, Arday described his tenure as “the privilege of my life to teach my students,” but conceded “the years since my appointment have also been marked by an unrelenting level of public scrutiny and personal attack.”
“While criticism is an inevitable part of academic life, what I have experienced has gone far beyond scholarly disagreement. The relentless accusations, speculation and public commentary have taken a profound toll on me and on those I love,” he continued.
In a statement Thursday, Cambridge’s Prentice shared an update on the inquiry into Arday, saying the university would investigate the circumstances around his appointment by the Faculty of Education in 2022 and his time at Cambridge.
She also said she asked the university council’s deputy chair and council’s audit committee to establish terms for an independent review of all university processes that will take place alongside the probe into Arday.
In his resignation announcement, Arday said he reached a point where the “personal cost becomes too great.”
“For my own wellbeing, for my family, and for those who have stood by me throughout this difficult period, I have concluded that the only way to bring this chapter to an end is to step away,” he said.
Arday’s memoir, “Great and Unfortunate Things,” was released earlier this week in the U.S., giving an account of his childhood — from being diagnosed with autism and developmental delays at the age of 3 — to speaking by the age of 11 and reading and writing by the age of 18.
“Without romanticizing the struggle, this is a story of determination against seemingly insurmountable odds — and of a family and a small group of believers whose compassion helped him see what is possible,” a description for the book by publisher Simon & Schuster said.

items.title_zh: 剑桥前教授贾森·阿尔代因抄袭指控辞职一周后被发现死亡
items.summary_zh: 贾森·阿尔代（Jason Arday）是一位曾任剑桥大学教授的学者，因抄袭指控而辞职。文章指出，他在辞职前遭受了无情的审视和嘲笑，感到无法承受职业和声誉的双重损失。阿尔代认为，存在一个种族主义的剧本，旨在通过抄袭指控来打击黑人学者。他的观点强调了在学术界中，针对黑人学者的抹黑行为及其对个人心理健康的严重影响。
items.l1_lead: 贾森·阿尔代因抄袭指控辞职后自杀，揭示了学术界对黑人学者的抹黑及其对心理健康的深远影响。
items.l2_summary: 贾森·阿尔代（Jason Aldine）是一位曾任剑桥大学教授的学者，近期因抄袭指控辞职，随后被发现死亡。阿尔代在辞职前经历了严厉的审视和公众的嘲笑，这使他感到难以承受职业和声誉的双重打击。他在接受采访时提到，自己认为这一切背后存在一个种族主义的剧本，旨在通过抄袭指控来打击黑人学者。他的观点揭示了在学术界中，针对黑人学者的抹黑行为不仅影响了他们的职业生涯，也对其心理健康造成了严重的负面影响。阿尔代的遭遇引发了对学术界中种族歧视问题的广泛关注，尤其是在当前社会对种族平等和公正的讨论日益增多的背景下。此事件不仅反映了个体在面对不公正指控时的脆弱，也突显了学术界在处理种族问题时的复杂性和挑战。阿尔代的死让人深思，如何在学术环境中建立一个更加包容和公正的氛围，以保护所有学者的声誉和心理健康。

items.article_body:
Sam Kahn Aug 03, 2026 373 15 58 Share Cambridge University’s Senate House. (Photo by Joe Giddens/PA Images via Getty Images.) This is a nasty story.
In 2023, Jason Arday made international news for becoming, at age 37, the youngest black professor in the history of Cambridge University. It wasn’t just that, though. Arday had a really remarkable background. Raised on a council estate in south London, Arday was, in his account, diagnosed at age three with autism and global development delay and didn’t speak until he was 11. At that point, something “clicked,” as he has put it, but he wouldn’t read or write until he was 18.
Then, Arday really applied himself. By age 30, he obtained a Ph.D. in Educational Studies from Liverpool John Moores University, and, according to his official biography , worked at Roehampton, Durham, and Glasgow before being appointed to a highly prestigious professorship at Cambridge. In his spare time, Arday was an ultra long-distance runner, in 2010 completing 30 marathons in 35 days and over two decades raising £5.5 million for charity.
It’s a beautiful story—Arday himself for the documentary “Great Big Story” said of his life, “Wouldn’t it be the most ridiculous story ever told?”—and it’s about to be commemorated in a memoir that Simon & Schuster UK is releasing later this month.
The only problem is that large portions of it may not be true.
In 2023, only months after his appointment at Cambridge, a pair of academics, Dave Harris and Martyn Hammersley, raised concerns to Cambridge, to Liverpool John Moores, and to different journals Arday had published in about the academic integrity of Arday’s work. Two of the journals issued corrections . Cambridge replied that the issues preceded Arday’s hiring and therefore were not within Cambridge’s “remit” to investigate. Liverpool John Moores, for its part, has issued a statement that the university in 2025 conducted a “confidential procedure” in response to the allegations and that “Professor Arday’s PhD still stands.”
Persuasion is a registered nonprofit that relies on reader support to pay our staff and keep our content free for everyone. If you value our work and want to fight for liberal values wherever they are threatened, please become a paying subscriber today!
In 2025, the Times Higher Education spiked an article about the allegations against Arday after Arday enlisted the defamation law firm Carter-Ruck to send a letter to the publication. But last month, Nathan Cofnas, a former Fellow at Cambridge, published a post on Substack that blew the Arday story wide open. Using the plagiarism detector Copyleaks, Cofnas found over 30 cases of “substantial overlap” in Arday’s Ph.D. dissertation with the previously-published dissertation of Paula Zwozdiak-Myers , many of them long chunks of verbatim copying, as well as verbatim copying from other sources. Cofnas went through ten other papers of Arday’s, taken from Arday’s own list of “principal and recent publications,” and found significant issues, including plagiarism, in at least four of them. Additional malfeasance included virtually identical quotes attributed to different sources in different papers, which strongly implies that at least some of the quotes from supposed participants in his studies were confabulated .
Meanwhile, Cofnas raised difficult questions about aspects of Arday’s personal story. He noted that running 30 marathons in 35 days would place Arday in the ultra-marathon elite—this without having left any ostensible mark in the running community. “If Arday [did that], I’ll eat my yarmulke,” said Cofnas by telephone. The claim to have raised £5.5 million for charity has already been walked back by Arday, who in a recent interview said the fundraising was done in conjunction with collectives. And Cofnas found that Arday’s two GCSE qualifications—in physical education and textiles—were unobtainable without passing written tests, a detail that challenges the timeline given by Arday that he could not read or write until he was 18. Cofnas also suggests that Arday’s account of his speech development is “medically improbable.”
Cofnas is far from a neutral party in this case. He was fired by Cambridge’s Emmanuel College in 2024 on the back of student protests against him for a Substack post in which he wrote that in a color-blind meritocracy “blacks would disappear from almost all high-profile positions outside of sports and entertainment.” Harris, the academic who first raised questions about Arday’s scholarship, was embroiled in a controversy of his own in which he had his emeritus title at Plymouth Marjon University stripped for a time after he critiqued critical race theory.
How To Fix DEI Rachel Kleinfeld · September 26, 2024 Read full story The fact that his accusers are controversial in their own right may help to explain why so many academics have reflexively defended Arday. In an interview with The Times of London, Arday this week said , “There has been, since I arrived at Cambridge, a very well orchestrated and co-ordinated campaign to unseat me from my position. The motive is racially motivated. I think there’s a reason why it’s me, and I do think that reason is aligned to ableism and racism.” In 2025, when the allegations against Arday were beginning to surface, the Cambridge professors Simon Baron-Cohen and Ricardo Sabates circulated an open letter under the heading “URGENT PLEASE SIGN ANTI-RACISM LETTER FOR JASON ARDAY.” The Good Law Project, an activist organization, orchestrated a solidarity letter last week that has been signed by 14,000 people decrying the “sustained and malicious attacks on the academic integrity of Dr. Jason Arday,” which the letter attributed to “an attempt to undermine Black people who hold positions of influence.” And Cambridge University has wholeheartedly taken Arday’s side. A university spokesperson said , “Professor Arday has been the victim of a vile campaign to undermine his credibility, which must stop.”
So—as you can see—it’s an uncomfortable story landing right on the faultlines of the culture wars. On one side is institutional procedure alongside an institutional culture hyper-sensitive to accusations against what the Good Law Project calls “a working class Black man.” On the other side is the argument that standards must be maintained—and maintained by academic and journalistic vigilantes if the institutions are unwilling to uphold their own meritocratic principles.
And of course the real issue isn’t exactly Arday. It’s the presumption that the politically progressive culture ascendant at Cambridge and in higher education in general has long ago deviated from real meritocracy. By phone, Cofnas was clear on that point. He said, “This is a story about DEI and the corruption that is required to sustain the system of DEI—of elevating people based on identity characteristics rather than merit.”
So what do we do in a case like this, where everybody pretty much sees what they are already predisposed to see? Well, first of all, we look at the source material—and in this case it’s pretty unequivocal. For instance, Arday’s line on page 17 of his 2015 dissertation—“Student teachers are unique individuals and differ in their personal biographies and prior experiences, disposition to enquiry, cognitive and perceptive abilities, communication, interpersonal skills, adaptability, values, and belief systems”—is a perfect match to page 1 of Zwozdiak-Myers’ 2009 dissertation . According to Cofnas, the pattern is repeated dozens of times, while The Telegraph for its part found “more than 100 passages that are identical or nearly identical” to Zwozdiak-Myers’ thesis. There is, as Harris put it , “no other plausible explanation” than plagiarism for the overlaps.
Then, in the week following Cofnas’ Substack post, subsequent reporting found additional patterns of fabulism by Arday. In an open letter to a government minister last year, Arday said he was the victim of innumerable threats and attacks since he took up his Cambridge position. In an interview with The Guardian this week, Arday clarified that he was referring to, among other incidents, a “severed pig’s head” that had been sent to his parents’ London home. That assertion triggered a macabre scavenger hunt, with Guardian journalists visiting the butcher shop that Arday claimed had sold the pig to the assailant. But the butcher said that there had been no police investigation into the incident, as Arday had asserted. For their part, London’s Metropolitan Police said that the details Arday gave of a police investigation into the incident were “categorically” inaccurate.
Arday further claimed that a masked man had accosted him twice at his Cambridge faculty building and threatened him with a knife the second time. But as The Guardian noted, no intruder appeared on CCTV on either occasion, and Arday did not inform colleagues or interrupt his working day after the alleged knife incident.
Meanwhile, a recently-surfaced video interview with Arday appears to show him claiming that he starred in the acclaimed documentary “Seven Up”—a mathematical impossibility unless Arday was actually born in 1956. And just today Glasgow University has denied Arday’s claim that he held a visiting professorship there.
Given all that—the all-but-indisputable evidence of plagiarism, in addition to the patterns of fanciful statements by Arday—the case for his defense collapses. “I think it’s plagiarism and it’s obvious,” one academic told The Guardian under condition of anonymity. “There is no question that there is extensive plagiarism,” David Sanders, an independent researcher who reviewed Arday’s case last year for Times Higher Education , said to Retraction Watch.
What Being a Digital Nomad Taught Me About the Real World Sam Kahn · Jul 27 Read full story Arday, for his part, did not, in a wide-ranging interview he gave to The Times of London last week, directly challenge the primary allegation of plagiarism and academic misconduct. He said, “I am accountable for the mistakes I’ve made. I hold myself accountable and other people should hold me accountable.” Instead, he took another line of defense, contending, “We’re talking about academia here. I didn’t murder somebody. I think the cruelty that I’ve experienced and the positioning of me as this kind of liar and fantasist is totally unacceptable.”
If it’s fair to say that the preponderance of evidence at this point speaks to serious academic misconduct on Arday’s part, the next question—picking up on Arday’s lead—is to ask ourselves what the stakes are here and what the story is really about. Arday is right of course that one academic with a shaky relationship to the truth is not, by itself, a huge deal. But, unfortunately for Arday’s defense, it is a story with more reach than he admits and it really does indict the institutions backing him.
For one thing, there is the issue of how Arday and his supporters have tried to defend him. There has been very little of the accountability Arday has called for—and there has been no willingness to look at the very obvious evidence of academic misconduct. The overriding tendency has been to shoot the messenger and to go after the academics, particularly Harris and Cofnas, who called attention to the issues in Arday’s work. According to The Guardian, Arday attempted to lodge a police complaint against Harris. Earlier this year, he dedicated a talk at the British Sociological Association to the “playbook” employed by conservative activists to target black professors. “There isn’t any room to sit there and watch your fellows suffer for no reason. It’s abhorrent, it’s a disgrace and, quite frankly, evil,” Arday said .
Apart from the often vitriolic counter-attack against Arday’s accusers, there has been a tendency to dodge the issue and shield Arday through arguments related to his neurodivergence. “1 in 4 autistic people have planned or attempted suicide. That’s why I’m very concerned about the impa
items.title_zh: 自闭症患者自杀风险引发关注
items.summary_zh: 文章提到，自闭症患者中有四分之一曾计划或尝试自杀，这一数据引发了对媒体报道影响的担忧。作者以自闭症人士Jason Arday为例，强调了对自闭症群体的关注，指出媒体在报道时应更加谨慎，以避免对这一脆弱群体产生负面影响。文章核心论点在于，社会应重视自闭症患者的心理健康问题，并采取措施降低自杀风险。
items.l1_lead: 自闭症患者中四分之一曾计划或尝试自杀，呼吁社会关注其心理健康并谨慎对待媒体报道。
items.l2_summary: 自闭症患者的心理健康问题日益受到关注，尤其是自杀风险的显著性引发了社会的广泛讨论。根据研究数据显示，约有四分之一的自闭症患者曾计划或尝试自杀，这一惊人的比例引起了人们对媒体报道的深刻反思。文章以自闭症人士Jason Arday为例，强调了对自闭症群体的关注，指出媒体在报道相关事件时应更加谨慎，以避免对这一脆弱群体产生负面影响。自闭症患者面临的心理健康挑战不仅影响他们的生活质量，也对社会的整体福祉构成威胁。因此，社会各界应当重视自闭症患者的心理健康问题，采取有效措施降低自杀风险。通过提高公众对自闭症的理解和支持，改善相关服务和资源的可获得性，可以为自闭症患者创造一个更安全、更包容的环境。总之，关注自闭症患者的心理健康，尤其是自杀风险，是社会责任的体现，亟需引起更多的重视和行动。

items.title_zh: 林赛·克兰西案背后的黑暗心理学
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了林赛·克兰西（Lindsay Clancy）案中可能涉及的心理健康问题。专家指出，克兰西的行为可能符合边缘性人格障碍（Borderline Personality Disorder）的五个特征，这足以进行诊断。具体而言，她的行为表现出自杀倾向和情绪调节困难等特征。这些心理特征为理解她的行为提供了重要的背景，揭示了在极端情况下，心理健康问题如何影响个体的决策和行为。
items.l1_lead: 林赛·克兰西案揭示了边缘性人格障碍对个体决策和行为的深远影响，尤其在极端心理健康问题下。
items.l2_summary: 林赛·克兰西案引发了对其心理健康问题的深入探讨，专家们认为她的行为可能符合边缘性人格障碍（Borderline Personality Disorder）的五个特征，这为对她的行为进行诊断提供了依据。具体而言，克兰西表现出自杀倾向和情绪调节困难等特征，这些心理特征为理解她在极端情况下的决策和行为提供了重要的背景。边缘性人格障碍通常与情绪不稳定、冲动行为和人际关系困难等相关，克兰西的案例突显了心理健康问题如何在关键时刻影响个体的选择和行为。通过分析她的行为，专家们揭示了心理健康问题在极端情境下的潜在影响，强调了对心理健康的关注和干预的重要性。这一案例不仅引发了对克兰西个人心理状态的思考，也促使社会对心理健康问题的重视，尤其是在面临压力和危机时，心理健康问题可能导致的严重后果。

items.title_zh: 林赛·克兰西案件背后的黑暗心理学
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了林赛·克兰西案件中的谋杀-自杀行为，认为这种行为可能是对伴侣的极端报复，体现了对控制和权力的渴望。文章引用了一句原话：“通过自杀，安德里安，你获得了对他的完全权力和支配感。”这一观点表明，谋杀-自杀的动机可能源于对伴侣的情感伤害和对关系的绝望。作者认为，如果克兰西出于某种原因选择这种极端行为，那么其背后的心理动机可以被理解为对伴侣的报复。整体来看，案件揭示了深层次的心理问题和人际关系中的权力斗争。
items.l1_lead: 林赛·克兰西案件揭示了谋杀-自杀行为背后的极端报复心理，反映了对伴侣控制和权力的渴望，以及情感伤害导致的绝望。
items.l2_summary:
林赛·克兰西案件中的谋杀-自杀行为引发了对其背后深层心理动机的探讨。文章认为，这种极端行为可能是对伴侣的报复，反映出一种对控制和权力的渴望。作者引用了一句原话：“通过自杀，安德里安，你获得了对他的完全权力和支配感。”这句话揭示了谋杀-自杀行为的潜在动机，可能源于对伴侣的情感伤害以及对关系的绝望。克兰西选择这种极端方式，可能是出于对伴侣的极端情感反应，表现出一种绝望的报复心理。

通过分析案件，作者指出，谋杀-自杀行为不仅仅是个人的极端选择，更是深层次心理问题的体现。这种行为常常与人际关系中的权力斗争密切相关，显示出在亲密关系中，个体如何在情感伤害和权力控制之间挣扎。整体来看，林赛·克兰西案件不仅揭示了个体心理的复杂性，也反映了在亲密关系中潜在的暴力和绝望。通过对这一案件的深入分析，文章强调了理解人际关系中权力动态的重要性，以及在面对情感危机时，个体可能采取的极端应对方式。

items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了林赛·克兰西案中的心理学现象，认为这一案件反映了社会价值观的重大转变。作者指出，1960年代是社会从集体主义向个体主义转变的关键时刻，这一变化与实验中观察到的临界点现象相似。通过分析这一转变，文章揭示了个体主义如何影响人们的行为和心理状态，暗示在特定情况下，个体的心理状态可能导致极端行为的发生。
items.l1_lead: 林赛·克兰西案反映了1960年代社会从集体主义向个体主义转变的心理学现象，揭示个体主义对行为和心理状态的深远影响。
items.l2_summary: 林赛·克兰西案揭示了个体主义在社会心理学中的深远影响，反映了1960年代社会价值观的重大转变。作者指出，这一时期是社会从集体主义向个体主义转变的关键时刻，这一变化与实验中观察到的临界点现象（tipping point）相似。个体主义的兴起使得人们的行为和心理状态发生了显著变化，个体在特定情况下的心理状态可能导致极端行为的发生。通过对林赛·克兰西案的分析，文章探讨了个体主义如何在社会中塑造人们的决策和反应，尤其是在面对道德困境时，个体往往会优先考虑自身利益而非集体利益。这种心理状态的转变，可能在无形中助长了社会中极端行为的发生，反映出个体在面对社会压力和道德选择时的脆弱性和复杂性。作者通过案例分析，强调了在特定情境下，个体的心理状态与社会环境的互动关系，揭示了个体主义对社会行为的深刻影响。整体而言，林赛·克兰西案不仅是一起具体的事件，更是对个体主义在现代社会中影响力的深刻反思，提示我们在理解人类行为时，必须考虑社会价值观的演变及其对个体心理的潜在影响。

Here's Everything to Know Before You Start Taking Supplements Follow Diet & Nutrition View feed What Is NAD? Here's Everything to Know Before You Start Taking Supplements NAD does naturally decrease over time, but supplementing isn't necessarily a good way to bring it back.
Getty Images We've been independently researching and testing products for over 120 years. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission. Learn more about our review process.
These days there are so many different types of vitamins and supplements on the market. Every time you walk down the supplement aisle, it can feel a bit like swimming in alphabet soup between vitamins C, D, and E and now trendy newcomers like nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, or NAD.
In 2024, the global nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide market was valued at $3.5 billion, and it is projected to grow from $4.5 billion in 2026 to $12.2 billion by 2033, according to Grand View Research.
With a market size that big, this must be a magic pill, right? We reached out to experts to get the lowdown on what NAD is, how to get NAD from your diet, and how to choose a supplement that best works for your lifestyle.
Simply put, NAD is an essential molecule found in every cell that our bodies must have to function. "Without it, life stops in seconds," says David A. Sinclair, Ph.D ., a professor of genetics at Harvard Medical School Paul F. Glenn Center for Biology of Aging Research and the author of Lifespan: Why We Age — and Why We Don’t Have To . “NAD is used by the body to carry out chemical reactions involved in processes such as energy production, DNA repair, and activating longevity-promoting enzymes like sirtuins.”
It's linked to your circadian rhythm as well as oxidative damage (which can contribute to skin aging like wrinkles and fine lines). Some studies in mice have found that higher levels of NAD may prevent fatty liver disease, improve kidney function, strengthen muscles, maintain a healthy cardiovascular system, lower inflammation, protect neurons, and slow aging.
As for humans, recent research (from 2023) has shown that NAD appears to be relatively promising in short-term studies, but there isn’t enough research on humans yet to definitively say that increasing the amount of NAD in your body will result in all of those health benefits. The good news is scientists are exploring the possibilities.
Unfortunately, our level of NAD tends to decline with age—and the amount by which it drops varies by type of tissue, research has found. That's why some people turn to supplements.
Right now, testing for NAD levels is not a routine part of health care and there’s no established recommended daily intake. That said, there are ways to evaluate the amount of NAD you have. “High-functioning organs like the brain, heart, liver, and muscles require greater amounts of NAD,” says Toby Amidor, M.S., R.D., C.D.N., F.A.N.D. , a nutrition expert and partner with Niagen Bioscience, which sells NAD booster products. “While direct measurement in these tissues typically requires biopsies or advanced imaging like MRIs, a less invasive way to assess overall NAD status is through blood testing.”
Sometimes, how your body feels is the best indicator that something is amiss. “Fatigue, brain fog, and metabolic slowdown could be signs that your NAD levels are declining,” says Sinclair. Of course, many other things can cause those symptoms as well, so if you’re feeling off and think low levels of NAD could be a contributing factor, talk to your physician.
First, talk to your doctor to make sure they think it’s a good idea. The NAD molecule itself is so large and unwieldy that it’s difficult for the body to use when taken as a supplement. “Supplements called NAD boosters typically contain either NMN (nicotinamide mononucleotide) or NR (nicotinamide riboside),” says Sinclair. “The body uses NR to make NMN, which is then converted to NAD.” A recent 2026 study showed that NR and NMN both increased circulating NAD+, but nicotinamide did not produce the same sustained increase which indicates how they both interact differently with the gut microbiome.
“There are a few ways to elevate NAD, including oral capsules and IV or injection therapy,” says Amidor. “It’s important to remember that supplementing or infusing with NAD directly is not efficient or as effective to raise NAD. Although NAD IV is popular amongst celebrities and athletes, it can take hours and induce severe side effects, such as nausea, headache, and diarrhea.”
If your doctor gives you the green light and recommends a dosage, here are some tips to consider when selecting an oral supplement to increase NAD levels:
“While we don’t absorb NAD directly from food, our bodies can produce it from specific nutrients found in whole foods,” says Serena Poon, C.N., C.H.C., C.H.N. , a certified nutritionist and founder of the wellness brand Serena Loves. Here are some strategies for obtaining NAD precursors through food:
“It’s also worth noting that preparation matters,” says Poon. “Steaming is an ideal cooking method for preserving NMN in foods like green beans and beets, while NR is more heat-sensitive, so enjoying certain fruits and leafy greens raw can help maintain their potency.” Just keep in mind that it’s probably not possible to eat enough food to bring NAD levels up to youthful levels, according to Sinclair.
Research suggests that short bursts of hot or cold exposure (such as in a sauna), a diet that’s not high in fat or sugar, exercising, and cutting calories may help increase NAD in your body. However, these methods aren’t recommended for everyone, and they may not lead to a meaningful long-term difference in NAD levels, so many people depend on NAD booster supplements instead.
Our bodies need NAD to function. However, levels decline as we age. If you’re low on NAD, your doctor may recommend supplementing with an NAD booster (NMN or NR), but there’s no guarantee that doing so will result in substantial health benefits. Fortunately, more research on NAD and the human body is emerging every year, so we should have more guidance soon.
Eric M. Ascher, D.O. is a board-certified family medicine physician. He completed medical school at the New York College of Osteopathic Medicine, his family medicine residency and fellowship at Northwell Health, and has been working for Northwell Health since. Dr. Ascher practices in New York City and focuses on preventative medicine and healthy lifestyles. He has been recognized annually on The Super Doctor’s List posted in the New York Times and has been recognized by Northwell Health as a Rising Star and Physician of the Year. He hosts a series on YouTube in collaboration with Northwell Health called “Hack Your Health,” where viewers are taught why household items may relieve their ailments. Dr. Ascher is an assistant professor of the Zucker Hillside School of Medicine at Hoftsra Northwell, has been a pioneer for telehealth throughout his career, has been a media expert, and is heavily involved in practice and technology optimization. He appreciates building relationships with his patients and their families to encourage long, happy, and healthy lives.

items.title_zh: 关于今年最受欢迎补充剂的真相
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了NAD（烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸）水平下降对健康的影响，指出疲劳、脑雾和新陈代谢减缓可能是NAD水平降低的迹象。科学家提到，身体利用NR（烟酰胺核糖）合成NMN（烟酰胺单核苷酸），进而转化为NAD。由于仅靠饮食难以将NAD水平恢复到年轻时的状态，因此补充相关物质可能是必要的。文章强调了NAD在维持身体能量和代谢中的重要性。
items.l1_lead: NAD水平下降可能导致疲劳和代谢减缓，补充NR和NMN有助于恢复NAD水平，维持身体能量和健康。
items.l2_summary:
近年来，关于补充剂的讨论愈发热烈，其中NAD（烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸）作为一种重要的生物分子，备受关注。研究表明，NAD水平的下降与多种健康问题密切相关，尤其是疲劳、脑雾和新陈代谢减缓等症状，这些都可能是NAD水平降低的迹象。科学家指出，人体通过NR（烟酰胺核糖）合成NMN（烟酰胺单核苷酸），再进一步转化为NAD。因此，NR和NMN的补充被认为是提升NAD水平的有效途径。

然而，单靠饮食摄入这些物质，往往难以将NAD水平恢复到年轻时的状态。随着年龄的增长，NAD的自然合成能力逐渐减弱，这使得补充相关物质显得尤为重要。文章强调，NAD在维持身体能量和代谢中的核心作用，尤其是在细胞能量生成和修复过程中，NAD的充足水平是不可或缺的。

总的来说，NAD的补充不仅有助于改善因其水平下降而引发的健康问题，还可能在延缓衰老和提升生活质量方面发挥积极作用。因此，针对NAD水平的补充策略，尤其是通过NR和NMN的摄入，成为了当前补充剂市场中的热门选择。

items.title: Appraisal of Gene Expression-Based Classifiers for Neuropsychiatric Disorders: A Meta-Regression.
items.body: A substantial body of research examines the potential of gene-expression-based biomarkers for diagnosing and selecting treatments for neuropsychiatric disorders, yet no clear consensus has been reached regarding the influence of controllable factors such as study design and model selection on the performance of gene-expression-based classifiers. To investigate study characteristics and methodologies that influence the accuracy of studies using transcriptomics to classify neuropsychiatric disorders, we conducted a literature review and meta-regression of relevant studies. We extracted several characteristics from each study, including the number of samples in a training dataset, approach for model validation, and classification model. Using univariate and multivariate mixed-effect meta-regression analyses, we estimated the association between these study characteristics and reported classification accuracies. Machine Learning (ML) models accounted for 55% of all models; Deep Learning (DL) models accounted for 20%, and variations of Logistic Regression models made up the remaining 25%. Support vector machine (SVM) was the most common model type (17%). The use of withheld test samples (56%) was the most frequent approach for validating the performance of classification models. We found significant associations between reported accuracies and study-rated bias risk, model type, class ratio, and validation approach. Overall, this review provides helpful insights into study characteristics that significantly influence classification accuracies and emphasizes the importance of prudent methodologies for training and evaluating classification models to mitigate biased accuracy estimates. In future research, these findings can direct study designs and support the development of clinically reliable, minimally invasive gene-expression biomarkers to improve diagnostic workflows and patient outcomes in neuropsychiatry.

items.authors: Razavi A, Arensman B, Barnett EJ, Lee LA, Faraone SV, Glatt SJ, Hess JL.
items.title_zh: 基于基因表达的神经精神疾病分类器评估：元回归分析
items.summary_zh: 本文评估了基因表达生物标志物在神经精神疾病诊断和治疗选择中的潜力，探讨了研究设计和模型选择等可控因素对基因表达分类器性能的影响。通过文献回顾和相关研究的元回归分析，提取了每项研究的多个特征，包括训练数据集样本数量、模型验证方法和分类模型类型。结果显示，机器学习（ML）模型占所有模型的55%，深度学习（DL）模型占20%，逻辑回归模型变体占25%。支持向量机（SVM）是最常用的模型类型（17%）。使用保留测试样本（56%）是验证分类模型性能的最常见方法。研究发现，报告的分类准确性与研究评估的偏倚风险、模型类型等存在显著关联。
items.l1_lead: 基因表达生物标志物在神经精神疾病诊断中的应用潜力受到研究设计和模型选择等因素的显著影响，机器学习和深度学习模型表现突出。
items.l2_summary:
本文对基因表达生物标志物在神经精神疾病诊断和治疗选择中的应用潜力进行了评估，重点探讨了研究设计和模型选择等可控因素对基因表达分类器性能的影响。通过对相关文献的回顾和元回归分析，研究提取了多项特征，包括训练数据集的样本数量、模型验证方法以及分类模型类型等。结果显示，机器学习（ML）模型在所有模型中占比55%，而深度学习（DL）模型占20%，逻辑回归模型变体则占25%。在不同模型类型中，支持向量机（SVM）是最常用的，使用比例为17%。此外，使用保留测试样本（56%）作为验证分类模型性能的方式是最为常见的。

研究结果表明，报告的分类准确性与研究评估的偏倚风险、模型类型等因素之间存在显著关联。这一发现强调了在神经精神疾病的基因表达分类器研究中，研究设计和模型选择的重要性。通过对这些因素的深入分析，本文为未来的研究提供了有价值的参考，指出了在提升基因表达分类器性能方面需要关注的关键领域。整体而言，基因表达生物标志物在神经精神疾病的诊断和治疗中展现出良好的应用前景，但其有效性仍受限于研究设计和模型选择的影响。

items.title: Prevalence of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder/hyperkinetic disorder of pediatric and adult populations in clinical settings: a systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression.
items.body: Background Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)/Hyperkinetic Disorder (HD) is linked to increased risks of morbidity, comorbidity and mortality, with higher prevalence in clinical populations. The differential prevalence of ADHD/HD across adult and pediatric clinical populations, influenced by factors such as time trends, sex, age, geographic regions, and comorbidities, has not been systematically assessed. Methods MEDLINE, CINAHL, Embase and PsycINFO databases were searched from inception to 1st August 2023 for eligible full-text papers published in English, and reviewing reference lists of identified studies and review papers. Studies reporting ADHD/HD prevalence in adult and pediatric clinical populations were included. Meta-regression evaluated the effects of geographic region, year of publication and sample size. Results From 30,740 citations, we reviewed 521 full-text articles, yielding 311 studies for inclusion (including 653,558 pediatric and 43,311 adult participants). Overall, worldwide pooled prevalence of ADHD/HD in clinical settings for pediatrics was 32.4% (95% CI 31-34%), and in adults 21.4% (95% CI 20-23%). Prevalence was higher in outpatient settings than inpatient settings. Prevalence based on rating scales was higher than studies using diagnostic interviews or clinical record review. Prevalence varied significantly across subspecialist settings for children and adults. No significant time trend was detected between 1981-2023. Pediatric prevalence appears influenced by geographic region but not year of publication or sample size. For adults, larger sample sizes were associated with lower prevalence estimates. Conclusions ADHD/HD prevalence in clinical populations is 8-9-fold higher than community estimates. With these patients at risk for many adverse outcomes, our findings underscore the critical importance of resource allocation for screening, diagnosing and treatment.
items.authors: Johnson S, Lim E, Jacoby P, Faraone SV, Su BM, Solmi M, Forrest B, Furfaro B, von Klier K, Downs J, Chen W.
items.title_zh: 临床人群中注意缺陷多动障碍的流行病学研究综述
items.summary_zh: 本研究系统评估了注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）/多动障碍（HD）在儿童和成人临床人群中的流行情况。通过检索MEDLINE、CINAHL、Embase和PsycINFO数据库，纳入了311项研究，涉及653,558名儿童和43,311名成人参与者。结果显示，全球儿童临床环境中ADHD/HD的合并流行率为32.4%（95% CI 31-34%），成人为21.4%（95% CI 20-23%）。门诊环境中的流行率高于住院环境，基于评定量表的流行率高于使用诊断访谈或临床记录审查的研究。此外，流行率在不同的亚专业设置中存在显著差异。此研究为理解ADHD/HD在临床人群中的流行情况提供了重要数据支持。
items.l1_lead: 本研究显示，全球儿童和成人临床人群中注意缺陷多动障碍的合并流行率分别为32.4%和21.4%，并在不同环境和亚专业设置中存在显著差异。
items.l2_summary: 本研究系统评估了注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD，Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder）/多动障碍（HD，Hyperactivity Disorder）在儿童和成人临床人群中的流行情况。研究通过检索MEDLINE、CINAHL、Embase和PsycINFO数据库，共纳入了311项研究，涉及653,558名儿童和43,311名成人参与者。结果显示，全球儿童临床环境中ADHD/HD的合并流行率为32.4%（95% CI 31-34%），而成人的流行率为21.4%（95% CI 20-23%）。研究还发现，门诊环境中的流行率高于住院环境，且基于评定量表的流行率普遍高于使用诊断访谈或临床记录审查的研究。此外，流行率在不同的亚专业设置中存在显著差异。这些数据为理解ADHD/HD在临床人群中的流行情况提供了重要的支持，强调了在不同环境和评估方法下流行率的变化，提示临床工作者在评估和干预时需考虑这些因素。总之，本研究为ADHD/HD的流行病学提供了重要的实证基础，有助于进一步的研究和临床实践。

items.title: Role of serotonin in psychiatric and somatic comorbidities of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder: a systematic literature review.
items.body: Introduction Serotonin is a well-established modulator of various neuropsychological processes, as well as organ and endocrine functioning, and metabolism and homeostasis. Serotonin has been implicated in the neurobiology of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). Herein, the evidence for a serotonergic link between psychiatric and somatic comorbidities associated with ADHD was evaluated. Methods A systematic literature review was conducted of the published literature to identify comorbidities proven to co-occur with ADHD and determine whether there was any serotonergic pathophysiology associated with these comorbidities. The average grade of serotonergic evidence was calculated and plotted alongside the volume of publications for each identified comorbidity. The date of the last search was 7 March 2024. Results One hundred eighty-two individual comorbidities commonly occurring in ADHD populations were identified; 135 (74.2 %) had evidence for serotonergic pathophysiology, including 91 psychiatric and 44 somatic conditions. The grade of evidence for a serotonergic role in the pathophysiology of a given comorbidity was generally medium to high or high. Conclusions Findings indicate that serotonin plays a key role, alongside dopamine and norepinephrine, in ADHD neurobiology. Serotonin involvement in physiological functioning suggests that dysregulation is likely to generate a broad spectrum of clinical manifestations, which may account for the unique presentation of neuropsychiatric behaviors and comorbidities found in patients with ADHD.
items.authors: Faraone SV, Ward CL, Boucher M, Elbekai R, Brunner E.
items.title_zh: 血清素在注意缺陷/多动障碍合并症中的作用综述
items.summary_zh: 本文系统评述了血清素在注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）相关的精神和躯体合并症中的作用。研究通过文献回顾，识别出182种常见的ADHD合并症，其中135种（74.2%）显示出与血清素（serotonin）相关的病理生理证据，包括91种精神疾病和44种躯体疾病。对每种合并症的血清素作用证据等级普遍为中等至高或高。研究结果表明，血清素在ADHD的神经生物学中与多巴胺（dopamine）和去甲肾上腺素（norepinephrine）共同发挥关键作用，且血清素在生理功能中的参与暗示其失调可能导致相关合并症的发生。
items.l1_lead: 血清素在注意缺陷/多动障碍的多种精神和躯体合并症中发挥关键作用，其失调可能导致相关疾病的发生。
items.l2_summary:
本文系统评述了血清素（serotonin）在注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）相关的精神和躯体合并症中的作用。通过文献回顾，研究识别出182种常见的ADHD合并症，其中有135种（占74.2%）显示出与血清素相关的病理生理证据。这些合并症中包括91种精神疾病和44种躯体疾病，表明血清素在ADHD的相关合并症中扮演着重要角色。对每种合并症的血清素作用证据等级普遍为中等至高或高，进一步支持了血清素在ADHD病理机制中的重要性。

研究结果表明，血清素与多巴胺（dopamine）和去甲肾上腺素（norepinephrine）共同在ADHD的神经生物学中发挥关键作用。这种相互作用提示血清素在生理功能中的参与，暗示其失调可能导致相关合并症的发生。因此，血清素不仅是ADHD的一个重要生物标志物，也可能是治疗ADHD及其合并症的潜在靶点。这一发现为理解ADHD的复杂性提供了新的视角，并为未来的研究和临床干预提供了重要依据。

items.title: A Global Prospective Harmonization Framework for Suicidality, Anhedonia, and Obsessive-Compulsive Symptoms in Psychiatric Genetic Studies: A Cross-Continental Study Within the Ancestral Population Network.
items.body: This study aims to prospectively collect harmonized, quantitative, and dimensional psychiatric phenotypes (suicidality, anhedonia, and obsessive-compulsive symptoms) and information on discrimination, stigma, and unfair treatment in up to 27,500 individuals across diverse ancestries and clinical populations for genetic analysis within the NIMH Ancestral Population Network (APN). Five APN projects are participating in the current study (PUMAS-Paisa, PUMAS-NeuroGAP, KOMOGEN-D, LATINO, and SAX-II), spanning recruitment over 15 countries across the Americas, Africa, and Asia. Participants are being enrolled via the recruitment protocols specific to each participating project. The harmonized clinical battery includes the Columbia-Suicide Severity Scale, Snaith-Hamilton Pleasure Scale, and Florida Obsessive-Compulsive Inventory-II to assess suicidality, anhedonia, and obsessive-compulsive symptoms, respectively. Additionally, we use the Discrimination and Stigma Scale-Ultra Short to evaluate discrimination and stigma across cultures. This project is a pioneering effort to prospectively assess transdiagnostic phenotypes in large-scale, diverse ancestral and clinical populations (across different diagnoses) using a harmonized clinical battery, advancing genetic research in mental health in underrepresented populations.

items.title_zh: 全球精神病遗传研究的自杀倾向、快感缺失与强迫症状统一框架
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在前瞻性地收集27,500名来自不同祖先和临床人群的个体的统一、定量和维度的精神病表型（自杀倾向、快感缺失和强迫症状），以及有关歧视、污名和不公平待遇的信息，以便在NIMH祖先人群网络（APN）中进行遗传分析。参与本研究的五个APN项目（PUMAS-Paisa、PUMAS-NeuroGAP、KOMOGEN-D、LATINO和SAX-II）覆盖美洲、非洲和亚洲的15个国家。参与者通过各项目特定的招募协议进行招募。统一的临床评估工具包括哥伦比亚自杀严重性量表、斯奈斯-汉密尔顿快感量表和佛罗里达强迫症量表-II，分别用于评估自杀倾向、快感缺失和强迫症状。此外，我们使用歧视与污名量表-超短版评估不同文化中的歧视和污名。该项目是首次在大规模、多样化的祖先和临床人群中前瞻性评估跨诊断表型的开创性努力，推动了在弱势人群中精神健康遗传研究的发展。
items.l1_lead: 本研究首次在多样化的祖先和临床人群中前瞻性评估自杀倾向、快感缺失与强迫症状，为精神健康遗传研究提供了新的视角。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在前瞻性地收集27,500名来自不同祖先和临床人群的个体的统一、定量和维度的精神病表型，包括自杀倾向（suicidal ideation）、快感缺失（anhedonia）和强迫症状（obsessive-compulsive symptoms），同时获取有关歧视、污名和不公平待遇的信息，以便在美国国立精神卫生研究所（NIMH）祖先人群网络（APN）中进行遗传分析。参与本研究的五个APN项目（PUMAS-Paisa、PUMAS-NeuroGAP、KOMOGEN-D、LATINO和SAX-II）覆盖了美洲、非洲和亚洲的15个国家，体现了研究的广泛性和多样性。参与者通过各项目特定的招募协议进行招募，确保了样本的代表性。

在数据收集过程中，研究团队使用了统一的临床评估工具，包括哥伦比亚自杀严重性量表（Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale）、斯奈斯-汉密尔顿快感量表（Snaith-Hamilton Pleasure Scale）和佛罗里达强迫症量表-II（Florida Obsessive-Compulsive Inventory-II），分别用于评估自杀倾向、快感缺失和强迫症状。此外，研究还使用了歧视与污名量表-超短版（Discrimination and Stigma Scale-Short Version）来评估不同文化中的歧视和污名现象。

该项目是首次在大规模、多样化的祖先和临床人群中前瞻性评估跨诊断表型的开创性努力，推动了在弱势人群中精神健康遗传研究的发展。通过对这些精神病表型的系统性分析，研究不仅为理解精神疾病的遗传基础提供了新的视角，也为改善弱势群体的精神健康服务和政策制定提供了重要依据。整体而言，本研究为精神健康领域的跨文化和跨学科合作奠定了基础，强调了在全球范围内进行精神病遗传研究的重要性。

items.title: Placebo and nocebo effects of pharmacotherapy for obsessive-compulsive related disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Objective This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to quantify the magnitude of placebo and nocebo effects in pharmacological trials for OCRDs and identify clinical and methodological moderators influencing these effects. Methods A comprehensive literature search was conducted across multiple databases and clinical trial registries up to May 2025. Randomised, placebo-controlled trials involving pharmacological interventions for OCRDs were included. The primary outcomes were placebo effect size and placebo response rate; secondary outcomes included nocebo response rate and side effect profile. Data were extracted independently and meta-analysed using random effects models. Meta-regression was performed to assess moderators of placebo response. Results Fifteen eligible trials ( N = 640; placebo N = 341) were included. The pooled placebo effect size was moderate (SMC = -0.63; 95% CI -0.77 to -0.48), with low heterogeneity ( I 2 = 4.73%). The placebo response rate was 21%, and the nocebo response rate was 18%. Despite testing a broad range of potential moderators, including clinical characteristics, methodological design, and medication class, no significant predictors of placebo effect size were identified. Side effects were reported in nearly one-third of placebo recipients, underscoring the relevance of nocebo effects. Conclusions Placebo and nocebo responses are noteworthy in trials for OCRDs and may influence perceived treatment efficacy. Variability in placebo responses is not well explained by currently measurable moderators. Further research is needed to explore neurobiological, psychological, and methodological contributors to expectancy effects in OCRD pharmacotherapy trials.
items.authors: Hoffman J, Williams T, Stein DJ.
items.title_zh: 强迫症相关障碍药物治疗的安慰剂与反安慰剂效应综述
items.summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在量化强迫症相关障碍（OCRDs）药物试验中的安慰剂（placebo）和反安慰剂（nocebo）效应，并识别影响这些效应的临床和方法学调节因素。通过对多个数据库和临床试验注册中心进行全面文献检索，共纳入15项随机对照试验（N = 640；安慰剂组N = 341）。结果显示，合并的安慰剂效应量为中等（SMC = -0.63；95% CI -0.77至-0.48），异质性低（I² = 4.73%）。安慰剂反应率为21%，反安慰剂反应率为18%。尽管测试了多种潜在调节因素，但未发现显著的安慰剂效应量预测因子。近三分之一的安慰剂接受者报告了副作用，强调了反安慰剂效应的重要性。结论是安慰剂和反安慰剂反应值得关注。
items.l1_lead: 强迫症相关障碍药物治疗中，安慰剂和反安慰剂效应显著，前者的反应率为21%，后者为18%，且副作用报告率接近三分之一。
items.l2_summary: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在量化强迫症相关障碍（OCRDs）药物试验中的安慰剂（placebo）和反安慰剂（nocebo）效应，并识别影响这些效应的临床和方法学调节因素。研究通过对多个数据库和临床试验注册中心进行全面文献检索，共纳入了15项随机对照试验，样本总量为640人，其中安慰剂组有341人。结果显示，合并的安慰剂效应量为中等，标准化均差（SMC）为-0.63，95%置信区间为-0.77至-0.48，且异质性低（I² = 4.73%）。在参与者中，安慰剂反应率为21%，而反安慰剂反应率则为18%。尽管研究测试了多种潜在的调节因素，但未发现显著的安慰剂效应量预测因子，这表明影响安慰剂效应的因素可能较为复杂。此外，近三分之一的安慰剂接受者报告了副作用，强调了反安慰剂效应的重要性。综上所述，安慰剂和反安慰剂反应在强迫症相关障碍的药物治疗中值得关注，提示临床实践中需重视这些效应对治疗结果的影响。

items.title: Neurorestorative properties of ibogaine: linking multi-receptor affinities to remyelination and metabolic restoration.
items.body: Ibogaine is a psychedelic alkaloid without an approved indication. Observational clinical research shows linkages between single administration of ibogaine and relief of symptoms of neuropsychiatric conditions including substance use disorder, multiple sclerosis (MS), and traumatic brain injury. Ibogaine has multi-receptor actions, but the neurobiological mechanisms underlying such putative effects are unknown. Here we review and discuss the relevant literature, focusing on remyelination and metabolic restoration. We provide evidence that ibogaine upregulates markers of myelination following opioid administration; that conditions such as opioid use disorder, MS and traumatic brain injury are characterised by white matter pathology; that decreased myelination is related to dysregulated metabolic homeostasis, ischaemia and hypoxia which may also play a role in these disorders. We conclude that multi-receptor actions of ibogaine, especially its affinities for the NMDA, kappa opioid and sigma receptors, in turn account for reduction in excitotoxicity, metabolic regulation, lasting neuroplasticity and immunomodulation that facilitates neuronal repair and remyelination providing a rationale for future investigation of its use as a therapeutic agent for these common central nervous system disorders.
items.authors: Calvey T, Govender D, Owen GR, Tumba N, Lang D, Lerer B, Stein DJ, Shoptaw S.
items.title_zh: 伊博卡因的神经修复特性：多受体亲和力与再髓鞘化和代谢恢复的关联
items.summary_zh: 伊博卡因是一种尚未获得批准的迷幻生物碱。观察性临床研究表明，单次使用伊博卡因与缓解神经精神疾病症状（如物质使用障碍、多发性硬化症和创伤性脑损伤）存在关联。本文回顾并讨论相关文献，重点关注再髓鞘化和代谢恢复。我们提供证据表明，伊博卡因在阿片类药物使用后上调髓鞘化标志物；阿片类药物使用障碍、多发性硬化症和创伤性脑损伤等疾病特征为白质病理；髓鞘化减少与代谢稳态失调、缺血和缺氧相关，这些因素可能在这些疾病中发挥作用。我们得出结论，伊博卡因的多受体作用，尤其是其对NMDA、κ阿片和σ受体的亲和力，能够减少兴奋性毒性、调节代谢、促进持久的神经可塑性和免疫调节，从而促进神经修复和再髓鞘化，为其作为治疗这些常见中枢神经系统疾病的药物提供了研究依据。
items.l1_lead: 伊博卡因通过多受体作用促进神经修复和再髓鞘化，为治疗中枢神经系统疾病提供了潜在的研究依据。
items.l2_summary:
伊博卡因是一种尚未获得批准的迷幻生物碱，近年来的观察性临床研究显示，单次使用伊博卡因与缓解多种神经精神疾病症状（如物质使用障碍、多发性硬化症和创伤性脑损伤）存在一定关联。本文回顾并讨论了相关文献，重点关注伊博卡因在再髓鞘化和代谢恢复方面的潜在作用。研究表明，伊博卡因能够在阿片类药物使用后上调髓鞘化标志物，这一发现与阿片类药物使用障碍、多发性硬化症和创伤性脑损伤等疾病的白质病理特征密切相关。髓鞘化减少通常与代谢稳态失调、缺血和缺氧等因素相关，这些因素在上述疾病中可能发挥重要作用。

通过分析伊博卡因的多受体作用，尤其是其对NMDA（N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸）、κ阿片和σ受体的亲和力，研究者发现伊博卡因能够有效减少兴奋性毒性，调节代谢，并促进持久的神经可塑性和免疫调节。这些机制共同促进了神经修复和再髓鞘化的过程，为伊博卡因作为治疗这些常见中枢神经系统疾病的药物提供了重要的研究依据。综上所述，伊博卡因的神经修复特性及其与再髓鞘化和代谢恢复的关联，值得进一步深入研究，以期为相关疾病的治疗开辟新的方向。

items.title: Are you on the internet or using screen-based devices?
items.body: The concept of 'internet addiction' was introduced in the 1990s and has increasingly been recognized as a clinical and public health issue. Although umbrella terms can be useful for screening, theoretical considerations, and intervention planning, the term itself has received criticism because of its conceptual heterogeneity, implying an addiction to a medium and not including a wide range of problematic behavioral patterns that are below the diagnostic threshold of a clinical disorder. To address this criticism, we propose adopting the term 'problematic use' instead of 'addiction'. Furthermore, we argue that while 'problematic usage of the internet' is currently a useful umbrella term, recent technological advancements and increasing online presence may in the future require a conceptual and methodological shift in terminology from 'internet' to the more specific 'screen-based devices' or 'screens' that would enable more accurate assessment and intervention strategies. Terms focusing on specific devices, such as 'smartphone addiction,' should also be used with caution, as problematic use relates to applications rather than the hardware itself and may extend to various devices.
items.authors: Demetrovics Z, Czakó A, Potenza MN, Griffiths MD, Fineberg NA, Stein DJ, Ekhtiari H, Brand M, Montag C, Lin CY, Li L, Elhai JD, Király O.
items.title_zh: 互联网成瘾还是屏幕设备使用问题？
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了“互联网成瘾”这一概念的起源及其作为临床和公共健康问题的日益被认可。尽管这一术语在筛查和干预规划中有其价值，但因其概念异质性而受到批评，未能涵盖低于临床障碍诊断阈值的多种问题行为。为此，作者建议使用“问题性使用”替代“成瘾”。同时，文章指出，随着技术进步和在线活动的增加，未来可能需要将术语从“互联网”转向更具体的“屏幕设备”或“屏幕”，以便更准确地评估和制定干预策略。针对特定设备的术语，如“智能手机成瘾”，也应谨慎使用，因为问题性使用与应用程序相关，而非硬件本身，并可能扩展到多种设备。
items.l1_lead: 文章建议用“问题性使用”替代“互联网成瘾”，并强调未来需关注“屏幕设备”以更准确评估和干预相关行为。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了“互联网成瘾”（Internet Addiction）这一概念的起源及其在临床和公共健康领域日益受到重视的现状。尽管“互联网成瘾”这一术语在筛查和干预规划中具有一定的价值，但由于其概念的异质性，受到了一些批评。具体而言，该术语未能涵盖那些未达到临床障碍诊断阈值的多种问题行为。因此，作者建议用“问题性使用”（Problematic Use）来替代“成瘾”，以更准确地描述相关现象。

随着技术的不断进步和在线活动的增加，文章指出，未来可能需要将关注的术语从“互联网”转向更具体的“屏幕设备”或“屏幕”，以便更有效地评估和制定干预策略。这一转变反映了对技术使用方式的变化，强调了在不同设备上使用技术的多样性。针对特定设备的术语，比如“智能手机成瘾”（Smartphone Addiction），也应谨慎使用，因为问题性使用往往与具体的应用程序相关，而非硬件本身。此外，问题性使用的现象可能不仅限于单一设备，而是可能扩展到多种设备之间的使用行为。

综上所述，本文强调了在研究和干预中对“互联网成瘾”这一概念的重新审视，呼吁采用更为精准的术语，以便更好地理解和应对现代社会中人们与技术的复杂关系。通过这种方式，能够更有效地识别和解决与屏幕设备使用相关的各种问题，促进公众健康和心理健康的改善。

items.title: Executive functioning in adolescents with internalizing disorders: a systematic review.
items.body: Internalizing disorders (INTs), including anxiety (AD) and depressive disorders (DD), frequently emerge during adolescence. Studies suggest that certain core domains of executive functioning (EF), i.e. inhibition, shifting and working memory (WM) may show selectively lower performance in certain INTs. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the evidence of associations between INTs and EF in adolescents. A systematic search was conducted in Medline, Psych-INFO, Scopus, and Web of Science in May 2023. Inclusion focused on adolescents (12-17) with AD (including obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)) or DD. After screening 2,551 titles/abstracts, 818 records underwent full-text review, on which independent reviewers reached 93% agreement on eligibility. EF parameters, measured through task-performance or ratings, were extracted from 32 eligible articles published since 2014. Performance-based EF differences were reported in 22 studies, most frequently in adolescents with DD. Task-based inhibition showed lower scores most consistently in DD (n = 5). Findings were mixed across other INTs. Three studies found evidence for improved inhibition performance in OCD (n = 2) and AD (n = 1). Finally, 6 studies reporting on self- or parent-rated EF found significant difficulties across EF domains, of which 3 contrasted with intact performances on task-based measurements of EF. Findings suggest both objective and subjective EF difficulties across INTs with no conclusive evidence for selective domain-specific differences. We highlight a discrepancy between subjectively experienced or observed deficits in daily EF and performance on structured tasks. This suggests that rating-based EF may be more sensitive for capturing subtle EF difficulties and therefore adds value in research and clinical settings. Finally, the quality of studies is discussed and directions for future studies are identified, namely, the use of both task and rating-based measures of EF as well as inclusion of larger sample sizes.
items.authors: Fontaine GP, Blake KV, Koen N, Stein DJ, Hammar Å, Groenewold NA.
items.title_zh: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能的系统评估
items.summary_zh: 内化障碍（INTs），如焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD），常在青少年时期出现。本系统评估旨在探讨青少年内化障碍与执行功能（EF）之间的关联。研究通过在Medline、Psych-INFO、Scopus和Web of Science进行系统检索，纳入了2014年以来的32篇符合条件的文章，重点关注12至17岁有AD（包括强迫症（OCD）和创伤后应激障碍（PTSD））或DD的青少年。结果显示，在22项研究中，DD青少年在任务表现上表现出较低的EF，尤其在任务基础的抑制能力上（n = 5）。其他内化障碍的结果则较为混杂。有三项研究发现OCD（n = 2）和AD（n = 1）在抑制表现上有所改善。此外，6项研究报告了自评或父母评定的EF，显示在EF各领域存在显著困难，其中3项与任务表现良好相对立。
items.l1_lead: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能存在显著关联，尤其抑郁障碍患者在执行任务时表现出较低的执行功能，反映出其在抑制能力方面的困难。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在系统评估青少年内化障碍（INTs）与执行功能（EF）之间的关系，特别关注焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD）。内化障碍在青少年中普遍存在，尤其是在12至17岁这一年龄段。研究通过在Medline、Psych-INFO、Scopus和Web of Science等数据库中进行系统检索，纳入了自2014年以来的32篇符合条件的文章，重点分析有AD（包括强迫症（OCD）和创伤后应激障碍（PTSD））或DD的青少年。

结果显示，在22项研究中，DD青少年在执行功能任务表现上普遍较低，尤其是在任务基础的抑制能力方面（n = 5）。这表明抑制能力的不足可能是DD青少年面临的主要挑战之一。尽管其他内化障碍的研究结果较为混杂，但有三项研究指出OCD（n = 2）和AD（n = 1）在抑制表现上有所改善，提示某些情况下，青少年可能在特定的执行功能任务中表现出积极的变化。

此外，研究还分析了自评或父母评定的执行功能，结果显示在EF的各个领域存在显著困难，其中有三项研究的结果与任务表现良好的情况相对立。这表明，尽管在某些任务中青少年可能表现良好，但在自我评估或他人评估中却显示出明显的执行功能障碍。

综上所述，青少年内化障碍与执行功能之间存在复杂的关系，尤其是抑郁障碍与执行功能的低下密切相关，而焦虑障碍和强迫症在某些情况下可能表现出改善。该研究为理解青少年内化障碍的影响提供了重要的实证依据，并为未来的干预措施提供了参考。

items.title: Consortium profile: the methylation, imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) consortium.
items.body: Epigenetic processes, such as DNA methylation, show potential as biological markers and mechanisms underlying gene-environment interplay in the prediction of mental health and other brain-based phenotypes. However, little is known about how peripheral epigenetic patterns relate to individual differences in the brain itself. An increasingly popular approach to address this is by combining epigenetic and neuroimaging data; yet, research in this area is almost entirely comprised of cross-sectional studies in adults. To bridge this gap, we established the Methylation, Imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) Consortium, which aims to bring a developmental focus to the emerging field of Neuroimaging Epigenetics by (i) promoting collaborative, adequately powered developmental research via multi-cohort analyses; (ii) increasing scientific rigor through the establishment of shared pipelines and open science practices; and (iii) advancing our understanding of DNA methylation-brain dynamics at different developmental periods (from birth to emerging adulthood), by leveraging data from prospective, longitudinal pediatric studies. MIND currently integrates 16 cohorts worldwide, comprising (repeated) measures of DNA methylation in peripheral tissues (blood, buccal cells, and saliva) and neuroimaging by magnetic resonance imaging across up to five time points over a period of up to 21 years (N pooled DNAm = 12,877; N pooled neuroimaging = 10,899; N pooled combined = 6074). By triangulating associations across multiple developmental time points and study types, we hope to generate new insights into the dynamic relationships between peripheral DNA methylation and the brain, and how these ultimately relate to neurodevelopmental and psychiatric phenotypes.

items.title_zh: 甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟简介
items.summary_zh: 甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟旨在通过结合表观遗传学（epigenetics）和神经成像（neuroimaging）数据，探讨外周表观遗传模式与大脑个体差异之间的关系。尽管DNA甲基化（DNA methylation）在预测心理健康及其他大脑表型方面显示出潜力，但目前相关研究主要集中于成年人且多为横断面研究。MIND联盟通过多队列分析（multi-cohort analyses）促进协作性、充分支持的发育研究，建立共享流程和开放科学实践以提高科学严谨性，并利用前瞻性、纵向儿童研究的数据，深化对不同发育阶段（从出生到成年初期）DNA甲基化与大脑动态关系的理解。目前，MIND联盟整合了全球16个队列，涵盖外周组织（血液、口腔细胞和唾液）中DNA甲基化的重复测量及多达21年的神经成像数据。
items.l1_lead: MIND联盟通过整合全球多队列的表观遗传学和神经成像数据，深入研究DNA甲基化与大脑发育之间的动态关系，推动儿童心理健康研究的科学严谨性。
items.l2_summary:
甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟致力于探讨外周表观遗传模式与大脑个体差异之间的关系，结合表观遗传学（epigenetics）和神经成像（neuroimaging）数据，推动对心理健康及大脑表型的理解。尽管DNA甲基化（DNA methylation）在预测心理健康方面展现出潜力，但现有研究多集中于成年人且多为横断面研究，缺乏对儿童及青少年发育阶段的深入分析。MIND联盟通过多队列分析（multi-cohort analyses）促进协作性研究，建立共享流程和开放科学实践，以提高研究的科学严谨性。该联盟利用前瞻性、纵向儿童研究的数据，旨在深化对不同发育阶段（从出生到成年初期）中DNA甲基化与大脑动态关系的理解。

目前，MIND联盟整合了全球16个队列的数据，涵盖外周组织（如血液、口腔细胞和唾液）中DNA甲基化的重复测量，并整合了多达21年的神经成像数据。这种大规模的数据整合为研究提供了丰富的样本量和多维度的视角，使得研究者能够更全面地分析外周表观遗传模式如何影响大脑发育及其后续的心理健康表现。通过这种跨学科的合作，MIND联盟希望能够揭示DNA甲基化与大脑功能之间的复杂关系，为未来的心理健康干预和治疗提供科学依据。

items.title: Exploring the relationships between Early Childhood Adversity, Social Cognition, and Aggression in a South African Study of People Living with Schizophrenia.
items.body: People living with schizophrenia (PLS) are at increased risk of being both victims and perpetrators of violence. Recent research suggests that social cognitive impairments may contribute to heightened aggression in schizophrenia. Childhood trauma, a well-established risk factor for both schizophrenia and aggression, is also linked to more severe cognitive deficits in PLS. Few studies have explored the relationships between childhood trauma, social cognition, and aggression in large sample sizes, particularly in low- and middle-income settings, where varying socioeconomic factors and exposure to violence may influence these associations. In this study, a subsample of participants (PLS = 585; controls = 882) from the Genomics of Schizophrenia in the South African Xhosa People study completed The Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ), Penn Emotion Identification Test (ER), Life History of Aggression Questionnaire (LHA), and Structured Diagnostic Interview for DSM-IV Axis I Disorders. Group differences in CTQ, ER, LHA, and selected demographic and clinical factors were assessed using t -tests and chi-square tests. Multivariable linear regressions were employed to test for associations among CTQ, ER, and LHA. We found that PLS had significantly higher childhood trauma and lifetime aggression scores and poorer emotion recognition performance than controls. Higher childhood trauma was associated with higher lifetime aggression and worse emotion recognition performance. However, emotion recognition performance was not associated with lifetime aggression. In this setting, childhood trauma predicts lifetime aggression and poorer emotion recognition, but there is no evidence that emotion recognition ability is related to aggression.
items.authors: van der Walt K, Wootton O, Rokicki J, Vaskinn A, Jonker D, Campbell M, Susser E, Haukvik UK, Gur RC, Stein DJ, Friestad C.
items.title_zh: 南非精神分裂症患者早期逆境、社会认知与攻击性关系研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了生活在南非的精神分裂症患者（PLS）中，早期逆境、社会认知和攻击性之间的关系。研究发现，PLS在童年创伤和终生攻击性评分上显著高于对照组，并且情绪识别能力较差。童年创伤被认为是精神分裂症和攻击性的已知风险因素，并与PLS的认知缺陷严重程度相关。通过对585名PLS和882名对照组参与者的问卷调查，包括《童年创伤问卷》（CTQ）、《宾州情绪识别测试》（ER）和《攻击性历史问卷》（LHA），研究使用t检验和卡方检验评估组间差异，并采用多变量线性回归分析CTQ、ER和LHA之间的关联。这些结果表明，早期逆境可能加剧精神分裂症患者的攻击性行为。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，南非精神分裂症患者的早期逆境与其攻击性行为显著相关，且童年创伤与认知缺陷程度密切相关。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在探讨南非精神分裂症患者（PLS）中早期逆境、社会认知与攻击性之间的关系。研究结果显示，PLS在童年创伤和终生攻击性评分上显著高于对照组，且其情绪识别能力较差。具体而言，研究发现童年创伤被认为是精神分裂症和攻击性的已知风险因素，并且与PLS的认知缺陷严重程度相关。研究样本包括585名PLS和882名对照组参与者，采用问卷调查的方式进行数据收集，使用的工具包括《童年创伤问卷》（CTQ）、《宾州情绪识别测试》（ER）和《攻击性历史问卷》（LHA）。通过t检验和卡方检验评估组间差异，并采用多变量线性回归分析CTQ、ER和LHA之间的关联，结果表明早期逆境可能加剧精神分裂症患者的攻击性行为。这一发现强调了早期逆境对精神健康的深远影响，提示在精神分裂症的干预和治疗中应考虑早期经历的因素，以降低患者的攻击性行为。

items.title: Problematic usage of the internet: Converging and diverging terminologies and constructs.
items.body: Problematic usage of the internet (PUI) is an increasing global concern, leading to significant negative impacts in various levels. PUI is an umbrella term comprised of subcategories, including online gaming disorder, online gambling disorder, online buying-shopping disorder, online compulsive sexual behavior disorder, problematic usage of social media, cyberchondria, cyberbullying, and digital hoarding. With respect to the diversity of these categories, a factor that further impedes the field of PUI is not recognizing these subcategories under the PUI. To estimate the state of the field, we conducted a systematic review on a sample time frame, 2022-2023, and we found that among 2,497 relevant papers, only 13% of the studies on PUI subcategories used PUI as an umbrella term. Establishing PUI as an overarching terminology, as we do with substance use disorder (SUD) as a term while respecting the diversities within its subcategories, would synergize research efforts, facilitate comparisons, and inform treatment strategies. As technology continues to evolve, terminological refinement is critical to maintaining relevance and accessibility for researchers and the broader community.
items.authors: Zare-Bidoky M, Baldacchino AM, Baldacchino AM, Demetrovics Z, Fineberg NA, Kamali M, Khazaal Y, Potenza MN, Stein DJ, Ekhtiari H.
items.title_zh: 互联网问题使用的术语与构建的趋同与分歧
items.summary_zh: 互联网问题使用（Problematic usage of the internet, PUI）日益成为全球关注的议题，给各个层面带来了显著的负面影响。PUI是一个涵盖多个子类别的总称，包括网络游戏障碍、网络赌博障碍、在线购物障碍、强迫性网络性行为障碍、社交媒体问题使用、网络健康焦虑、网络欺凌和数字囤积等。研究发现，在2022-2023年间的2497篇相关论文中，仅有13%的研究将PUI作为总称使用。将PUI确立为一个总的术语，类似于物质使用障碍（Substance Use Disorder, SUD），能够促进研究的协同、便于比较，并为治疗策略提供信息。随着技术的不断发展，术语的细化对于保持研究的相关性和可及性至关重要。
items.l1_lead: 将互联网问题使用（PUI）确立为总称有助于促进研究协同、便于比较，并为治疗策略提供信息，随着技术发展，术语细化至关重要。
items.l2_summary: 互联网问题使用（Problematic usage of the internet, PUI）已成为全球关注的热点议题，给社会的各个层面带来了显著的负面影响。PUI是一个涵盖多个子类别的总称，包括网络游戏障碍、网络赌博障碍、在线购物障碍、强迫性网络性行为障碍、社交媒体问题使用、网络健康焦虑、网络欺凌和数字囤积等。根据对2022-2023年间2497篇相关论文的研究，仅有13%的研究将PUI作为一个总称使用，这表明在学术界对这一概念的统一性和系统性认识仍显不足。将PUI确立为一个总的术语，类似于物质使用障碍（Substance Use Disorder, SUD），不仅能够促进研究的协同，便于不同研究之间的比较，还能为治疗策略的制定提供重要的信息支持。随着技术的不断发展，互联网使用问题的术语细化显得尤为重要，这对于保持研究的相关性和可及性至关重要。因此，推动PUI的系统化研究和应用，将有助于更好地理解和应对互联网带来的各种问题。

items.title: New Genomics Discoveries Across the Bipolar Disorder Spectrum Implicate Neurobiological and Developmental Pathways.
items.body: Bipolar disorder (BD) is a highly heritable mental disorder that affects millions of people worldwide. Our understanding of the genetic etiology and biological processes that underlie BD have greatly increased in recent years. Extensive progress has been made in identifying common variant signals for BD, and the polygenic score from the latest genome-wide association study (GWAS) may provide some clinical utility if combined with other risk factors for BD. The role of rare variation in BD remains to be determined, although genes annotated to common variant loci are shown to be enriched for rare variation. BD subtypes have been shown to differ in their genetic architecture, and as such, genetic studies across the subtypes of the BD spectrum will identify subtype-specific signals and reveal subtype-specific biological mechanisms. Despite this, subtype-specific GWAS sample sizes have not increased at the same rate as BD cases, and more concerted efforts are required to obtain this information for participants included in future BD GWASs. Moreover, assessment of culture, geography, and other systematic differences that may impact patient assessment will be necessary to ensure accurate inclusion of diverse ancestral groups and global representation in genetic studies of BD moving forward.

items.title_zh: 新发现揭示双相障碍的神经生物学与发育路径
items.summary_zh: 双相障碍（Bipolar Disorder, BD）是一种高度遗传的精神疾病，影响全球数百万人。近年来，我们对BD的遗传病因及其生物过程的理解显著提高。研究已在识别BD的常见变异信号方面取得了重要进展，最新的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中的多基因评分若与其他风险因素结合，可能具有一定的临床应用价值。尽管尚未确定稀有变异在BD中的作用，但与常见变异位点相关的基因显示出稀有变异的富集。BD亚型在遗传结构上存在差异，因此对BD谱系各亚型的遗传研究将识别特定信号并揭示特定的生物机制。然而，亚型特异性GWAS的样本量未能与BD病例的增长同步，未来需要更多努力以获取相关信息。此外，评估文化、地理及其他可能影响患者评估的系统性差异，对于确保在BD的遗传研究中准确纳入多样的祖先群体和全球代表性至关重要。
items.l1_lead: 双相障碍的遗传病因和生物机制研究取得进展，亚型差异显著，未来需加强样本量和多样性，以推动临床应用和理解。
items.l2_summary:
双相障碍（Bipolar Disorder, BD）是一种具有高度遗传性的精神疾病，影响着全球数以百万计的人。近年来，科学界对BD的遗传病因及其生物学过程的理解有了显著提升。研究者们在识别BD的常见变异信号方面取得了重要进展，尤其是在最新的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中，发现多基因评分与其他风险因素结合时，可能具有一定的临床应用价值。这一发现为BD的早期诊断和个性化治疗提供了新的思路。

尽管稀有变异在BD中的具体作用尚未明确，但研究显示，与常见变异位点相关的基因中，稀有变异的富集现象值得关注。BD的不同亚型在遗传结构上存在差异，因此，针对BD谱系各亚型的遗传研究将有助于识别特定信号，并揭示相应的生物机制。然而，目前亚型特异性GWAS的样本量未能与BD病例的增长保持同步，这表明在未来的研究中需要更多的努力，以获取更为丰富和准确的信息。

此外，评估文化、地理及其他可能影响患者评估的系统性差异，对于确保在BD的遗传研究中准确纳入多样的祖先群体和全球代表性至关重要。这一方面的研究将有助于更全面地理解BD的遗传背景，从而推动该领域的科学进步和临床应用。因此，未来的研究不仅需要关注遗传变异的识别，还应重视多样性和代表性的纳入，以便更好地服务于全球范围内的BD患者。

items.title: A whole-brain voxel-based analysis of structural abnormalities in PTSD: An ENIGMA-PGC study.
items.body: Background Patients with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) exhibit smaller regional brain volumes in commonly reported regions including the amygdala and hippocampus, regions associated with fear and memory processing. In the current study, we have conducted a voxel-based morphometry (VBM) meta-analysis using whole-brain statistical maps with neuroimaging data from the ENIGMA-PGC PTSD working group. Methods T1-weighted structural neuroimaging scans from 36 cohorts (PTSD n = 1309; controls n = 2198) were processed using a standardized VBM pipeline (ENIGMA-VBM tool). We meta-analyzed the resulting statistical maps for voxel-wise differences in gray matter (GM) and white matter (WM) volumes between PTSD patients and controls, performed subgroup analyses considering the trauma exposure of the controls, and examined associations between regional brain volumes and clinical variables including PTSD (CAPS-4/5, PCL-5) and depression severity (BDI-II, PHQ-9). Results PTSD patients exhibited smaller GM volumes across the frontal and temporal lobes, and cerebellum, with the most significant effect in the left cerebellum (Hedges' g = 0.22, p corrected = .001), and smaller cerebellar WM volume (peak Hedges' g = 0.14, p corrected = .008). We observed similar regional differences when comparing patients to trauma-exposed controls, suggesting these structural abnormalities may be specific to PTSD. Regression analyses revealed PTSD severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum ( p corrected = .003), while depression severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum and superior frontal gyrus in patients ( p corrected = .001). Conclusions PTSD patients exhibited widespread, regional differences in brain volumes where greater regional deficits appeared to reflect more severe symptoms. Our findings add to the growing literature implicating the cerebellum in PTSD psychopathology.

items.title_zh: 全脑体素基础的PTSD结构异常分析：ENIGMA-PGC研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了全脑体素基础的形态学元分析。研究发现，PTSD患者在前额叶、颞叶及小脑等区域的灰质（GM）体积显著较小，尤其在左小脑的影响最为显著（Hedges' g = 0.22, p 校正 = .001），同时小脑的白质（WM）体积也较小（峰值 Hedges' g = 0.14, p 校正 = .008）。通过与经历过创伤的对照组进行比较，观察到类似的区域差异，提示这些结构异常可能特定于PTSD患者。该研究使用了来自36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像数据，分析了PTSD患者与对照组在灰质和白质体积上的体素差异，并探讨了区域脑体积与临床变量（如PTSD和抑郁严重程度）之间的关联。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者在前额叶、颞叶及小脑等区域的灰质和白质体积显著较小，提示这些结构异常可能特定于PTSD患者。
items.l2_summary:
本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了全脑体素基础的形态学元分析，旨在揭示PTSD患者在脑部结构上的特征性变化。研究结果显示，PTSD患者在前额叶、颞叶及小脑等关键区域的灰质（GM）体积显著较小，尤其是在左小脑的灰质体积差异最为显著，Hedges' g值为0.22，校正后的p值为0.001。此外，小脑的白质（WM）体积也显示出显著减少，峰值Hedges' g为0.14，校正后的p值为0.008。这些发现通过与经历过创伤的对照组进行比较，进一步确认了PTSD患者在这些特定脑区的结构异常，提示这些变化可能是PTSD的特征性标志。

本研究使用了来自36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像数据，系统分析了PTSD患者与对照组在灰质和白质体积上的体素差异，并探讨了区域脑体积与临床变量（如PTSD和抑郁严重程度）之间的关联。这些结果为理解PTSD的神经生物学基础提供了重要的结构性证据，强调了小脑在PTSD发病机制中的潜在作用。总的来说，该研究不仅揭示了PTSD患者脑结构的特征性变化，还为未来的干预和治疗策略提供了新的思路。

items.title: Comparison between accelerated and standard or sham rTMS in the treatment of depression: A systematic review.
items.body: Major depressive disorder (MDD) represents a major global health challenge, with a significant proportion of patients being resistant to drug treatment (TRD). Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has shown promise in the treatment of MDD/TRD, with a single stimulation session per day for five days per week over several weeks (the "standard" protocol). The two main paradigms used are high-frequency rTMS and intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) delivered to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Accelerated TMS (aTMS) protocols aim to make the treatment more effective, or at least more rapidly effective, by delivering more stimulations in a shorter time, which could also facilitate the implementation of the protocols for a larger number of patients. In this systematic literature review, articles comparing in the same study an aTMS protocol to a standard or sham rTMS protocol were retained for analysis. Thus, 23 articles were retained and the analysis focused on the efficacy of aTMS protocols used for the treatment of depression (MDD/TRD) as well as on the impact of various stimulation parameters, such as stimulation pattern, intersession interval, dosage, and methods of cortical targeting. Although some studies did not report significant differences between aTMS and standard or sham protocols, others suggested potential advantages of aTMS, such as twice-daily HF-rTMS of the left DLPFC or more intensive iTBS protocols with a long interval between two sessions and personalized cortical targeting. Our results highlight the influence of the number of sessions or pulses per session (dosage), the duration of the interval between sessions, and the precision of target localization (using image-guided neuronavigation) on therapeutic efficacy. However, limitations in sample size, few independent studies replicating the same methodology, and variability in the clinical profile of treated patients, given different definitions of treatment resistance or the presence of comorbidities, hamper definitive conclusions.
