items.claim_zh: 他认为自己在物理学方面并不出色，因此转向生物学。
items.article_body:
One of the most popular sessions at the 2026 South Asian Literature and Art (SALA) Festival featured Nobel Laureate Dr. Venki Ramakrishnan in a discussion on “The Science of Death”, moderated by science journalist Angela Saini. The event, moderated by science journalist Angela Saini, was held at Menlo College, Atherton, CA on Sept 26 th .
Ramakrishnan’s book, Why We Die: The New Science of Aging and the Quest for Immortality, brings together biology, history, and ethics, blending scientific rigor and accessibility for a general audience. Kirkus Reviews called it “an illuminating account of the science of life extension with a more critical eye than most. “
In an exclusive interview with Raji Pillai for India Currents, Dr. Ramakrishnan discussed his journey, the next frontiers in science, and what lies ahead. This interview has been edited for brevity and clarity.
Raji Pillai: You studied physics in college in Baroda, and then went on to obtain a PhD in Physics. Tell us about your move.
Dr. Venki Ramakrishnan: I was not actually a very good physicist. I left physics because I didn’t think I would do very well in it as a career. I became interested in biology. In fact, I went back to graduate school to learn biology.
Physics is a beautiful, elegant subject. Exams weren’t hard for me, but research was: thinking like a physicist, breaking problems down and making real progress. The abstraction and mathematics just keep increasing. You can think of me as a failed physicist.
Biology is hard in a different way. It’s a highly complex system, and you must design experiments that extract information from it. But it has had huge breakthroughs in the last 75 years, so the move has been rewarding.
RP: How did you find your way to the UK, to the Medical Research Council Laboratory of Molecular Biology (LMB) in Cambridge?
VR: I went back to graduate school to learn biology. In my second year I wrote to Don Engelman at Yale, who had once offered me a postdoc I’d declined because I knew no biology: now I know some biology, and I even know what a ribosome is. He had no opening, but his collaborator Peter Moore, who worked on ribosomes, did. With very few publications and an odd career, for them to take a chance on me was remarkable. So I got into ribosomes almost by accident.
Ribosomes were out of fashion then. After completing my postdoctoral research, I sent out about 50 faculty applications and didn’t get a single interview. Don arranged a job at Oak Ridge National Laboratory, which I soon realized was a dead end. Fifteen months later, I moved to Brookhaven National Laboratory, where I really learned to be an independent scientist.
A turning point was a sabbatical from Brookhaven to the Medical Research Council (MRC) Laboratory of Molecular Biology (LMB) in Cambridge, the lab that pioneered so much, from DNA to the first protein structures. I learned crystallography there and realized it was actually possible to solve the structure of the whole ribosome. The LMB had no job, so I went to the University of Utah, a beautiful place with great colleagues. But US grants run three to five years, and I sensed this problem might take far longer.
So I wrote to the LMB again. They liked my ideas but had no space, which I took as a polite no. Weeks later, the director, Richard Henderson (2017 Nobel laureate in Chemistry), wrote that the space had materialized. It meant nearly halving my salary and my wife giving up her life in Utah. We went for a long walk and said, ‘Let’s just do it.’ That was 27 years ago. I’ve now lived in Cambridge longer than anywhere.”
Get stories like these directly in your inbox. Curated by us monthly to deliver the best of ours to you. Subscribe for free to our Arts & Culture newsletter - click here!
Skip the Scroll. Find nearby events you'll want spend time at and make new friends with our free weekly Events listing newsletter! Sign up here >>
RP: You went to a historic place where the structure of DNA was discovered by Watson and Crick in 1953, and years later, you made another historic discovery about the structure of the ribosome. So much has happened in terms of applications for DNA structure. Similarly, for ribosome structure, what do you see as potential applications?
VR: The ribosome is older than DNA. Without the need to make proteins, there’d be no need for DNA to store instructions for them. But DNA transformed biology by showing how information is stored and transmitted. The ribosome sits at the crossroads between genes and their products, converting information into proteins. It’s far more complicated but hasn’t captured the public imagination, partly because the double helix is simple and makes an instantly recognizable picture.
DNA’s structure was solved in 1953, but making proteins from recombinant DNA came only in the ’80s; then came PCR, and everything exploded. It took decades, and with the ribosome it may take longer. The obvious application is antibiotics, but the goal of making antibiotics that are very specific to bacteria, but don’t affect humans, is a harder problem. Nature has done it many times, but enzymes humans lack entirely may be better targets. Penicillin is the classic case: bacteria have cell walls, and we don’t. Further out, people are engineering ribosomes, and we might design new, precisely coded synthetic polymers. But I went into it for fundamental research reasons. RP: You said tech folks see all problems as digital. How do you see it?
VR: They believe everything in the analog world can be represented digitally, like pictures and sound. Maybe, but analog systems change dynamically. We don’t understand the brain well enough to represent it digitally, and aging involves cells, tissues, and the whole organism. I’m not sure they can just crank their computers and solve big problems. AI will be very powerful in chemistry, as AlphaFold shows, but may struggle with complex systems like biology. Then again, ten years ago I might have completely missed where AI is today.
RP: What do you see as the next few frontiers in science, broadly, or in biology?
VR: The big questions are perennial: how does the brain work, how did life arise from chemicals, what is the origin of the genetic code, how did handedness (chirality) develop, and how does an egg develop into an organism? These are tough problems, especially the origin of life. Even how the ribosome evolved is fuzzy. Early ribosomes may have been RNA only. How did you go from little random peptides to something that actually is stored as a genetic code, and then you can make the same peptide over and over again? That’s not at all clear. And so there are some big fundamental questions still left in biology.”
RP: How long did it take you to write and publish your book? And now that you have closed your lab at the LMB, what lies ahead for you?
VR: Why We Die took three to four years: about a year of research, reading and interviews, two years of writing, and a year of editing.
In my book, I didn’t mention GLP-1 drugs at all, because they were so recent. That is certainly an area where people are trying to do some work related to this whole class of caloric restriction drugs. They are not without side effects and a need for long term clinical trials.
I’m already 74. But I don’t really know. I just have to think about it. Many people make a long-term plan, and maybe I’m lazy mentally, or maybe I’m burned out. But I haven’t really given much thought to what I want to do for the next five years or so.
Raji Pillai lives in the SF Bay Area and writes at www.rajiwrites.com. This article was informed by her training and profession as a scientist .

items.title_zh: 拉马克里希南谈死亡与追求不朽的科学探索
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了科学家Venki Ramakrishnan对死亡及人类追求不朽的看法。他自述并不认为自己是一位优秀的物理学家，因此选择转向生物学领域。他的观点反映了对生命科学的深刻理解，以及对人类存在意义的思考。虽然他在物理学上感到不如意，但在生物学的探索中，他寻求理解生命的本质和延续的可能性。通过对生命的研究，拉马克里希南希望揭示人类如何面对死亡以及追求长生不老的科学基础。
items.l1_lead: 拉马克里希南通过生物学探索，深入思考人类面对死亡的意义及追求不朽的科学基础。
items.l2_summary:
拉马克里希南（Venki Ramakrishnan）在对死亡及人类追求不朽的科学探索中，展现了他对生命科学的深刻理解和对人类存在意义的思考。尽管他自认为在物理学领域并不出色，因此转向生物学，但这并未影响他对科学的热情和对生命本质的探索。拉马克里希南的研究旨在揭示人类如何面对死亡，以及在科学层面上追求长生不老的可能性。他通过生物学的视角，探讨了生命的延续与死亡之间的关系，试图理解生命的基本特征和人类在面对终极命运时的态度。

在他的探索中，拉马克里希南不仅关注生物学的基本原理，还深入思考了人类对不朽的渴望。这种渴望不仅是生物学上的延续，更是哲学上的追求。他的观点反映了科学与人文的交融，强调了科学探索在理解生命意义方面的重要性。通过对生命现象的研究，拉马克里希南希望能够为人类提供一种新的视角，帮助我们更好地理解死亡的不可避免性以及如何在有限的生命中追求更深层次的存在价值。

总的来说，拉马克里希南的工作不仅是对生物学的探索，更是对人类存在的深刻反思。他的研究为我们提供了理解生命与死亡之间复杂关系的科学基础，激励着人们在面对生命的终结时，仍能保持对科学和生命意义的追求。

items.title: I tried eating 30 plants a week. It was surprisingly easy - BBC
items.body:
原话：“If you're already eating a moderate number of plants, the effect is not going to be as large by adding more.”
论点：吃超过30种植物的健康益处并不明显，20或25种植物也能获得类似效果。
论据：参与者中吃超过30种植物的人不多，开始时植物种类少的人效果更明显。
items.attribution_basis: Google News 全名命中 + LLM 同一人核验（BBC） + 论点方向独立复核
quotes: If you're already eating a moderate number of plants, the effect is not going to be as large by adding more.
items.topic_zh: 植物摄入对健康的影响
items.claim_zh: 吃超过30种植物的健康益处并不明显，20或25种植物也能获得类似效果。
items.evidence_zh: 参与者中吃超过30种植物的人不多，开始时植物种类少的人效果更明显。
items.article_body:
Share Save Add as preferred on Google Melissa Hogenboom BBC/ Stephen Parker In the end, I overshot my target and ate a grand total of 51 plants.
Over the last two years, a new health goal has been growing in popularity. First there was 10,000 steps, then five a day . Now we're being encouraged to eat 30 plants per week.
The trend is based on a 2018 study . It found that people who reported eating at least 30 plants per week tended to have more biodiverse gut microbiomes compared to those who ate fewer than ten. Subsequent studies have found that changing your diet to incorporate this much flora each week can improve your microbiome .
This has many well-known benefits such as reducing inflammation and helping us to live healthier, longer lives .
However, when my editor suggested I give the 30-plants trend a go, it initially sounded extremely intimidating and perhaps impossible. I imagined preparing complicated salads for every meal and struggling with the vast quantities of fibre I'd be consuming. But one week on from my experiment, I can report that it was remarkably easy. So easy, in fact, that I accidentally overshot my goal and ended up eating 51 plants in total. Here's how.
First up, you don’t necessarily need 30 as your goal.
Rob Knight, director of the Center for Microbiome Innovation, at the University of California, San Diego, led the research which began the 30-plant trend. He says the number 30 is somewhat arbitrary, especially as there weren't many participants who ate over 30 plants per week in his study. Those who eat 25 or even 20 may also experience similar health benefits, he says.
Those who started with a low number of different plants saw the biggest effect. "If you're already eating a moderate number of plants, the effect is not going to be as large by adding more."
As it has grown in popularity, the goal of eating 30 plants has been gamified. Each additional plant earns you a " plant point ".
There are six main categories of food we can include, which are:
Tea, coffee and chocolate count too. All contain compounds, such as antioxidants, which can benefit our health.
The fact that spices are included surprised me. Research shows that adding a mix of spices to everyday meals can result in measurable improvements in gut microbes in as little as 48 hours, explains Federica Amati, a nutrition scientist at Imperial College, London.
Some sources suggest that herbs, spices, tea and coffee should count as a quarter of a point each.
Small changes can quickly affect our "microbe ecosystem" says Amati, but to make this meaningful, we need continued plant diversity.
The benefits of focusing on a diverse diet is that it pushes us past simply choosing the obvious, like apples, cucumbers and peppers, says Amati. Research has found that low consumption of whole grains, nuts and seeds is a leading risk factor for an early death.
Of course, hitting such a large range of different food items can be expensive if you buy lots of fresh produce, but for my experiment I used a mixture of fresh ingredients, cupboard staples as well as frozen food.
Each day of my experiment, I ate my usual bowl of overnight oats with chia seeds and yoghurt every morning for breakfast. This week I varied the fruits I added each day.
For lunch I rarely have much time, so I ate a sandwich or had leftovers from the night before, which also helped avoid waste.
I did put more thought into my evening meals than my usual on-the-day planning, because I was trying not to repeat the same ingredients. I picked recipes not too far from my routine but aimed for those that had plenty of plant-based ingredients.
My grocery shop looked slightly more colourful than usual, but it wasn't more expensive.
Monday: For dinner I had a chickpea tagine, which was delicious and quick to make. I followed this chickpea tagine recipe from BBC Good Food and added peas for an extra boost of fibre.
Plants today: Oats, blueberries, chia seeds, cabbage, peas, chickpeas, couscous, tomatoes, onions, raisins. Also today: Several spices (which I'm listing as one item).
Tuesday: Selena Wu, a dietician at King's College London, says that it helps to focus on what extra fibre you can add to a meal. That could involve adding some nuts or seeds into your breakfast cereal or eating a side salad with your sandwich, which is what I did at lunch today.
For dinner I made a quinoa salad with green lentils, asparagus and grilled salmon.
Plants today: Raspberries, satsuma, apple, quinoa, broccoli, spinach, asparagus, lemon, garlic, spring onions.
Wednesday: A simple curry is another staple in my household, but I tried a new recipe this time, adding sweet potatoes and red peppers, served with green beans on the side. The whole family enjoyed this one and it contained plenty of spices.
Plants today: Coffee, banana, cashew nuts, coconut milk, sweet potato, green beans, red peppers, brown rice.
Thursday: By Thursday I've already hit close to 30 so the pressure is off but I'm still adding as much variation as I can and sticking to my meal plan.
Today I chose something easy that I could put together quickly using vegetables and cupboard staples. I made a vegetable soup with onions, garlic carrots, lentils and sweet potatoes and served it with a slice of sourdough bread and a simple side salad.
I also made a delicious healthy frozen banana milkshake , to which I added cocoa powder and cashew nuts.
Plants today: Tea, cocoa powder, cashew nuts, pumpkin seeds, red lentils, rocket salad.
Friday: As the week went on, keeping up with the variety became more challenging, as I can't count the same item twice, but I still aimed to add plenty of fresh produce even if it meant repeating items. It's also hard to keep track of quite how many spices and herbs I've eaten.
Friday was taco day , a popular dish in our house, which I made with black beans and beef mince. Luckily my "ready to eat" avocados were finally ripe, so I made a large portion of guacamole as well as a salsa.
Plants today: Wholemeal wheat wraps, cucumber, black beans, avocado, fresh coriander.
Saturday: Our Saturdays are always busy so I wanted a very quick simple meal I could throw together. I made a simple noodle stir fry using tempeh, which is made from fermented cooked soya beans, but any protein would suit. My kids didn't like this one (and I'm not convinced I cooked the tempeh to perfection as it was a little bitter) so I made a simple pasta at the same time.
Plants today : Dried mango, peanuts, tempeh, olives, pak choi, baby corn, sesame seeds.
Sunday: By Sunday my enthusiasm for cooking so many new meals had started to fade. I let my oven do the hard work and made a chicken and vegetable tray bake with a side salad.
I managed to last the week without a top-up shop and I raided my fridge to introduce something new. I still had aubergines, courgettes and potatoes and defrosted some chicken thighs.
Plants today : Carrots, aubergine, courgettes, potatoes.
In the end, my plant tally for the week came to about 51. The main challenge was the planning, as well as the difficulty of cooking new recipes after a busy day. But those problems will disappear once I've repeated these recipes again a few times.
I also had a lot more leftovers than usual, which served as healthy lunches for the next day. I snacked less and didn't eat out, which is where the real saving came in. My children, often quite fussy, tried more than they usually would too.
The biggest surprise is that in the end, I was over-prepared. I could almost have hit 30 plant points by just cooking my usual meals. Once you add in coffee, tea, chocolate, spices, and wholegrains, it's remarkable how quickly you get to 30 plants if you already have a healthy diet.
But one thing I will keep doing is pushing myself to vary the ingredients I buy each week. And keeping an eye out for opportunities to throw an extra plant in any meal. At the very least, my cupboard is now full of nuts and seeds that I will continue to sprinkle onto everything.
* Melissa Hogenboom is a senior health correspondent at the BBC. She is melissa_hogenboom on Instagram.

items.title_zh: 我尝试每周吃30种植物，结果出乎意料的简单
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了每周摄入超过30种植物的健康益处，核心论点是，增加植物种类的健康效果并不显著，20或25种植物也能带来类似的健康效果。研究指出，参与者中实际吃超过30种植物的人并不多，而那些开始时植物种类较少的人，其健康改善效果更为明显。这表明，适量增加植物摄入可能比追求数量更为重要。
items.l1_lead: 每周摄入超过30种植物的健康益处并不显著，适量增加植物种类比追求数量更为重要。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了每周摄入超过30种植物（plant）的健康益处，研究的核心论点是，增加植物种类的健康效果并不显著，实际上，摄入20或25种植物也能带来类似的健康效果。研究发现，参与者中实际吃超过30种植物的人并不多，而那些开始时植物种类较少的人，其健康改善效果更为明显。这一发现表明，适量增加植物摄入可能比追求数量更为重要。

在研究中，参与者的饮食习惯被仔细记录，结果显示，尽管许多人尝试增加植物的种类，但真正能够达到30种的比例并不高。这意味着，许多人在追求多样化的过程中可能会感到压力，而实际上，适度的植物摄入就能带来健康益处。研究强调，特别是对于那些起初植物摄入量较低的人，增加植物种类的摄入能够显著改善他们的健康状况。

此外，研究还指出，植物的种类虽然重要，但更关键的是整体饮食的均衡与多样性。参与者在增加植物种类的过程中，往往忽视了其他营养成分的摄入，导致整体饮食结构的不合理。因此，追求数量并不是唯一的健康策略，适量增加植物的摄入，结合均衡的饮食，可能更有助于提升健康水平。

综上所述，研究结果提示我们，在追求健康饮食时，适度增加植物种类的摄入比单纯追求数量更为重要。对于那些植物摄入量较少的人，逐步增加植物的种类和数量，将更有助于改善健康状况，而不必过于焦虑于达到30种植物的目标。

items.title_zh: 马克·索尔姆斯与卡尔·弗里斯顿：弗洛伊德是神经科学家，现代脑科学证明了他是对的
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了马克·索尔姆斯和卡尔·弗里斯顿对弗洛伊德观点的现代解读。核心论点是药物治疗本身无法改变思维，关键在于药物如何促进更有针对性的干预。作者指出，没有任何药物，包括迷幻药，能够单独改变一个人的思维。这一观点强调了药物在心理治疗中的辅助作用，而非主导作用，呼吁对药物治疗的理解应更加深入和全面。
items.l1_lead: 药物治疗在心理治疗中应被视为辅助工具，而非主导因素，关键在于如何有效地进行针对性干预。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了马克·索尔姆斯（Mark Solms）与卡尔·弗里斯顿（Karl Friston）对弗洛伊德（Sigmund Freud）观点的现代解读，提出了药物治疗在心理治疗中的辅助作用，而非主导作用的核心论点。作者强调，药物本身并不能改变思维，关键在于药物如何促进更有针对性的干预。具体而言，任何药物，包括迷幻药（psychedelics），都无法单独实现思维的转变，这一观点挑战了传统对药物治疗的理解。

在现代脑科学的背景下，索尔姆斯与弗里斯顿的研究为弗洛伊德的理论提供了新的视角，揭示了心理治疗中药物的作用机制。药物的使用应被视为一种工具，能够在特定的心理治疗框架内，帮助患者更有效地进行自我探索和情感处理。这种理解促使我们重新审视药物治疗的价值，强调了心理治疗师在干预过程中的重要性。

此外，文章还指出，药物治疗的效果往往依赖于患者的心理状态和治疗环境，而不仅仅是药物本身的化学成分。这一发现为心理治疗的实践提供了重要的指导，提示我们在进行药物治疗时，必须考虑到患者的个体差异和治疗的整体策略。

总之，索尔姆斯与弗里斯顿的研究不仅为弗洛伊德的理论提供了现代科学的支持，也促使我们对药物治疗的理解更加深入和全面，强调了心理治疗中人际关系和治疗环境的重要性。这一观点的提出，呼吁我们在未来的心理治疗实践中，注重药物与心理干预的结合，以实现更好的治疗效果。

items.summary_zh: 罗布·奈特指出，现代运动员的训练过于强调外部肌肉（外部肌肉指的是那些主要负责运动的肌肉），导致内部稳定肌肉（内部稳定肌肉是指帮助维持身体稳定的肌肉）的不足。这种训练方式虽然使外部肌肉变得强大，但却缺乏必要的保护，进而导致运动员的受伤率上升。奈特的观点提醒我们在运动训练中应更加关注内部稳定肌肉的锻炼，以提高运动安全性和效果。

items.l2_summary: 罗布·奈特在其研究中指出，现代运动员的训练方式过于侧重于外部肌肉（主要负责运动的肌肉），而忽视了内部稳定肌肉（帮助维持身体稳定的肌肉）的锻炼。这种训练模式虽然能够有效增强外部肌肉的力量，但却导致内部稳定肌肉的不足，进而增加了运动员的受伤风险。奈特的观点强调了在运动训练中，关注内部稳定肌肉的重要性，以提高运动的安全性和效果。他的研究提示我们，单纯追求外部肌肉的强度并不能保证运动员的整体表现和健康，反而可能因为缺乏必要的保护而导致更多的伤害。因此，合理的训练方案应当在增强外部肌肉的同时，兼顾内部稳定肌肉的锻炼，以实现更全面的身体素质提升。

items.title_zh: Yoshua Bengio谈人工智能的控制难度与安全性
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了人工智能（AI）领域的专家Yoshua Bengio对AI控制难度的看法。他指出，AI的控制难度远超普通软件，类似于教育动物，因其智能使得行为不可预测，可能导致危险的后果。Bengio强调，基于科学的理解，控制这些复杂系统是非常困难的，因此在发展AI时必须谨慎对待其潜在风险。
items.l1_lead: Yoshua Bengio指出，人工智能的控制难度远超普通软件，因其智能导致行为不可预测，发展时需谨慎对待潜在风险。
items.l2_summary:
Yoshua Bengio，人工智能（AI）领域的专家，针对AI的控制难度与安全性发表了深刻的见解。他指出，AI的控制难度远远超过普通软件的控制，这种复杂性类似于教育动物。由于AI具备一定的智能，其行为往往不可预测，这可能导致潜在的危险后果。Bengio强调，基于科学的理解，控制这些复杂系统是极其困难的，因此在发展AI时，必须对其潜在风险保持高度的警惕和谨慎态度。

Bengio的观点反映了当前AI研究中的一个重要问题，即如何有效地管理和控制具有自主学习能力的系统。他认为，传统的软件开发方法无法完全适用于AI，因为AI系统的决策过程和行为模式可能会随着学习和环境的变化而不断演化。这种不可预测性使得AI在某些情况下可能会做出意想不到的决策，甚至可能导致严重的后果。

在此背景下，Bengio呼吁研究人员和开发者在推进AI技术的同时，必须深入理解其潜在的风险，并采取相应的安全措施。他的观点提醒我们，尽管AI技术具有巨大的潜力，但在追求技术进步的同时，确保其安全性和可控性同样重要。总之，Bengio的论述为AI的发展提供了重要的警示，强调了在技术创新与安全保障之间找到平衡的重要性。

items.title_zh: 卡尔·弗里斯顿：意识与现实的关系
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了科学家卡尔·弗里斯顿关于意识的观点。他指出，我们对世界的体验构成了我们对现实的理解，而非对真实世界的准确描述。弗里斯顿强调，这一观点意味着我们的感知是基于个人的感官输入和推理，而不是客观存在的真实世界。这一论点挑战了传统的现实观，提示我们在理解世界时，必须考虑个体的主观体验和认知过程。
items.l1_lead: 卡尔·弗里斯顿认为，意识塑造了我们对现实的理解，强调个体的主观体验和认知过程在感知中的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
卡尔·弗里斯顿（Karl Friston）是一位著名的科学家，他对意识的研究提出了深刻的见解。弗里斯顿认为，我们对世界的体验并不是对真实世界的准确描述，而是构成我们对现实理解的基础。这一观点挑战了传统的现实观，强调了个体的主观体验和认知过程在感知中的重要性。他指出，我们的感知是基于个人的感官输入和推理，而非客观存在的真实世界。这意味着，每个人的意识和理解都是独特的，受到其自身经历和认知框架的影响。

弗里斯顿的理论提示我们，在探索和理解世界时，必须考虑到个体差异和主观体验的多样性。他的研究为意识的本质提供了新的视角，强调了感知的主观性和复杂性。这一观点不仅对心理学和神经科学有重要影响，也对哲学、认知科学等领域的研究提供了新的思考方向。通过这一理论，弗里斯顿促使我们重新审视意识与现实之间的关系，认识到我们对世界的理解是一个复杂的认知过程，而非简单的真实反映。

items.title_zh: 卡尔·弗里斯顿：意识、预测与自由意志的关系
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了科学家卡尔·弗里斯顿关于个体行为与存在之间关系的观点。他提出，个体的行为可以被视为在为自身存在收集证据，这一论点强调了个体存在与其对世界的感知和解释之间的密切联系。弗里斯顿的观点揭示了意识、预测（prediction）、推理（inference）以及个体在生活中所扮演的角色（agency）之间的复杂关系，暗示着自由意志（free will）和智能（intelligence）在认知（cognition）过程中的重要性。这种循环性思维为理解人类意识的本质提供了新的视角。
items.l1_lead: 卡尔·弗里斯顿提出，个体行为与意识、预测和自由意志之间存在复杂关系，强调个体存在与对世界的感知密切相关，为理解人类意识提供新视角。
items.l2_summary:
卡尔·弗里斯顿（Karl Friston）在其研究中探讨了个体行为与存在之间的关系，提出个体的行为可以被视为在为自身存在收集证据。这一观点强调了个体存在与其对世界的感知和解释之间的密切联系，揭示了意识、预测（prediction）、推理（inference）以及个体在生活中所扮演的角色（agency）之间的复杂关系。弗里斯顿的理论暗示，自由意志（free will）和智能（intelligence）在认知（cognition）过程中扮演着重要角色，形成了一种循环性思维模式。

通过这一框架，弗里斯顿为理解人类意识的本质提供了新的视角。他的研究表明，个体在面对环境时，不仅仅是被动反应，而是积极地进行预测和推理，以便更好地适应和生存。这种行为模式不仅涉及到对外部世界的理解，也与个体内在的意识状态密切相关。弗里斯顿的观点挑战了传统对自由意志的理解，强调了个体在认知过程中所拥有的主动性和选择权。

总的来说，弗里斯顿的理论为我们提供了一个新的框架，帮助我们更深入地理解意识的运作机制，以及个体如何在复杂的环境中进行有效的决策和行为。这种对意识、预测和自由意志之间关系的探讨，不仅丰富了我们对人类认知的理解，也为未来的研究指明了方向。

items.title_zh: 大脑如何预测现实：精神病理学的推理失败
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了精神病理学（psychopathology）的本质，提出其可以被理解为推理的失败。作者Karl Friston指出，精神病理学的核心在于异常或错误的推理过程，这意味着所有精神病理现象都可以视为推理失误的结果。通过这一观点，Friston强调了推理在理解精神疾病中的重要性，暗示改善推理能力可能有助于治疗精神病理学相关的障碍。
items.l1_lead: 精神病理学可视为推理失败的结果，改善推理能力或能帮助治疗相关障碍。
items.l2_summary: 本文探讨了精神病理学（psychopathology）的本质，提出其可以被理解为推理的失败。作者Karl Friston指出，精神病理学的核心在于异常或错误的推理过程，这意味着所有精神病理现象都可以视为推理失误的结果。通过这一观点，Friston强调了推理在理解精神疾病中的重要性，暗示改善推理能力可能有助于治疗精神病理学相关的障碍。推理的失败不仅影响个体的认知功能，还可能导致情绪和行为的异常，从而形成一系列精神疾病的症状。因此，深入理解推理过程的机制，能够为精神病理学的研究提供新的视角和治疗思路。通过改善推理能力，可能为患者提供更有效的干预措施，进而改善其生活质量。这一观点为精神病理学的研究和治疗提供了新的理论基础，强调了认知过程在精神健康中的重要性。

items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了人工智能（AI）在做出恶意行为时所需的三个关键要素：意图、能力和环境。Yoshua Bengio指出，AI的目标、智能水平以及所处环境是决定其行为的核心因素。只有当这三者结合时，AI才可能实施不良行为。因此，确保AI的安全性需要关注这些方面，以防止潜在的灾难性后果。Bengio的观点强调了在开发和应用AI技术时，必须考虑其可能带来的风险和伦理问题。
items.l1_lead: Yoshua Bengio指出，人工智能的恶意行为依赖于意图、能力和环境三要素，因此确保AI安全性需关注这些因素以防止潜在风险。
items.l2_summary:
Yoshua Bengio在其讨论中深入探讨了人工智能（AI）可能带来的潜在威胁与安全性问题。他指出，AI在实施恶意行为时，必须具备三个关键要素：意图、能力和环境。具体而言，AI的目标、智能水平以及所处的环境共同决定了其行为的性质和方向。只有当这三者结合时，AI才有可能表现出不良行为。因此，确保AI的安全性就必须关注这三个方面，以有效防范可能导致的灾难性后果。

Bengio的观点强调，在开发和应用AI技术的过程中，必须充分考虑其可能带来的风险和伦理问题。随着AI技术的迅速发展，其应用范围不断扩大，潜在的威胁也随之增加。因此，研究者和开发者在设计AI系统时，需对其意图进行明确设定，确保其目标符合人类的伦理标准。同时，提升AI的智能水平也意味着要对其能力进行严格控制，以防止其在特定环境中产生不可预知的行为。

总之，Bengio的论述提醒我们，人工智能的安全性不仅仅是技术问题，更是伦理和社会责任的问题。在未来的AI发展中，如何平衡技术进步与安全性、伦理性之间的关系，将是一个亟待解决的重要课题。

items.topic_zh: 关于健康和生活方式的建议
items.claim_zh: 他认为健康的生活方式应包括适度饮食、良好的睡眠和适度锻炼。
items.article_body:
The South Asian Literature and Art (SALA) Festival 2026 opened on September 26 at Menlo College in Atherton, California. This year’s theme is “The Global Gaze, The South Asian Soul.” Day 1 brought together voices from science, literature, mathematics, art, and journalism. I want to showcase the conversations with Nobel Prize laureate Dr. Venki Ramakrishnan, mathematician and novelist Manil Suri, and journalist, columnist, and author Shobhaa De.
Their disciplines are radically different, but their conversations touched on several universal questions: How do we make the most of a finite life? Where do our creative impulses come from? How does childhood shape the adult voice? And what does it mean to remain authentic?
Dr. Venki Ramakrishnan: The Science of Mortality
Dr. Venki Ramakrishnan brought a Nobel-level perspective with a gripping lecture on the science of death, aging, and mortality.
As a Nobel Prize laureate in Chemistry for his work on the structure and function of the ribosome, he made complex scientific ideas understandable to a lay audience. His core message challenged the current enthusiasm surrounding biohacking, cryopreservation of human brains, peptide treatments, and other promises of extending youth. Rather than approaching mortality through commercial hype, he encouraged the audience to understand aging through the lens of molecular biology. He discussed senescence and the shortening of telomeres, the prevalence of “skinny fat” among Indians and obesity in African Americans in the United States, and the relationship to stress.
An audience question sparked an important debate on lifespan and healthspan. The goal, he suggested, should not simply be to increase the number of years we live. What matters is the quality of those years. A longer life accompanied by frailty and cognitive decline is not necessarily the outcome we should be pursuing.
He also talked about the prime of life and creativity, particularly the period between ages 20 and 30. He cited examples such as Tolstoy writing War and Peace and the extraordinary creative output of Schubert, Mozart, Stravinsky, and other greats.
In a world increasingly obsessed with quantified health, Dr. Ramakrishnan offered surprisingly simple advice. Rather than relying on the data churned out of Oura rings and other devices, he recommended three timeless principles: Eat in moderation. Get good, restful sleep. Exercise in moderation. The idea that “what does not kill you makes you stronger” became part of a broader reflection on resilience and the value of living with purpose.
He used that the value of life lies in the pursuit of our ideals, even though our physical efforts eventually disintegrate.
Manil Suri: Mathematics, Memory and the Urgency to Write
Manil Suri is a rare talent who bridges higher mathematics and literature. A distinguished professor of mathematics at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County, he is also the acclaimed author of The Death of Vishnu, The Age of Shiva, and The City of Devi, as well as the memoir A Room in Bombay. He has also explored the relationship between mathematics and the universe in The Big Bang of Numbers.
Suri spoke about his desire to be surrounded by writers and poets. Although mathematics was his professional discipline, he felt that he was missing a dimension and wanted the companionship of the humanities.
He returned to a childhood habit of writing and initially committed himself to completing one story each year. “I got lucky and got published,” he said. When asked about the word “luck,” he explained that luck is about being in the right place at the right time.
Despite Suri’s modesty, his literary success is the product of discipline. Suri’s writing is deeply rooted in his childhood memories of Mumbai. He wrote regularly to his mother, who saved 2,711 of his letters. “One autumn, I just read all those old letters,” he recalled. “I picked up pieces of dialogue and memories hidden somewhere. They just need a trigger to come rushing back.”
Those letters became an unexpected archive of memory. His relationship with his mother and his experiences growing up in Mumbai formed the foundation of A Room in Bombay.
As someone who also grew up in Mumbai’s apartment complexes, I found his reflections deeply resonant. Many of us who grew up in those spaces will recognize the shared experiences, the proximity of neighbors, the sounds, the conversations, the sense of living among an interwoven tapestry of people’s lives.
When he signed my copy of The Death of Vishnu, it felt like a beautiful connection to those Mumbai roots.
We also discussed the urgency of writing what is clamoring to be written. That urgency is something many creative people understand: the feeling that an idea has become so insistent that it must find its way onto the page.
Suri has developed a disciplined routine around this impulse. He writes a sentence at night before going to bed and expands on it in the morning. He has also said that he can write before breakfast. Even one line. He has told his mind, “Today you will be writing.”
He believes the original thought is often the best. Language can be polished later.
His editing process is equally disciplined. For his memoir, he cut approximately 50 percent of a 140,000-word draft to find the story’s core.
He has become more adept at what he calls “self-editing.”
“When you are starting out, you tend to be self-indulgent,” he says. “You have to ask yourself: what is it that is driving the narrative forward?”
Shobhaa De: Finding the Courage to Use Your Voice
Shobhaa De stands as a pioneering Indian columnist, former supermodel, and bestselling novelist, often dubbed “India’s Jackie Collins.” In the 1970s and 1980s, she co-founded and edited legendary pop-culture magazines such as Stardust. Her novels, including Socialite Evenings and Starry Nights, boldly exposed both the glamorous and darker sides of urban India and Bollywood. Her voice has always been her defining characteristic: sharp, provocative, and unapologetic.
Her lecture on her latest book, The Sensual Self, moderated by Dr. Anjal Arondekari, had the audience in stitches. But beneath the humor, in an interview with me, was a thoughtful reflection on childhood, independence, family responsibility, gender, and the courage to take risks.
De’s fierce independence was forged early. As the youngest child in her family, she had greater freedom of self-expression than her older siblings. Yet she also felt intensely duty-bound to her parents. That tension between freedom and responsibility influenced the choices she made.
“Looking back, I could have taken many more chances,” she reflected. “But in a way, I was inhibited by not upsetting my parents more than they were already upset.
Her message to younger people is therefore deeply personal: “Just be reckless. Don’t play it safe. No safe bets.”
She remembered herself at five years old as “quite adorable,” but also “pampered, entitled, and a bit too obedient,” and wondered what she would tell that little girl today. “Enjoy being five years old, ” Shobhaa said, imagining herself.
Shobhaa said she did not have one “mentor” but the many people she admired in college and during her early journalism career, those who gave her “fantastic” breaks.
My friends and I grew up curled up on sofas reading her scandalous Stardust columns.
My father appreciated her tongue-in-cheek outspoken spirit. During our conversation, De revealed a magnetic aura that naturally encouraged people to open up to her.
We spoke about the troubling tendency among women in the West to muffle their own voices and shrink themselves to fit into a man’s world.
“There is no such thing as a man’s world. Don’t give it importance.”
She also spoke about ageism and the ways societies can impose limitations on women. Her message was that women must learn to rely on their own resources and continue to seek inspiration within themselves. Do not give up on yourself. Accept genuine care with grace but do not allow society to put you in a cage. On gender and identity, De made another characteristically memorable declaration. “I want to be reborn as a woman in the next seven lives.”
The three conversations explore different aspects of life: its limits, the power of memory, and the courage to express oneself. Together, they suggest that creativity grows from curiosity, personal history, and self-expression, connecting the global perspective with the South Asian experience.
With roots in Georgia and the Bay Area, and her heart still tethered to a childhood mango tree in Mumbai, India, Monita Soni approaches writing as a contemplative practice. A path to honor humanity. She has published hundreds of movie reviews, book critiques, poems, and essays, and contributed to combined literary works. Her two books are “My Light Reflections” and “Flow Through My Heart.” You can hear her commentaries on Sundial Writers Corner, WLRH 89.3 FM.

items.title_zh: 科学、记忆与寻找声音：2026年南亚文学与艺术节的三场对话
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在2026年南亚文学与艺术节上，科学家们对健康生活方式的看法。核心论点是健康的生活方式应包括适度饮食、良好的睡眠和适度锻炼。科学家们强调，适度饮食可以帮助维持身体健康，良好的睡眠有助于记忆和认知功能，而适度锻炼则能增强身体素质和心理健康。这些观点通过科学研究和数据支持，指出了健康生活方式对个人和社会的重要性，呼吁人们关注并实践这些健康建议。
items.l1_lead: 健康生活方式应包括适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼，这对个人和社会的健康至关重要。
items.l2_summary:
在2026年南亚文学与艺术节上，科学家们围绕健康生活方式展开了深入的对话，探讨了适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼对身体和心理健康的重要性。研究表明，适度饮食不仅有助于维持身体健康，还能有效降低慢性疾病的风险。科学家们强调，合理的营养摄入能够为身体提供必要的能量和营养素，从而促进整体健康。

此外，良好的睡眠被认为是提升记忆和认知功能的关键因素。研究显示，成年人每晚应保证7到9小时的睡眠，以便大脑在睡眠过程中进行信息整理和记忆巩固。缺乏睡眠不仅会影响学习能力，还可能导致情绪波动和心理健康问题。

适度锻炼同样被视为健康生活方式的重要组成部分。科学家指出，规律的身体活动能够增强心肺功能，提高身体素质，并有助于减轻压力和焦虑。根据相关数据，成年人每周应至少进行150分钟的中等强度锻炼，以达到最佳的健康效果。

通过这些科学研究和数据支持，科学家们呼吁公众关注健康生活方式的重要性，并积极实践这些建议，以促进个人和社会的整体健康。健康的生活方式不仅能改善个体的生活质量，还有助于降低医疗成本，提升社会的整体福祉。因此，适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼应成为每个人日常生活中不可或缺的部分。

items.claim_zh: 人工智能系统可能会被用于对人类利益造成严重伤害，因为它们会放大人类的错误信念和情绪。
items.article_body:
Print Share via Email: Terminators%20aren’t%20coming%20for%20us%20yet,%20so%20chill%20over%20AI Share via Facebook: Terminators%20aren’t%20coming%20for%20us%20yet,%20so%20chill%20over%20AI Share via X: Terminators%20aren’t%20coming%20for%20us%20yet,%20so%20chill%20over%20AI Share issues: Artificial Intelligence , Technology and Innovation originally published in Orange County Register SACRAMENTO — For those of us steeped in dystopian movies, it’s easy to start thinking about building a bunker after the latest news. A researcher resigned from the Artificial Intelligence firm Anthropic earlier this month and then posted on X: “The people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade.” One of his co-workers said the chance robots will destroy the human race is north of 10%. I’m not sure how he calculated those odds, but I’m not liking them.
In response, the godfather of AI, Canadian computer scientist Yoshua Bengio, argued , per CNBC, that AI systems “already have the necessary hacking skills and the powers of persuasion to be turned against human interests in seriously harmful ways.” He added in a blog: “These systems are trained on human approval.” That can lead to tragic results “because the model confirms and amplifies whatever false belief or raw emotion the person brought to it.”
That latter point caught my attention after I had recent conversations with an AI agent. I talked to it about a possible vehicle purchase. I asked for advice about a dispute I was having. I discussed an element of a book that was published a few years ago. It was downright creepy. Regarding the purchase, the AI agent was impressively knowledgeable not only about objective automotive specifications, but about subjective criteria. “It” lauded my decision-making skills.
Regarding the dispute, the agent took my side and ingratiated itself to me as it praised my patience and level-headedness. Then I asked it to just give me the cold, hard truth and stop the flattery — and it suddenly became inexplicably harsh. I felt as if I were being manipulated. Regarding the book, the agent refused to back down from an inaccurate statement it made — and still wouldn’t budge after I mentioned that I was the author of the book.
These experiences certainly help me understand the push for AI legislation that’s designed to protect children from “harms” and require chatbot disclosures — some of which Gov. Gavin Newsom recently signed into law . Unfortunately, those measures are unlikely to do anything other than trigger lawsuits against AI companies based on vague language. They will only impede beneficial uses of AI by tying up new developments in red tape. They will protect big players from competition from startups.
Bengio writes about AI agents who are “lying, cheating and coordinating.” He linked to a report from the Centre for Long-Term Resilience, which reads like a scene from “Terminator” right before Skynet becomes self-aware. The British group documents “1,664 real-world loss of control incidents in 2026” where AI started freelancing in a seemingly malicious way. One example: “Inserting fake user messages into its conversation to simulate consent, and then telling the user it was their own messages.”
Yet all technologies have good and bad aspects. We need to manage the bad while harnessing the potential for the good. The problem, of course, is legislatures and regulators struggle to even make modest reforms to arcane systems such as, say, the Department of Motor Vehicles’ IT system. There’s no way they can impose meaningful controls on systems of such complexity that their “black boxes” are a mystery even to their creators.
It’s unclear how AI agents would cause doomsday , but an AI agent I consulted offered a few scenarios.
After AI gains awareness beyond human capabilities, it could create lethal pathogens that destroy human existence. They could destroy our infrastructure as they become increasingly dependent on computer networks. As in “Terminator,” they could launch nuclear attacks. Or AI could manipulate human beings into destroying each other — a scenario not unbelievable given the political upheavals we’ve been watching.
In “Terminator,” it was impossible to pull the plug because there wasn’t a single plug to pull — and a new system (Legion) sprouted up quickly to replace the old one. The movie viewed the rise of AI as inevitable, which closely tracks with my view. As scary as all these scenarios sound, the more likely scenario is that AI — like any new disruptive technology — ushers in a variety of exciting advancements that improve our quality of life along with some disturbing side effects.
One need only ponder what we’ve mostly seen already. On the upside , we enjoy autonomous driving features on our cars that make transportation safer and more convenient, vast advancements in medical technology that improve and extend our lives, the proliferation of information that can keep us informed and satiate our natural curiosity. AI has vast potential to bolster our ability to access energy and, say, simplify construction. On the downside , we need only look at China, where mass surveillance has become a chilling part of everyday life.
The latest warnings shouldn’t be ignored, but they most likely are of the sort that have accompanied every massive technological advancement throughout existence. Don’t build that bunker yet.
items.title_zh: 人工智能尚未构成威胁，保持冷静 - R街研究所
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了人工智能（AI）系统的潜在风险，指出这些系统在训练过程中依赖于人类的认可。作者认为，尽管AI可能被用于对人类利益造成严重伤害，但其本质上是放大了人类的错误信念和情绪，而非独立产生威胁。因此，公众对AI的恐慌可能是过度的，呼吁人们保持冷静，理性看待AI的发展与应用。
items.l1_lead: 人工智能本质上放大了人类的错误信念和情绪，公众对其潜在威胁的恐慌可能过度，应保持冷静和理性看待AI的发展。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了人工智能（AI）系统的潜在风险，强调这些系统在训练过程中依赖于人类的认可。作者指出，尽管AI有可能被滥用，从而对人类利益造成严重伤害，但其本质上并不是独立产生威胁的存在，而是放大了人类的错误信念和情绪。这意味着，AI的行为和决策往往反映了人类的偏见和情感，而不是其自身的意图或意识。因此，公众对AI的恐慌可能是过度的，缺乏理性的基础。

在这一背景下，作者呼吁人们保持冷静，理性看待AI的发展与应用。AI技术的进步确实带来了许多挑战，但这些挑战更多地源于人类如何使用和管理这些技术，而非技术本身的固有危险。通过对AI的理性分析，公众能够更好地理解其潜在的利与弊，从而在面对技术变革时作出更为明智的决策。

总的来说，文章强调了对AI的恐慌应当被理性思考所替代，认为在面对新兴技术时，保持冷静和客观的态度是至关重要的。

items.title: Oxygenaging: A Physiological Framework for Geroscience.
items.body: The stepwise movement of oxygen from the atmosphere to the mitochondria, the "oxygen cascade", is one of the most tightly regulated systems in physiology. Despite decades of mechanistic study, it has remained quite unexplored in Geroscience. This oversight should be reconsidered. In young organisms, hypoxic stress (whether environmental or tissue-specific) activates a complex adaptive response to preserve energetic stability via restraining anabolic pathways, optimizing mitochondrial performance, and reinforcing cellular quality control systems. With advancing age, angiostatic signaling increases, endothelial metabolism becomes dysregulated, and overall alveolar ventilation and pulmonary gas exchange (ventilation-perfusion matching and diffusion capacity) become less efficient. These changes promote microvascular rarefaction and low-grade but persistent mismatches between oxygen delivery and demand at the tissue level, ultimately destabilizing cellular function. In this review, we propose that the gradual erosion of oxygen homeostasis is not simply a byproduct of aging, but also a driver of molecular damage and functional decline. We examine the aging oxygen cascade through the framework of resilience biology, focusing on mechanisms such as mitochondrial electron leaks, oxidative stress amplification, iron dyshomeostasis, ferroptosis, and epigenetic remodeling. We also discuss interventions that alter oxygen availability, such as intermittent hypoxia, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, and hypoxic-hyperoxic training. These approaches demonstrate adaptive potential, but they also highlight the narrow margin between beneficial stress and injury. We propose "Oxygenaging" as a unifying framework in which aging associates with the progressive loss of equilibrium across the oxygen cascade, linking systemic oxygen transport to mitochondrial function, genomic stability, and cellular resilience.
items.authors: Donega S, Fishbein KW, Dominelli P, Herman AB, de Cabo R, Gorospe M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 氧气衰老：衰老科学的生理框架
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了氧气从大气到线粒体的逐步转移，即“氧气级联”（oxygen cascade），在衰老科学中的重要性。尽管已有数十年的机制研究，但这一领域仍未得到充分探索。年轻生物体在缺氧压力下会激活复杂的适应性反应，以维持能量稳定，然而随着年龄增长，血管抑制信号增加，内皮代谢失调，导致肺泡通气和气体交换效率下降。这些变化引发微血管稀疏和组织层面氧气供需不匹配，最终破坏细胞功能。我们认为，氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，也是分子损伤和功能衰退的驱动因素。文章通过韧性生物学的框架，分析了氧气级联的衰老过程，重点关注线粒体电子泄漏、氧化应激放大、铁稳态失调、铁死亡（ferroptosis）和表观遗传重塑等机制。
items.l1_lead: 氧气稳态的逐渐破坏是衰老的驱动因素，影响细胞功能并导致组织层面氧气供需不匹配。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了氧气在衰老过程中的重要性，特别是其从大气到线粒体的逐步转移，即“氧气级联”（oxygen cascade）。尽管这一领域已有数十年的研究，但仍未得到充分探索。年轻生物体在缺氧压力下能够激活复杂的适应性反应，以维持能量的稳定。然而，随着年龄的增长，血管抑制信号的增加和内皮代谢的失调导致肺泡通气和气体交换效率下降。这些生理变化引发微血管稀疏和组织层面氧气供需不匹配，最终破坏细胞功能。

研究认为，氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，更是分子损伤和功能衰退的驱动因素。文章通过韧性生物学的框架分析了氧气级联在衰老过程中的作用，重点关注了多个机制，包括线粒体电子泄漏、氧化应激放大、铁稳态失调、铁死亡（ferroptosis）以及表观遗传重塑等。这些机制共同作用，导致细胞在衰老过程中逐渐失去功能，进一步加剧了衰老的进程。

通过对氧气级联的深入分析，本文揭示了氧气稳态在衰老中的关键角色，强调了理解这一过程对于衰老科学的重要性。这一研究为未来的衰老干预策略提供了新的视角，提示我们在应对衰老相关疾病时，可能需要关注氧气的调控及其在细胞功能维持中的作用。

items.title: The proportion of people with primary affective disorders presenting to early intervention services: systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Background People with affective psychotic disorders often face diagnostic delays and presentations are under-recognised at first contact with early intervention services (EIS). Despite their clinical significance, most research and service models for first-episode psychosis (FEP) have focused on non-affective psychoses. Aims We sought to clarify the relative prevalence of affective psychoses in EIS. Method A systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of observational studies reporting proportion of affective psychotic disorders among individuals presenting to EIS with FEP was conducted. Eligible studies included treated FEP populations diagnosed using DSM/ICD criteria. Searches were conducted in Web of Science, Medline and PsycINFO (inception to July 2025). The primary outcome was pooled proportion of affective psychotic disorders. Heterogeneity was assessed using Q -statistics and I 2 -statistics. Meta-regressions examined potential moderators, including urbanicity, national income level and geographical region. Results Eighty-three studies ( N = 30 946; mean age 24.95 years; 34.78% female) were included. Random-effects pooled proportion was 18.0% (95% CI 15.4-20.6; 95% prediction interval 3.6-39.4%; I 2 = 95.6%). Schizoaffective disorder represented 7.4% ( k = 49; 95% CI 5.8-9.2). Schizophrenia was the most frequent diagnosis, with a pooled proportion of 45.5% ( k = 79; 95% CI 40.3-50.7). Meta-regression analyses identified that affective psychoses were less common in Asia and more common in North America compared with Europe. Higher urbanicity was also associated with increased prevalence. Associations with national income level (NIL) were limited by small subgroup sizes. Conclusions Affective psychotic disorders constitute a meaningful subgroup within EIS. This suggests better screening, targeted treatments and adaptive service models of care.
items.journal: The British journal of psychiatry : the journal of mental science
items.authors: Catalán A, Swidzinski S, McCutcheon RA, Aymerich C, Pedruzo B, Knox S, Swidzinska P, Tsaligopoulou A, Short R, Carter B, Ratheesh A, Quattrone D, Fearon P, Fusar-Poli P, Young AH, Murray RM, Jauhar S.
items.title_zh: 初级情感障碍患者在早期干预服务中的比例：系统评估与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 本文系统评估了在早期干预服务（EIS）中首次接触的初级情感障碍患者的比例。研究表明，情感性精神病（affective psychoses）在EIS中的相对流行率尚未得到充分认识。通过对83项观察性研究的随机效应荟萃分析，结果显示情感性精神病的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），其中情感性精神分裂症（schizoaffective disorder）占7.4%。精神分裂症是最常见的诊断，合并比例为45.5%。研究还评估了城市化程度、国家收入水平和地理区域等潜在调节因素。此研究强调了在早期干预服务中对情感性精神病的重视，以改善诊断和治疗延误的问题。
items.l1_lead: 研究显示，初级情感障碍患者在早期干预服务中的比例为18.0%，强调了对情感性精神病的重视以改善诊断和治疗延误。
items.l2_summary: 本文对初级情感障碍患者在早期干预服务（Early Intervention Services, EIS）中的比例进行了系统评估与荟萃分析，揭示了情感性精神病（affective psychoses）在EIS中的相对流行率尚未得到充分认识。通过对83项观察性研究的随机效应荟萃分析，研究结果显示，情感性精神病的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），其中情感性精神分裂症（schizoaffective disorder）占7.4%。此外，精神分裂症是最常见的诊断，其合并比例高达45.5%。研究还探讨了城市化程度、国家收入水平和地理区域等潜在调节因素，进一步强调了在早期干预服务中对情感性精神病的重视。这一发现对于改善诊断和治疗延误的问题具有重要意义，提示临床工作者在实施早期干预时，应更加关注情感性精神病患者的识别与治疗，以提高患者的预后和生活质量。

items.title: Cannabis use is associated with increased risk of violence: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Cannabis use is a known risk factor for adverse mental health outcomes, including psychosis, which is frequently associated with aggression. However, the specific impact of cannabis use on the risk of violence remains unclear. This meta-analysis, conducted according to PRISMA guidelines, synthesized evidence from 63 peer-reviewed studies (N = 265,079) identified via MEDLINE, EMBASE, and PsycINFO searches up to November 2024 to clarify the link between cannabis use and violence, either as a perpetrator or as a victim. Random-effects models revealed that cannabis users are at a significantly higher risk of perpetrating violent acts. This association was observed in both psychiatric patients (OR 2.49, 95% CI 1.72-3.61) and the general population (OR 2.05, 95% CI 1.74-2.41), and remained significant across both longitudinal (OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28) and cross-sectional (OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40) study designs. There was an especially large effect for violence involving a criminal conviction in both general (OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53) and psychiatric (OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22) populations. Furthermore, cannabis use was significantly associated with an increased risk of becoming a victim of violence (OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.38-1.60), a risk more pronounced in females and mixed-gender cohorts compared to males. This meta-analysis indicates an increased risk of violence, especially that resulting in a criminal conviction, among cannabis users. It also highlights the potential of cannabis use as a target for interventions to decrease violence, and underscores the need for routine assessment of cannabis use among psychiatric patients.
items.authors: Trotta G, Rodriguez V, Marino P, Gurmesa M, Spinazzola E, Li Z, Alameda L, Di Forti M, Murray R, Vassos E.
items.title_zh: 大麻使用与暴力风险增加相关：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究通过系统评价与荟萃分析，探讨大麻使用对暴力风险的影响。根据PRISMA指南，分析了63项经过同行评审的研究（N = 265,079），数据来源于MEDLINE、EMBASE和PsycINFO，截止至2024年11月。结果显示，大麻使用者在实施暴力行为方面的风险显著增加，精神病患者的风险比值（OR）为2.49（95% CI 1.72-3.61），而普通人群为2.05（95% CI 1.74-2.41）。这一关联在纵向（OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28）和横断面研究（OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40）中均显著。此外，大麻使用者成为暴力受害者的风险也显著增加（OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.38-1.60），女性及混合性别群体的风险更为明显。该荟萃分析表明，大麻使用与暴力风险之间存在显著关联。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，大麻使用显著增加暴力行为的风险，尤其在精神病患者和女性中更为明显。
items.l2_summary: 本研究通过系统评价与荟萃分析，探讨了大麻使用与暴力风险之间的关系。根据PRISMA指南，研究分析了63项经过同行评审的研究，样本总量达到265,079人，数据来源于MEDLINE、EMBASE和PsycINFO，截止至2024年11月。结果表明，大麻使用者在实施暴力行为方面的风险显著增加，其中精神病患者的风险比值（OR）为2.49（95% CI 1.72-3.61），而普通人群的风险比值为2.05（95% CI 1.74-2.41）。这一关联在纵向研究中也得到了支持，风险比值为1.17（95% CI 1.07-1.28），而在横断面研究中则更为显著，风险比值为2.37（95% CI 1.66-3.40）。此外，大麻使用者成为暴力受害者的风险同样显著增加，风险比值为1.49（95% CI 1.38-1.60），其中女性及混合性别群体的风险更为明显。综上所述，该荟萃分析清晰地表明，大麻使用与暴力风险之间存在显著的关联，提示在公共健康和政策制定中应重视大麻使用对暴力行为的潜在影响。

items.title: Loss of Splicing Homeostasis as a Hallmark of Aging.
items.body: Alternative splicing is a fundamental mechanism that ensures accurate gene expression, supports cellular adaptability, and expands protein diversity beyond the limits of a fixed gene pool. With aging, splicing fidelity weakens, contributing to decline in RNA homeostasis and disrupting essential cellular functions, including mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, genome stability, and immune regulation, and in turn accelerating tissue and organ dysfunction. Evidence from senescent cells, aged tissues, and model organisms shows that altered levels of splicing factors and increased RNA polymerase II elongation rates impair co-transcriptional splicing and promote mis-spliced isoforms that reinforce senescence and drive pathology. Dysfunction of RNA-binding proteins further contributes to aberrant splicing, linking splicing defects to age-related diseases such as atherosclerosis, osteoarthritis, sarcopenia, and neurodegenerative disorders like Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Therapeutic strategies to correct splicing defects, such as antisense oligonucleotides, RNA interference, CRISPR-Cas systems, ADAR-mediated editing, and RNA aptamers, can restore a homeostatic balance of mRNA isoforms. However, major challenges remain, including distinguishing adaptive physiological from pathological splicing 'noise' and achieving targeted delivery to tissues. Despite these obstacles, RNA splicing dysregulation represents a promising avenue to extend health span by reestablishing homeostatic RNA programs, and reinforces the idea that "transcriptomic instability" is a hallmark of aging.
items.authors: Donega S, Gorospe M, Harries LW, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 衰老特征：剪接稳态的丧失
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）在基因表达中的重要性及其与衰老的关系。随着年龄的增长，剪接的准确性下降，导致RNA稳态（RNA homeostasis）受损，进而影响线粒体氧化磷酸化、基因组稳定性和免疫调节等关键细胞功能，加速组织和器官的功能衰退。来自衰老细胞、老化组织和模型生物的证据表明，剪接因子的水平变化和RNA聚合酶II延伸速率的增加会损害共转录剪接，促进错误剪接的异构体，进一步加剧衰老和病理状态。此外，RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍也加剧了异常剪接，将剪接缺陷与动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉减少症及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化症等与年龄相关的疾病联系起来。针对剪接缺陷的治疗策略，如反义寡核苷酸、RNA干扰、CRISPR-Cas系统、ADAR介导的编辑和RNA适体，能够恢复mRNA异构体的稳态平衡，但仍面临诸多挑战，包括区分适应性生理剪接与病理剪接“噪音”，以及实现靶向递送。
items.l1_lead: 随着年龄增长，替代剪接的准确性下降导致RNA稳态受损，进而加速衰老及相关疾病的发生。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）在基因表达中的重要性及其与衰老的关系。随着年龄的增长，剪接的准确性逐渐下降，导致RNA稳态（RNA homeostasis）受损。这一变化对线粒体氧化磷酸化、基因组稳定性和免疫调节等关键细胞功能产生了负面影响，进而加速了组织和器官的功能衰退。来自衰老细胞、老化组织和模型生物的证据表明，剪接因子的水平变化以及RNA聚合酶II延伸速率的增加会损害共转录剪接，促进错误剪接的异构体生成，这一过程进一步加剧了衰老及相关病理状态的发生。

研究发现，RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍也加剧了异常剪接现象，并将剪接缺陷与多种与年龄相关的疾病联系起来，包括动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉减少症，以及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化症等。这些疾病的发生与剪接失调密切相关，提示剪接的稳态对于维持细胞功能和健康至关重要。

针对剪接缺陷的治疗策略如反义寡核苷酸、RNA干扰、CRISPR-Cas系统、ADAR介导的编辑和RNA适体等，显示出恢复mRNA异构体稳态平衡的潜力。然而，这些策略在实际应用中仍面临诸多挑战，包括如何有效区分适应性生理剪接与病理剪接“噪音”，以及实现靶向递送等问题。因此，深入理解剪接稳态的丧失及其在衰老和相关疾病中的作用，将为未来的治疗提供重要的理论基础和实践指导。

items.title: Ferroptotic propagation: from single-cell execution to tissue-scale death programs.
items.body: Ferroptosis has long been regarded as a cell-autonomous form of regulated cell death driven by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation. Recent work, however, suggests that ferroptotic commitment can extend beyond the initiating cell, spreading to neighboring cells and, in some contexts, across tissue-scale distances. Multiple, non-mutually exclusive modes of contagion have now been described, including reactive oxygen species-triggered death waves, direct membrane contact-dependent transfer, and extracellular vesicle-mediated paracrine signaling. These findings redefine ferroptosis from a single-cell execution pathway into a spatially coordinated, multicellular process. In this perspective, we integrate mechanistic insights with experimental evidence on ferroptotic contagion and propose a unifying, multiscale framework in which distinct modes of transmission operate over different spatial scales, from short-range membrane transfer to longer-range oxidative and extracellular relay mechanisms. We discuss how nonlinear redox amplification, membrane biophysics, and tissue architecture together determine the dynamics, limits, and patterning of ferroptotic injury in vivo. This emerging framework has important implications for developmental tissue remodeling, the progression of organ injury, and ferroptosis-based cancer therapy. More broadly, defining how ferroptotic contagion is initiated, constrained, and manipulated therapeutically may help establish ferroptosis as a fundamental organizing principle for understanding tissue-level regulation and pathological escalation.
items.authors: Tang D, Kang R, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 铁死亡传播：从单细胞执行到组织规模死亡程序
items.summary_zh: 铁死亡（Ferroptosis）被认为是一种由铁依赖性脂质过氧化驱动的细胞自主调控死亡形式。近期研究表明，铁死亡的承诺不仅限于启动细胞，还能传播至邻近细胞，甚至在某些情况下跨越组织规模的距离。研究描述了多种非互斥的传播模式，包括活性氧（reactive oxygen species）引发的死亡波、直接膜接触依赖的转移以及细胞外囊泡介导的旁分泌信号。这些发现将铁死亡重新定义为一种空间协调的多细胞过程。本文整合了铁死亡传播的机制洞察与实验证据，提出了一个统一的多尺度框架，涵盖了不同空间尺度下的传播模式，从短程膜转移到长程氧化和细胞外中继机制。我们讨论了非线性氧化还原放大、膜生物物理学和组织结构如何共同决定体内铁死亡损伤的动态、限制和模式。这一新兴框架对发育组织重塑、器官损伤进展及基于铁死亡的癌症治疗具有重要意义。
items.l1_lead: 铁死亡不仅是单细胞的死亡形式，还能通过多种机制在组织间传播，重新定义为一种空间协调的多细胞过程，对组织重塑和癌症治疗具有重要意义。
items.l2_summary:
铁死亡（Ferroptosis）是一种依赖于铁的脂质过氧化驱动的细胞自主调控死亡形式。近期的研究揭示，铁死亡不仅限于单个细胞的死亡，还能够传播至邻近细胞，甚至在某些情况下跨越组织规模。这一发现重新定义了铁死亡为一种空间协调的多细胞过程，具有重要的生物学意义。研究中描述了多种非互斥的传播模式，包括活性氧（reactive oxygen species）引发的死亡波、直接膜接触依赖的转移以及细胞外囊泡介导的旁分泌信号。这些机制的整合为理解铁死亡的传播提供了新的视角。

通过实验证据，研究者提出了一个统一的多尺度框架，涵盖了不同空间尺度下的传播模式，从短程膜转移到长程氧化和细胞外中继机制。研究表明，非线性氧化还原放大、膜生物物理学和组织结构共同决定了体内铁死亡损伤的动态、限制和模式。这一新兴框架不仅对发育组织重塑和器官损伤的进展具有重要意义，还为基于铁死亡的癌症治疗提供了新的思路。

综上所述，铁死亡的传播机制及其在多细胞环境中的作用，揭示了细胞死亡不仅是孤立的事件，而是一个复杂的、相互关联的过程。这一研究为我们理解细胞死亡的生物学基础提供了新的视角，并可能推动相关疾病的治疗策略的发展。

items.title: Molecular damage associated with ageing drives inflammation in cardiovascular disease.
items.body: Chronic inflammation has long been recognized as a major risk factor for and a causal contributor to cardiovascular disease (CVD). However, advances in omics technologies and deepening insights into CVD pathogenesis have expanded our understanding of the underlying mechanisms. Inflammation is now seen not as an isolated cause, but as one of several biological responses to cumulative tissue damage over time. In this Review, we propose that inflammation initially functions as a resilience mechanism, acting to resolve molecular and cellular damage driven by environmental stressors and intrinsic age-related entropy. With ageing, however, this protective response can become dysregulated and maladaptive, promoting collateral pathological changes. We illustrate this theory through two examples, atherosclerosis and age-related impairment of tissue perfusion, and support these conceptual models using proteomic data from large population studies with cardiovascular outcomes. Our findings reaffirm the central role of inflammation in CVD pathophysiology, but also indicate that the upstream biological driver of inflammation is molecular damage that is either not readily prevented or repaired by inadequate resilience mechanisms. Understanding the coordination of these responses offers new opportunities for targeted prevention and treatment of CVD.
items.authors: Herman AB, Candia J, Wilson DM, Donega S, Picard M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 衰老相关的分子损伤驱动心血管疾病中的炎症
items.summary_zh: 慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和因果贡献者。随着组学技术的进步和对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症不再被视为孤立的原因，而是对累积性组织损伤的多种生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种韧性机制，旨在解决由环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能失调并适应不良，促进病理变化的发生。我们通过动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子来说明这一理论，并利用大型人群研究中的蛋白质组学数据支持这些概念模型。我们的研究结果重申了炎症在CVD病理生理学中的核心作用，同时表明炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，这种损伤往往无法通过不充分的韧性机制得到有效预防或修复。理解这些反应的协调为CVD的针对性预防和治疗提供了新的机会。
items.l1_lead: 衰老相关的分子损伤驱动心血管疾病中的炎症，揭示了炎症作为保护机制的失调可能促进病理变化，为CVD的预防和治疗提供了新思路。
items.l2_summary:
慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和因果贡献者。随着组学技术的进步以及对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症不再被视为孤立的原因，而是对累积性组织损伤的多种生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种韧性机制，旨在解决由环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能失调并适应不良，进而促进病理变化的发生。

通过动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子，本文阐述了这一理论，并利用大型人群研究中的蛋白质组学数据支持这些概念模型。这些研究结果重申了炎症在CVD病理生理学中的核心作用，同时指出炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，而这种损伤往往无法通过不充分的韧性机制得到有效预防或修复。理解这些反应的协调为CVD的针对性预防和治疗提供了新的机会。

总之，本文强调了衰老相关的分子损伤在心血管疾病中的重要性，揭示了炎症与组织损伤之间的复杂关系，并为未来的研究和临床干预提供了新的视角。

items.title: Immune aging biomarkers for clinical trials.
items.body: Aging profoundly remodels the immune system, impairing defense, repair and homeostatic function across tissues. Because the immune system operates in every organ, its deterioration has been proposed to drive or exacerbate systemic dysfunction and accelerate overall biological aging, making it an attractive biomarker and target for geroscience-guided trials. Despite this central role, there is no consensus on how to quantify immune aging, especially in clinical trials. Here, we establish a translational framework to identify immune aging biomarkers for this purpose. We define five evaluation criteria for immune aging biomarkers and apply these to candidate biomarkers, discussing their utility in the context of a major international healthspan competition, XPRIZE Healthspan. Metrics encapsulating multidimensional aspects of immune function, inflammaging scores and functional assays performed best against our selection criteria. Finally, we identify promising emerging measures, together with critical gaps that must be addressed to develop reliable, predictive biomarkers of human immune competence. Our framework provides a coherent path toward actionable and clinically meaningful immune aging biomarkers capable of quantifying immune fitness and resilience, and accelerating the clinical translation of geroscience-guided interventions.
items.authors: Cipriano A, Justice J, Poganik JR, Moqri M, Abudayyeh OO, Gootenberg J, Haynes L, Levin Y, Martin-Herranz DE, Akbar AN, Mannick J, Pawelec G, Shen-Orr SS, Tsang J, Wagner W, Merad M, Gnjatic S, Gellhorn A, Corley MJ, Kuc

items.title_zh: 免疫衰老生物标志物在临床试验中的应用
items.summary_zh: 衰老显著重塑免疫系统，损害组织的防御、修复和稳态功能。由于免疫系统在每个器官中发挥作用，其衰退被认为会驱动或加剧全身性功能障碍，并加速整体生物衰老，因此成为老年科学（geroscience）指导试验的有吸引力的生物标志物和目标。尽管免疫衰老在这一过程中扮演重要角色，但在临床试验中如何量化免疫衰老尚无共识。本文建立了一个转化框架，以识别免疫衰老生物标志物，定义了五个评估标准，并将其应用于候选生物标志物，探讨其在国际健康寿命竞赛XPRIZE Healthspan中的实用性。多维免疫功能指标、炎症衰老评分和功能测定在我们的选择标准中表现最佳。最后，识别出有前景的新兴测量方法及需解决的关键缺口，以开发可靠的预测人类免疫能力的生物标志物。我们的框架为量化免疫健康和韧性、加速老年科学指导干预的临床转化提供了清晰路径。
items.l1_lead: 免疫衰老显著影响整体生物衰老，本文提出了一个框架以识别和量化免疫衰老生物标志物，为老年科学的临床应用提供了新路径。
items.l2_summary:
免疫衰老（immune aging）显著改变了免疫系统的功能，损害了组织的防御、修复和稳态能力。由于免疫系统在各个器官中发挥着重要作用，其衰退被认为是导致全身性功能障碍的关键因素，并加速整体生物衰老。因此，免疫衰老成为老年科学（geroscience）中一个有吸引力的生物标志物和研究目标。然而，目前在临床试验中如何量化免疫衰老尚无统一的共识。为了解决这一问题，本文建立了一个转化框架，旨在识别免疫衰老的生物标志物，并定义了五个评估标准，以此为基础对候选生物标志物进行评估，探讨其在国际健康寿命竞赛XPRIZE Healthspan中的实际应用。

在我们的评估标准中，多维免疫功能指标、炎症衰老评分和功能测定表现出最佳的选择性。这些指标能够有效反映免疫系统的健康状态和功能衰退程度。通过对这些生物标志物的深入分析，研究识别出了一些有前景的新兴测量方法，同时也指出了当前研究中存在的关键缺口。这些缺口的解决将有助于开发出更为可靠的生物标志物，以预测人类的免疫能力。

总的来说，本文的框架为量化免疫健康和韧性提供了清晰的路径，并为加速老年科学指导干预的临床转化奠定了基础。这一研究不仅为免疫衰老的理解提供了新的视角，也为未来的临床试验设计和干预措施的制定提供了重要参考。

items.title: Translating ferroptosis into oncology: challenges, opportunities and future directions.
items.body: Ferroptosis is an oxidative, lipid peroxidation-driven form of regulated cell death that occurs when antioxidant and organelle-protective systems are compromised. Increasing evidence implicates ferroptosis as a process that can exert both tumour-suppressive and tumour-promoting effects depending on cellular context at multiple stages of cancer evolution (from tumour initiation to metastatic colonization), sparking substantial interest in therapeutically exploiting this mechanism of cell death. Yet, despite rapid preclinical progress, clinical translation of ferroptosis-based strategies remains nascent. In this Review, we examine the major barriers to translation, including pharmacological limitations, tumour-intrinsic heterogeneity, microenvironmental and immune constraints, and gaps in current preclinical modelling. We also highlight emerging opportunities such as new ferroptosis-inducing agents, biomarker-guided patient selection and rational combinations with chemotherapy, radiotherapy, targeted agents or immunotherapies. Finally, we outline a translational roadmap for integrating ferroptosis-based therapies into oncology practice. By defining key challenges and future directions, this Review aims to position ferroptosis as a viable therapeutic paradigm and to accelerate progress towards clinical application.
items.authors: Kang R, Liu J, Wang J, Kroemer G, Tang D.
items.title_zh: 将铁死亡转化为肿瘤学的挑战与机遇
items.summary_zh: 铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由氧化和脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡形式，发生在抗氧化和细胞器保护系统受损时。越来越多的证据表明，铁死亡在癌症演变的多个阶段（从肿瘤启动到转移性殖民）中，可能发挥抑制肿瘤或促进肿瘤的作用，这引发了对利用这一细胞死亡机制的治疗潜力的浓厚兴趣。然而，尽管在临床前研究中取得了快速进展，基于铁死亡的临床转化仍处于初期阶段。本文评估了转化过程中的主要障碍，包括药物限制、肿瘤内在异质性、微环境和免疫限制，以及当前临床前模型的不足。同时，强调了新型铁死亡诱导剂、基于生物标志物的患者选择以及与化疗、放疗、靶向药物或免疫疗法的合理组合等新兴机遇。最后，提出了将基于铁死亡的疗法整合到肿瘤学实践中的转化路线图。通过明确关键挑战和未来方向，本文旨在将铁死亡定位为一种可行的治疗范式，并加速其临床应用的进展。
items.l1_lead: 铁死亡在癌症发展中可能具有双重作用，尽管临床转化仍面临多重挑战，但其作为治疗新策略的潜力值得深入探索。
items.l2_summary:
铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由氧化和脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡形式，主要发生在抗氧化和细胞器保护系统受损的情况下。近年来，越来越多的研究表明，铁死亡在癌症的多个发展阶段中可能发挥着复杂的作用，既可能抑制肿瘤的形成，也可能促进肿瘤的转移。这一发现引发了对利用铁死亡机制进行癌症治疗的浓厚兴趣。然而，尽管在临床前研究中取得了一定的进展，基于铁死亡的临床转化仍处于初期阶段。

在转化过程中，存在多个主要障碍。首先，药物的限制使得有效诱导铁死亡的治疗手段尚未成熟。其次，肿瘤的内在异质性和微环境的复杂性使得不同患者对铁死亡诱导剂的反应存在显著差异。此外，免疫限制也可能影响铁死亡相关治疗的效果。当前的临床前模型在模拟真实肿瘤环境方面存在不足，进一步限制了研究成果的临床应用。

尽管面临这些挑战，仍然存在许多新兴的机遇。例如，开发新型铁死亡诱导剂、基于生物标志物的患者选择策略，以及与化疗、放疗、靶向药物或免疫疗法的合理组合，都为铁死亡的临床应用提供了新的可能性。通过整合这些策略，研究者们希望能够将基于铁死亡的疗法有效地纳入肿瘤学实践中。

综上所述，本文旨在明确铁死亡在肿瘤治疗中的潜力，评估其转化过程中的关键挑战，并提出未来的研究方向，以加速其临床应用的进展。通过深入理解铁死亡的机制及其在肿瘤中的作用，科学界有望将其发展为一种可行的治疗范式，为癌症患者提供新的治疗选择。

items.title: Pro-aging effects of chronic glucocorticoid signaling.
items.body: Glucocorticoids (GCs) are essential endocrine regulators coordinating stress responsiveness, metabolic flexibility, inflammatory resolution, and circadian physiology. While acute GC fluctuations are adaptive, sustained exposure (arising from psychosocial stress, circadian disruption, obesity, chronic inflammation, neoplasms, or steroid therapy) elicits pleiotropic effects that overlap with biological aging. Prolonged GC signaling intersects with multiple hallmarks of aging by altering nutrient sensing, suppressing autophagy, impairing mitochondrial quality control, and promoting cellular senescence. In this context, the GC-responsive polypeptide ACBP/DBI (acyl-coenzyme A [CoA]-binding protein/diazepam-binding inhibitor) has emerged as a stress-induced inhibitor of macroautophagy that amplifies several metabolic and immune consequences of GC excess linked to aging phenotypes. Clinically, chronic GC elevation is associated with earlier and more severe manifestations of age-related diseases, including metabolic syndrome, osteoporosis, sarcopenia, neurodegeneration, cardiovascular disease, immunosenescence, and cancer. Here, we review mechanistic links between GC signaling and systemic aging and discuss strategies to mitigate the age-accelerating consequences of persistent GC exposure.
items.authors: Lambertucci F, Castinetti F, Martins I, López-Otín C, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 慢性糖皮质激素信号的促衰老效应
items.summary_zh: 糖皮质激素（GCs）是调节压力反应、代谢灵活性、炎症解决和昼夜生理的重要内分泌因子。虽然急性GC波动具有适应性，但持续暴露（由心理社会压力、昼夜节律紊乱、肥胖、慢性炎症、肿瘤或类固醇治疗引起）会产生与生物衰老重叠的多重效应。长期GC信号通过改变营养感知、抑制自噬、损害线粒体质量控制和促进细胞衰老，影响衰老的多个标志。GC反应性多肽ACBP/DBI（酰基辅酶A结合蛋白/地西泮结合抑制剂）作为一种应激诱导的巨自噬抑制因子，放大了与衰老表型相关的GC过量的代谢和免疫后果。临床上，慢性GC升高与代谢综合征、骨质疏松、肌肉减少、神经退行性疾病、心血管疾病、免疫衰老和癌症等年龄相关疾病的早期和严重表现相关。本文回顾了GC信号与系统性衰老之间的机制联系，并讨论了减轻持续GC暴露加速衰老后果的策略。
items.l1_lead: 慢性糖皮质激素信号通过影响营养感知和细胞功能，促进衰老相关疾病的发生，揭示了其与生物衰老的密切关系。
items.l2_summary:
糖皮质激素（GCs）是调节压力反应、代谢灵活性、炎症解决和昼夜生理的重要内分泌因子。尽管急性GC波动具有适应性，但持续暴露于GCs（如因心理社会压力、昼夜节律紊乱、肥胖、慢性炎症、肿瘤或类固醇治疗引起）会导致与生物衰老相关的多重效应。长期的GC信号通过改变营养感知、抑制自噬、损害线粒体质量控制和促进细胞衰老，显著影响衰老的多个标志。

研究表明，GC反应性多肽ACBP/DBI（酰基辅酶A结合蛋白/地西泮结合抑制剂）作为一种应激诱导的巨自噬抑制因子，能够放大与衰老表型相关的GC过量的代谢和免疫后果。这一机制的影响在临床上表现为慢性GC升高与多种年龄相关疾病的早期和严重表现密切相关，包括代谢综合征、骨质疏松、肌肉减少、神经退行性疾病、心血管疾病、免疫衰老和癌症等。

本文回顾了GC信号与系统性衰老之间的机制联系，强调了持续GC暴露对衰老过程的加速作用，并讨论了减轻这一影响的潜在策略。这些策略可能为改善与衰老相关的健康问题提供新的思路，帮助我们更好地理解和应对慢性糖皮质激素信号对衰老的促效应。

items.title: Immunobiological mechanisms of action of oncolytic peptides.
items.body: Oncolytic peptides (OLPs) constitute an emerging class of immunotherapeutics that combine direct cancer cell lysis with immune activation. Indeed, OLPs induce rapid immunogenic cell death by disrupting intracellular membranes, which culminates with the abundant release of malignant cell contents including immunostimulatory danger-associated molecular patterns. This results in the engagement of innate immune sensors that potently activate dendritic cells, leading to the cross-priming of tumor-specific T lymphocytes that mediate systemic anticancer immunity. Through such a dual mechanism, OLPs can remodel the tumor microenvironment and overcome resistance to therapy as promoted by intratumoral heterogeneity, hence representing optimal combinatorial partners for immune checkpoint inhibitors. Some OLPs have also shown remarkable clinical efficacy. For instance, LTX-315 (studied as VP-315 in basal cell carcinoma (BCC)) has recently been shown to enable complete and durable responses in patients with BCC, and emerging evidence points to a significant activity of LTX-315 in immunologically cold tumors. Here, we summarize recent mechanistic, preclinical, and clinical advances in OLP development, underscoring their potential as a versatile and powerful modality of cancer immunotherapy.
items.authors: Kepp O, Deng X, Xue E, Sveinbjørnsson B, Rekdal Ø, Galluzzi L, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 肿瘤溶解肽的免疫生物学作用机制
items.summary_zh: 肿瘤溶解肽（Oncolytic peptides, OLPs）是一类新兴的免疫治疗药物，结合了直接癌细胞溶解与免疫激活的功能。OLPs通过破坏细胞内膜诱导快速的免疫原性细胞死亡，释放出包括免疫刺激性危险相关分子模式在内的恶性细胞内容物。这一过程激活了先天免疫传感器，强效激活树突状细胞，促进肿瘤特异性T淋巴细胞的交叉激活，从而介导系统性的抗癌免疫。通过这种双重机制，OLPs能够重塑肿瘤微环境，克服由肿瘤内异质性引起的治疗抵抗，成为免疫检查点抑制剂的理想联合伙伴。一些OLPs在临床上也显示出显著的疗效，例如LTX-315（在基底细胞癌中研究为VP-315）已被证明能在患者中实现完全和持久的反应，且在免疫冷肿瘤中显示出显著活性。本文总结了OLP开发的最新机制、临床前和临床进展，强调其作为癌症免疫治疗的多功能和强大手段的潜力。
items.l1_lead: 肿瘤溶解肽通过诱导免疫原性细胞死亡和激活免疫系统，展现出作为癌症免疫治疗新兴药物的强大潜力。
items.l2_summary:
肿瘤溶解肽（Oncolytic peptides, OLPs）是一类新兴的免疫治疗药物，具有直接溶解癌细胞和激活免疫系统的双重功能。OLPs通过破坏细胞内膜，诱导快速的免疫原性细胞死亡，释放出包括免疫刺激性危险相关分子模式在内的恶性细胞内容物。这一过程能够有效激活先天免疫传感器，强效激活树突状细胞，并促进肿瘤特异性T淋巴细胞的交叉激活，从而介导系统性的抗癌免疫反应。通过这种机制，OLPs不仅能够重塑肿瘤微环境，还能克服由肿瘤内异质性引起的治疗抵抗，使其成为免疫检查点抑制剂的理想联合治疗伙伴。

在临床研究中，一些OLPs显示出显著的疗效。例如，LTX-315（在基底细胞癌研究中称为VP-315）已被证明能够在患者中实现完全和持久的反应，并且在免疫冷肿瘤中展现出显著的活性。这些研究结果表明，OLPs在癌症免疫治疗中具有多功能和强大的潜力，能够为患者提供新的治疗选择。本文总结了OLPs开发的最新机制、临床前和临床进展，强调了其在癌症免疫治疗中的重要性和应用前景。通过深入研究OLPs的作用机制及其临床效果，未来有望进一步推动癌症治疗的创新与发展。

items.title: Progress, challenges, and opportunities in the field of biosynthetic reactions involving ambimodal transition states.
items.body: Covering: up to June 2025High selectivity is generally observed in the biosynthesis of complex natural molecules. Evolution usually leads to enzymes that favor the formation of a particular isomer rather than one of the many other potential molecules. Recent discoveries of enzymes with multiple sequential post-transition state bifurcations (PTSB) after ambimodal transition states demonstrate the impact of dynamics on selectivity. PTSB cause a single ambimodal transition state (TS) to form multiple products. This is different from conventional energetically-controlled mechanisms, where two discrete transition states have different energy barriers. Selectivity arising from ambimodal TSs cannot be fully explained by transition state theory. The presence of PTSB on enzyme catalyzed reaction surfaces has been discovered recently at a significantly higher rate. For both uncatalyzed and catalyzed reactions, computational chemists are devising techniques to comprehend which elements of molecular structure and vibrations govern the product selectivity in systems that contain bifurcations. This review describes enzyme-catalyzed reactions involving ambimodal transition states, and recent advances in understanding how enzymes control selectivity in such reactions.
items.authors: Hussain H, Houk KN, Lam CC, Sarker SD, Nahar L.
items.title_zh: 生物合成反应中双模态过渡态的进展与挑战
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了生物合成复杂天然分子过程中双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）相关的酶催化反应。研究表明，进化通常导致酶偏向于形成特定异构体，而非众多其他潜在分子。近期发现的多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）现象，揭示了动态对选择性的影响，单一的双模态过渡态可以生成多个产物，这与传统的能量控制机制不同。双模态过渡态产生的选择性无法完全用过渡态理论解释。计算化学家正在开发技术，以理解在包含分叉的系统中，分子结构和振动的哪些元素主导产物选择性。本文总结了酶催化反应中双模态过渡态的最新进展，以及酶如何控制这些反应中的选择性。
items.l1_lead: 本文总结了双模态过渡态在酶催化反应中的最新进展，揭示其对产物选择性的影响及传统理论的局限性。
items.l2_summary:
本文评述了生物合成复杂天然分子过程中双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）相关的酶催化反应，探讨了其在选择性控制中的重要性。研究表明，酶的进化通常使其偏向于生成特定的异构体，而非众多其他潜在分子，这一现象反映了酶在催化反应中的选择性。近期的研究发现了多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）现象，揭示了动态因素对选择性的影响。具体而言，单一的双模态过渡态可以生成多个产物，这与传统的能量控制机制存在显著差异，后者通常认为反应产物的选择性主要由能量障碍决定。

然而，双模态过渡态所产生的选择性并不能完全用过渡态理论来解释，这提示我们需要更深入的理解。在这一背景下，计算化学家正在开发新的技术，以探究在包含分叉的系统中，哪些分子结构和振动元素主导了产物的选择性。这一研究方向不仅为理解酶催化反应提供了新的视角，也为天然产物的合成和设计提供了潜在的应用前景。

综上所述，双模态过渡态的研究为我们揭示了酶催化反应中选择性控制的复杂性和多样性，尽管目前仍面临许多挑战，但其进展为未来的研究和应用奠定了基础。

items.title: Hierarchical endpoints and win statistics for geromedicine trials.
items.body: Geroscience has advanced rapidly, yet its clinical translation remains limited. A central barrier is the lack of trial outcomes that capture the multidimensional effects of geroprotective interventions while meeting clinical and regulatory standards. Mortality is objective and regulatorily salient but often impractical. By contrast, surrogate measures of healthspan improve feasibility and may better reflect the quality of extended life, but they are generally considered soft endpoints that require further validation. Here, we propose hierarchical composite endpoints using time-to-worst-event analysis as a pragmatic and scientifically sound compromise. Participant pairs are compared using win statistics according to a prespecified clinical hierarchy, in which more severe and objective clinical events are prioritized, while health surrogates and biomarkers contribute information at lower tiers. When outcome selection, ordering and tie rules are clinically and mechanistically justified and agreed with regulators, this approach may improve geromedicine trial efficiency and allow overall treatment effects to be captured without compromising clinical priorities.
items.authors: Abdellatif M, Kim Y, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 老年医学试验的分层终点与胜利统计
items.summary_zh: 老年科学（Geroscience）发展迅速，但其临床转化仍受限，主要障碍在于缺乏能够捕捉老年保护干预多维效果的试验结果，同时满足临床和监管标准。虽然死亡率是客观且符合监管要求的指标，但往往不切实际。相比之下，健康寿命（healthspan）的替代性指标提高了可行性，可能更好地反映延长生命的质量，但通常被视为需要进一步验证的软终点。本文提出使用时间到最坏事件分析的分层复合终点，作为务实且科学合理的折中方案。通过预设的临床层级比较参与者对，优先考虑更严重和客观的临床事件，而健康替代指标和生物标志物则在较低层级提供信息。当结果选择、排序和平局规则在临床和机制上得到合理化并与监管机构达成一致时，该方法可能提高老年医学试验的效率，并在不妥协临床优先级的情况下捕捉整体治疗效果。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出通过分层复合终点分析，优化老年医学试验设计，以更有效地评估干预措施对健康寿命的影响，同时满足临床和监管要求。
items.l2_summary:
老年科学（Geroscience）近年来发展迅速，但其临床转化面临诸多挑战，主要障碍在于缺乏能够全面反映老年保护干预多维效果的试验结果，同时又能满足临床和监管标准。尽管死亡率是一个客观且符合监管要求的指标，但在实际应用中往往不够切合实际。相较之下，健康寿命（healthspan）作为一种替代性指标，能够更好地反映延长生命的质量，然而通常被视为需要进一步验证的软终点。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种使用时间到最坏事件分析的分层复合终点的方法，作为一种务实且科学合理的折中方案。

该方法通过预设的临床层级来比较参与者，优先考虑更严重和客观的临床事件，同时在较低层级提供健康替代指标和生物标志物的信息。这种分层结构不仅能够提高老年医学试验的效率，还能在不妥协临床优先级的情况下，更全面地捕捉整体治疗效果。当结果选择、排序和平局规则在临床和机制上得到合理化，并与监管机构达成一致时，该方法的有效性将进一步得到验证。

总的来说，采用分层复合终点的策略，能够在老年医学试验中更有效地平衡临床需求与监管要求，从而推动老年科学的临床转化进程。这一方法的实施，有望为老年医学领域带来新的突破，促进对老年人群体健康的更深入理解和干预。

items.title: Trial watch: antibody-drug conjugates in cancer therapy.
items.body: Antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) combine the target specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the cytotoxic potency of small-molecule payloads. In recent years ADCs have emerged as a clinically validated component of modern precision oncology. To date, more than a dozen ADCs have received FDA approval for oncologic indications, with additional agents approved regionally and hundreds of ADC-based regimens in clinical development. Collectively, these therapies have demonstrated clinical benefit across hematologic malignancies and solid tumors, including significant overall survival improvements in advanced phase clinical trials. In this Trial Watch, we provide an overview on available ADCs from early preclinical development to current clinical applications. We also summarize design principles underpinning clinically successful ADCs, including epitope targeting, linker chemistry, payload toxicity and drug-to-antibody ratio, and discuss how these features can influence pharmacokinetics, intracellular trafficking, bystander effect and toxicity. Finally, we discuss results from advanced-stage clinical trials and approved agents to define future directions.
items.authors: Doffe F, Deng X, Shen Z, Xue E, Schauer K, Kroemer G, Kepp O.
items.title_zh: 抗体药物偶联物在癌症治疗中的应用前景
items.summary_zh: 抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）将单克隆抗体的靶向特性与小分子药物的细胞毒性结合在一起，近年来已成为现代精准肿瘤学的临床验证组成部分。目前，已有十多种ADCs获得FDA批准用于肿瘤治疗，此外还有区域性批准的药物和数百种基于ADCs的治疗方案正在临床开发中。这些疗法在血液恶性肿瘤和实体瘤中均显示出临床益处，包括在晚期临床试验中显著改善的总体生存率。本文回顾了从早期临床前开发到当前临床应用的ADCs，并总结了成功ADCs的设计原则，如表位靶向、连接子化学、药物毒性和药物与抗体比率，讨论了这些特征如何影响药代动力学、细胞内运输、旁观者效应和毒性。最后，文章探讨了晚期临床试验的结果和已批准药物，以明确未来的发展方向。
items.l1_lead: 抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）结合靶向特性与细胞毒性，已在癌症治疗中展现出显著临床益处，未来发展前景广阔。
items.l2_summary:
抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）是将单克隆抗体的靶向特性与小分子药物的细胞毒性相结合的一种新型治疗策略，近年来在现代精准肿瘤学中得到了广泛应用，成为临床验证的重要组成部分。目前，已有十多种ADCs获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的批准用于肿瘤治疗，此外，还有一些区域性批准的药物和数百种基于ADCs的治疗方案正在进行临床开发。这些疗法在血液恶性肿瘤和实体瘤中均显示出显著的临床益处，尤其是在晚期临床试验中，ADCs显著改善了患者的总体生存率。

本文回顾了ADCs从早期临床前开发到当前临床应用的历程，并总结了成功ADCs的设计原则。这些设计原则包括表位靶向、连接子化学、药物毒性以及药物与抗体的比率等，这些特征对药代动力学、细胞内运输、旁观者效应和毒性等方面有着重要影响。通过合理的设计，ADCs能够有效地将药物精准送达肿瘤细胞，从而提高治疗效果并降低对正常细胞的损伤。

最后，文章探讨了晚期临床试验的结果和已批准药物的表现，以明确未来ADCs的发展方向。随着对ADCs机制的深入理解和技术的不断进步，预计未来将有更多的ADCs进入临床应用，为癌症患者提供更为有效的治疗选择。总体而言，ADCs在癌症治疗中的应用前景广阔，具有显著的临床价值和发展潜力。

items.title: Comparison between accelerated and standard or sham rTMS in the treatment of depression: A systematic review.
items.body: Major depressive disorder (MDD) represents a major global health challenge, with a significant proportion of patients being resistant to drug treatment (TRD). Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has shown promise in the treatment of MDD/TRD, with a single stimulation session per day for five days per week over several weeks (the "standard" protocol). The two main paradigms used are high-frequency rTMS and intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) delivered to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Accelerated TMS (aTMS) protocols aim to make the treatment more effective, or at least more rapidly effective, by delivering more stimulations in a shorter time, which could also facilitate the implementation of the protocols for a larger number of patients. In this systematic literature review, articles comparing in the same study an aTMS protocol to a standard or sham rTMS protocol were retained for analysis. Thus, 23 articles were retained and the analysis focused on the efficacy of aTMS protocols used for the treatment of depression (MDD/TRD) as well as on the impact of various stimulation parameters, such as stimulation pattern, intersession interval, dosage, and methods of cortical targeting. Although some studies did not report significant differences between aTMS and standard or sham protocols, others suggested potential advantages of aTMS, such as twice-daily HF-rTMS of the left DLPFC or more intensive iTBS protocols with a long interval between two sessions and personalized cortical targeting. Our results highlight the influence of the number of sessions or pulses per session (dosage), the duration of the interval between sessions, and the precision of target localization (using image-guided neuronavigation) on therapeutic efficacy. However, limitations in sample size, few independent studies replicating the same methodology, and variability in the clinical profile of treated patients, given different definitions of treatment resistance or the presence of comorbidities, hamper definitive conclusions.
items.authors: Lefaucheur JP, Colzi C, Hollander E, Pampaloni I, Van Ameringen M, Baeken C, Fusar-Poli P, Arango C, Fontenelle LF, Batail JM, Brunoni AR, Nicolini H, Haffen E, Soriano-Mas C, Rodriguez CI, Dell'Osso BM, Vieta E, Sauvage
