items.title_zh: 加速与标准或假刺激rTMS治疗抑郁症的比较：系统评估
items.summary_zh: 重度抑郁障碍（MDD）是全球健康的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗（TRD）产生耐药性。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）在MDD/TRD的治疗中显示出希望，标准方案为每周五天每天一次的刺激。主要使用的两种模式是高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS），针对左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。加速TMS（aTMS）方案旨在通过在更短时间内提供更多刺激，提高治疗效果或加快效果。本文系统评估了比较aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS的研究，共纳入23篇文章，分析了aTMS在抑郁症治疗中的有效性及刺激参数的影响。尽管部分研究未显示aTMS与标准或假刺激之间的显著差异，但其他研究提出了aTMS的潜在优势。
items.l1_lead: 加速TMS在抑郁症治疗中显示出潜在优势，尽管部分研究未发现其与标准或假刺激之间的显著差异。
items.l2_summary:
重度抑郁障碍（MDD）是全球健康面临的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗产生耐药性（TRD）。在此背景下，重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）作为一种新兴的治疗方法，显示出对MDD/TRD患者的治疗潜力。标准的rTMS治疗方案通常为每周五天、每天一次，主要采用高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS），针对左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。为了提高治疗效果或加快效果，加速TMS（aTMS）方案应运而生，旨在在更短的时间内提供更多的刺激。

本文对aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS的研究进行了系统评估，共纳入了23篇相关文献，分析了aTMS在抑郁症治疗中的有效性及其刺激参数的影响。尽管部分研究未能显示aTMS与标准或假刺激之间存在显著差异，但也有研究提出了aTMS的潜在优势，暗示其可能在某些情况下提供更好的治疗效果。这些研究结果表明，尽管目前的证据尚不完全一致，但aTMS在抑郁症治疗中的应用仍值得进一步探索。

总体而言，aTMS作为一种新兴的治疗策略，可能为重度抑郁障碍患者提供新的希望，尤其是对于那些对传统药物治疗反应不佳的患者。未来的研究需要进一步明确aTMS的有效性及其最佳刺激参数，以便为临床实践提供更为坚实的依据。

items.title: Executive functioning in adolescents with internalizing disorders: a systematic review.
items.body: Internalizing disorders (INTs), including anxiety (AD) and depressive disorders (DD), frequently emerge during adolescence. Studies suggest that certain core domains of executive functioning (EF), i.e. inhibition, shifting and working memory (WM) may show selectively lower performance in certain INTs. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the evidence of associations between INTs and EF in adolescents. A systematic search was conducted in Medline, Psych-INFO, Scopus, and Web of Science in May 2023. Inclusion focused on adolescents (12-17) with AD (including obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)) or DD. After screening 2,551 titles/abstracts, 818 records underwent full-text review, on which independent reviewers reached 93% agreement on eligibility. EF parameters, measured through task-performance or ratings, were extracted from 32 eligible articles published since 2014. Performance-based EF differences were reported in 22 studies, most frequently in adolescents with DD. Task-based inhibition showed lower scores most consistently in DD (n = 5). Findings were mixed across other INTs. Three studies found evidence for improved inhibition performance in OCD (n = 2) and AD (n = 1). Finally, 6 studies reporting on self- or parent-rated EF found significant difficulties across EF domains, of which 3 contrasted with intact performances on task-based measurements of EF. Findings suggest both objective and subjective EF difficulties across INTs with no conclusive evidence for selective domain-specific differences. We highlight a discrepancy between subjectively experienced or observed deficits in daily EF and performance on structured tasks. This suggests that rating-based EF may be more sensitive for capturing subtle EF difficulties and therefore adds value in research and clinical settings. Finally, the quality of studies is discussed and directions for future studies are identified, namely, the use of both task and rating-based measures of EF as well as inclusion of larger sample sizes.
items.authors: Fontaine GP, Blake KV, Koen N, Stein DJ, Hammar Å, Groenewold NA.
items.title_zh: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能的系统评估
items.summary_zh: 内化障碍（INTs），如焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD），常在青少年时期出现。本系统评估旨在探讨青少年内化障碍与执行功能（EF）之间的关联。研究通过在Medline、Psych-INFO、Scopus和Web of Science进行系统检索，纳入了2014年以来的32篇符合条件的文章，重点关注12至17岁有AD（包括强迫症（OCD）和创伤后应激障碍（PTSD））或DD的青少年。结果显示，在22项研究中，DD青少年在任务表现上表现出较低的EF，尤其在任务基础的抑制能力上（n = 5）。其他内化障碍的结果则较为混杂。有三项研究发现OCD（n = 2）和AD（n = 1）在抑制表现上有所改善。此外，6项研究报告了自评或父母评定的EF，显示在EF各领域存在显著困难，其中3项与任务表现良好相对立。
items.l1_lead: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能存在显著关联，尤其抑郁障碍患者在执行任务时表现出较低的执行功能，反映出其在抑制能力方面的困难。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在系统评估青少年内化障碍（INTs）与执行功能（EF）之间的关系，特别关注焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD）。内化障碍在青少年中普遍存在，尤其是在12至17岁这一年龄段。研究通过在Medline、Psych-INFO、Scopus和Web of Science等数据库中进行系统检索，纳入了自2014年以来的32篇符合条件的文章，重点分析有AD（包括强迫症（OCD）和创伤后应激障碍（PTSD））或DD的青少年。

结果显示，在22项研究中，DD青少年在执行功能任务表现上普遍较低，尤其是在任务基础的抑制能力方面（n = 5）。这表明抑制能力的不足可能是DD青少年面临的主要挑战之一。尽管其他内化障碍的研究结果较为混杂，但有三项研究指出OCD（n = 2）和AD（n = 1）在抑制表现上有所改善，提示某些情况下，青少年可能在特定的执行功能任务中表现出积极的变化。

此外，研究还分析了自评或父母评定的执行功能，结果显示在EF的各个领域存在显著困难，其中有三项研究的结果与任务表现良好的情况相对立。这表明，尽管在某些任务中青少年可能表现良好，但在自我评估或他人评估中却显示出明显的执行功能障碍。

综上所述，青少年内化障碍与执行功能之间存在复杂的关系，尤其是抑郁障碍与执行功能的低下密切相关，而焦虑障碍和强迫症在某些情况下可能表现出改善。该研究为理解青少年内化障碍的影响提供了重要的实证依据，并为未来的干预措施提供了参考。

items.title: A whole-brain voxel-based analysis of structural abnormalities in PTSD: An ENIGMA-PGC study.
items.body: Background Patients with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) exhibit smaller regional brain volumes in commonly reported regions including the amygdala and hippocampus, regions associated with fear and memory processing. In the current study, we have conducted a voxel-based morphometry (VBM) meta-analysis using whole-brain statistical maps with neuroimaging data from the ENIGMA-PGC PTSD working group. Methods T1-weighted structural neuroimaging scans from 36 cohorts (PTSD n = 1309; controls n = 2198) were processed using a standardized VBM pipeline (ENIGMA-VBM tool). We meta-analyzed the resulting statistical maps for voxel-wise differences in gray matter (GM) and white matter (WM) volumes between PTSD patients and controls, performed subgroup analyses considering the trauma exposure of the controls, and examined associations between regional brain volumes and clinical variables including PTSD (CAPS-4/5, PCL-5) and depression severity (BDI-II, PHQ-9). Results PTSD patients exhibited smaller GM volumes across the frontal and temporal lobes, and cerebellum, with the most significant effect in the left cerebellum (Hedges' g = 0.22, p corrected = .001), and smaller cerebellar WM volume (peak Hedges' g = 0.14, p corrected = .008). We observed similar regional differences when comparing patients to trauma-exposed controls, suggesting these structural abnormalities may be specific to PTSD. Regression analyses revealed PTSD severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum ( p corrected = .003), while depression severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum and superior frontal gyrus in patients ( p corrected = .001). Conclusions PTSD patients exhibited widespread, regional differences in brain volumes where greater regional deficits appeared to reflect more severe symptoms. Our findings add to the growing literature implicating the cerebellum in PTSD psychopathology.

items.title_zh: 全脑体素基础的PTSD结构异常分析：ENIGMA-PGC研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了全脑体素基础的形态学元分析。研究发现，PTSD患者在前额叶、颞叶及小脑等区域的灰质（GM）体积显著较小，尤其在左小脑的影响最为显著（Hedges' g = 0.22, p 校正 = .001），同时小脑的白质（WM）体积也较小（峰值 Hedges' g = 0.14, p 校正 = .008）。通过与经历过创伤的对照组进行比较，观察到类似的区域差异，提示这些结构异常可能特定于PTSD患者。该研究使用了来自36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像数据，分析了PTSD患者与对照组在灰质和白质体积上的体素差异，并探讨了区域脑体积与临床变量（如PTSD和抑郁严重程度）之间的关联。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者在前额叶、颞叶及小脑等区域的灰质和白质体积显著较小，提示这些结构异常可能特定于PTSD患者。
items.l2_summary:
本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了全脑体素基础的形态学元分析，旨在揭示PTSD患者在脑部结构上的特征性变化。研究结果显示，PTSD患者在前额叶、颞叶及小脑等关键区域的灰质（GM）体积显著较小，尤其是在左小脑的灰质体积差异最为显著，Hedges' g值为0.22，校正后的p值为0.001。此外，小脑的白质（WM）体积也显示出显著减少，峰值Hedges' g为0.14，校正后的p值为0.008。这些发现通过与经历过创伤的对照组进行比较，进一步确认了PTSD患者在这些特定脑区的结构异常，提示这些变化可能是PTSD的特征性标志。

本研究使用了来自36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像数据，系统分析了PTSD患者与对照组在灰质和白质体积上的体素差异，并探讨了区域脑体积与临床变量（如PTSD和抑郁严重程度）之间的关联。这些结果为理解PTSD的神经生物学基础提供了重要的结构性证据，强调了小脑在PTSD发病机制中的潜在作用。总的来说，该研究不仅揭示了PTSD患者脑结构的特征性变化，还为未来的干预和治疗策略提供了新的思路。

items.title: The meltdown pathway: A multidisciplinary account of autistic meltdowns.
items.body: Autistic meltdowns are fits of intense frustration and often physical violence elicited by sensory and cognitive stressors. Despite the high prevalence of meltdowns among autistic individuals, the neural mechanisms that underlie this response are not yet well understood. This has thus far hampered progress toward a dedicated therapeutic intervention-beyond traditional medications-that limits their frequency and severity. Here, we aim to initiate an interdisciplinary dialogue on the etiology of sensory meltdowns. In doing so, we frame meltdowns as a consequence of underlying chronic hypervigilance and acute hyperreactivity to objectively benign stressors driven by differences in the insular cortex-a multimodal integration hub that adapts autonomic state and behavior to meet environmental demands. We first discuss meltdowns through the lens of neurophysiology and argue that intrainsular hypoconnectivity engenders vagal withdrawal and sympathetic hyperarousal in autism, driving chronic hypervigilance and reducing the threshold of stressors those with autism can tolerate before experiencing a meltdown. Next, we turn to neuropsychology and present evidence that meltdowns reflect a difference in how contextual evidence, particularly social cues, is integrated when acutely assessing ambiguous signs of danger in the environment-a process termed neuroception. Finally, we build on contemporary predictive coding accounts of autism to argue that meltdowns may be ultimately driven by differences in sensory attenuation and coherent deep inference within the interoceptive hierarchy, possibly linked to oxytocin deficiency during infancy. Throughout, we synthesize each perspective to construct a multidisciplinary, insula-based model of meltdowns. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2025 APA, all rights reserved).
items.authors: Soden PA, Bhat A, Anderson AK, Friston K.
items.title_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃的多学科探讨
items.summary_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃是由感官和认知压力引发的强烈挫败感和身体暴力表现。尽管在自闭症个体中情绪崩溃的发生率很高，但其神经机制尚不明确，这限制了针对性治疗的进展。本文旨在启动关于感官崩溃病因的跨学科对话。我们将情绪崩溃视为慢性过度警觉和对客观良性压力源的急性过度反应的结果，这与岛叶皮层（insular cortex）的差异有关。首先，从神经生理学角度讨论情绪崩溃，认为岛叶内连接不足导致自闭症中的迷走神经撤退和交感神经过度兴奋，进而驱动慢性过度警觉，降低自闭症个体对压力源的耐受阈值。接着，从神经心理学角度提供证据，表明情绪崩溃反映了在评估环境中模糊危险信号时，特别是社会线索的整合方式的差异，称为神经感知（neuroception）。
items.l1_lead: 自闭症情绪崩溃源于感官和认知压力引发的过度反应，涉及岛叶皮层的神经机制差异，需跨学科探讨其病因与治疗。
items.l2_summary:
自闭症情绪崩溃是一种由感官和认知压力引发的强烈挫败感和身体暴力表现，尽管在自闭症个体中情绪崩溃的发生率较高，但其神经机制仍不明确，这限制了针对性治疗的进展。本文旨在启动关于感官崩溃病因的跨学科对话，将情绪崩溃视为慢性过度警觉与对客观良性压力源的急性过度反应的结果，认为这一现象与岛叶皮层（insular cortex）的差异密切相关。

从神经生理学的角度来看，情绪崩溃的发生与岛叶内连接不足有关，这种不足导致自闭症个体出现迷走神经撤退和交感神经过度兴奋的现象，进而驱动慢性过度警觉。这种状态降低了自闭症个体对压力源的耐受阈值，使他们在面对压力时更容易产生情绪崩溃。此外，从神经心理学的角度，研究表明情绪崩溃反映了自闭症个体在评估环境中模糊危险信号时，特别是在整合社会线索方面的差异，这一现象被称为神经感知（neuroception）。

通过对情绪崩溃的多学科探讨，本文强调了理解自闭症个体情绪反应的重要性，并指出了未来研究的方向。情绪崩溃不仅是自闭症个体面临的挑战之一，也为我们提供了深入理解其神经机制和心理特征的机会。这一研究为制定更有效的干预措施奠定了基础，旨在帮助自闭症个体更好地应对情绪崩溃带来的困扰。

items.title: Active inference and cognitive control: Balancing deliberation and habits through precision optimization.
items.body: We advance a novel formulation of cognitive control within the active inference framework. The theory proposes that cognitive control amounts to optimising a precision parameter, which acts as a control signal and balances the contributions of deliberative and habitual components of action selection. To illustrate the theory, we simulate a driving scenario in which the driver follows a well-known route, but encounters unexpected challenges. Our simulations show that a standard active inference model can form adaptive habits; i.e., can pass from deliberative to habitual control when the context is stable, but generally fails to revert to deliberative control, when the context changes. To address this failure of context-sensitivity, we introduce a novel type of hierarchical active inference, in which a lower level is responsible for behavioural control and the higher (or meta-cognitive) level observes the belief updating of the lower level below and is responsible for cognitive control. Crucially, the meta-cognitive level can both form habits and suspend them, by controlling the (precision) parameter that prioritizes deliberative choices at the behavioural level. Furthermore, we show that several processes linked to cognitive control - such as surprise detection, cognitive conflict monitoring, control signal regulation and specification, the simulation of future outcomes and the assessment of the costs of control and mental effort - stem coherently from the free energy minimization scheme that underpins active inference. Finally, we discuss the putative neurobiology of cognitive control by simulating brain dynamics in the mesolimbic and mesocortical pathways of the dopamine system, the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex and the locus coeruleus.
items.authors: Proietti R, Parr T, Tessari A, Friston K, Pezzulo G.
items.title_zh: 主动推理与认知控制：通过精度优化平衡深思与习惯
items.summary_zh: 本文在主动推理（active inference）框架内提出了一种新的认知控制理论。该理论认为，认知控制的核心在于优化一个精度参数，该参数作为控制信号，平衡深思（deliberative）与习惯（habitual）在行动选择中的贡献。通过模拟驾驶场景，研究表明标准的主动推理模型能够形成适应性习惯，即在环境稳定时从深思转向习惯控制，但在环境变化时通常无法恢复到深思控制。为了解决这一上下文敏感性失败的问题，本文引入了一种新型的层级主动推理，其中低层负责行为控制，高层（或元认知）观察低层的信念更新并负责认知控制。关键在于，元认知层能够形成和暂停习惯，通过控制优先考虑深思选择的精度参数。此外，本文还展示了与认知控制相关的多个过程，如惊讶检测、认知冲突监测、控制信号调节与规范、未来结果的模拟等。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种新型的认知控制理论，通过优化精度参数，平衡深思与习惯的贡献，以应对环境变化带来的认知挑战。
items.l2_summary:
本文在主动推理（active inference）框架内提出了一种新的认知控制理论，强调认知控制的核心在于优化一个精度参数，该参数作为控制信号，旨在平衡深思（deliberative）与习惯（habitual）在行动选择中的贡献。通过模拟驾驶场景的实验，研究发现标准的主动推理模型能够在环境稳定时形成适应性习惯，即从深思转向习惯控制。然而，当环境发生变化时，该模型通常无法有效恢复到深思控制状态，这揭示了上下文敏感性失败的问题。

为了解决这一问题，本文引入了一种新型的层级主动推理模型，其中低层负责具体的行为控制，而高层（或元认知）则观察低层的信念更新并负责认知控制。元认知层的关键功能在于能够形成和暂停习惯，通过调节优先考虑深思选择的精度参数来实现对行动选择的优化。此外，研究还展示了与认知控制相关的多个过程，包括惊讶检测、认知冲突监测、控制信号的调节与规范，以及未来结果的模拟等。

这一理论的提出为理解认知控制提供了新的视角，强调了在不同环境条件下，如何通过精度优化来平衡深思与习惯的作用。通过对认知控制机制的深入探讨，本文为未来的研究提供了重要的理论基础和实践指导，尤其是在需要快速适应环境变化的复杂任务中。

items.title: Consortium profile: the methylation, imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) consortium.
items.body: Epigenetic processes, such as DNA methylation, show potential as biological markers and mechanisms underlying gene-environment interplay in the prediction of mental health and other brain-based phenotypes. However, little is known about how peripheral epigenetic patterns relate to individual differences in the brain itself. An increasingly popular approach to address this is by combining epigenetic and neuroimaging data; yet, research in this area is almost entirely comprised of cross-sectional studies in adults. To bridge this gap, we established the Methylation, Imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) Consortium, which aims to bring a developmental focus to the emerging field of Neuroimaging Epigenetics by (i) promoting collaborative, adequately powered developmental research via multi-cohort analyses; (ii) increasing scientific rigor through the establishment of shared pipelines and open science practices; and (iii) advancing our understanding of DNA methylation-brain dynamics at different developmental periods (from birth to emerging adulthood), by leveraging data from prospective, longitudinal pediatric studies. MIND currently integrates 16 cohorts worldwide, comprising (repeated) measures of DNA methylation in peripheral tissues (blood, buccal cells, and saliva) and neuroimaging by magnetic resonance imaging across up to five time points over a period of up to 21 years (N pooled DNAm = 12,877; N pooled neuroimaging = 10,899; N pooled combined = 6074). By triangulating associations across multiple developmental time points and study types, we hope to generate new insights into the dynamic relationships between peripheral DNA methylation and the brain, and how these ultimately relate to neurodevelopmental and psychiatric phenotypes.

items.title_zh: 甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟简介
items.summary_zh: 甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟旨在通过结合表观遗传学（epigenetics）和神经成像（neuroimaging）数据，探讨外周表观遗传模式与大脑个体差异之间的关系。尽管DNA甲基化（DNA methylation）在预测心理健康及其他大脑表型方面显示出潜力，但目前相关研究主要集中于成年人且多为横断面研究。MIND联盟通过多队列分析（multi-cohort analyses）促进协作性、充分支持的发育研究，建立共享流程和开放科学实践以提高科学严谨性，并利用前瞻性、纵向儿童研究的数据，深化对不同发育阶段（从出生到成年初期）DNA甲基化与大脑动态关系的理解。目前，MIND联盟整合了全球16个队列，涵盖外周组织（血液、口腔细胞和唾液）中DNA甲基化的重复测量及多达21年的神经成像数据。
items.l1_lead: MIND联盟通过整合全球多队列的表观遗传学和神经成像数据，深入研究DNA甲基化与大脑发育之间的动态关系，推动儿童心理健康研究的科学严谨性。
items.l2_summary:
甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟致力于探讨外周表观遗传模式与大脑个体差异之间的关系，结合表观遗传学（epigenetics）和神经成像（neuroimaging）数据，推动对心理健康及大脑表型的理解。尽管DNA甲基化（DNA methylation）在预测心理健康方面展现出潜力，但现有研究多集中于成年人且多为横断面研究，缺乏对儿童及青少年发育阶段的深入分析。MIND联盟通过多队列分析（multi-cohort analyses）促进协作性研究，建立共享流程和开放科学实践，以提高研究的科学严谨性。该联盟利用前瞻性、纵向儿童研究的数据，旨在深化对不同发育阶段（从出生到成年初期）中DNA甲基化与大脑动态关系的理解。

目前，MIND联盟整合了全球16个队列的数据，涵盖外周组织（如血液、口腔细胞和唾液）中DNA甲基化的重复测量，并整合了多达21年的神经成像数据。这种大规模的数据整合为研究提供了丰富的样本量和多维度的视角，使得研究者能够更全面地分析外周表观遗传模式如何影响大脑发育及其后续的心理健康表现。通过这种跨学科的合作，MIND联盟希望能够揭示DNA甲基化与大脑功能之间的复杂关系，为未来的心理健康干预和治疗提供科学依据。

items.title: Exploring the relationships between Early Childhood Adversity, Social Cognition, and Aggression in a South African Study of People Living with Schizophrenia.
items.body: People living with schizophrenia (PLS) are at increased risk of being both victims and perpetrators of violence. Recent research suggests that social cognitive impairments may contribute to heightened aggression in schizophrenia. Childhood trauma, a well-established risk factor for both schizophrenia and aggression, is also linked to more severe cognitive deficits in PLS. Few studies have explored the relationships between childhood trauma, social cognition, and aggression in large sample sizes, particularly in low- and middle-income settings, where varying socioeconomic factors and exposure to violence may influence these associations. In this study, a subsample of participants (PLS = 585; controls = 882) from the Genomics of Schizophrenia in the South African Xhosa People study completed The Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ), Penn Emotion Identification Test (ER), Life History of Aggression Questionnaire (LHA), and Structured Diagnostic Interview for DSM-IV Axis I Disorders. Group differences in CTQ, ER, LHA, and selected demographic and clinical factors were assessed using t -tests and chi-square tests. Multivariable linear regressions were employed to test for associations among CTQ, ER, and LHA. We found that PLS had significantly higher childhood trauma and lifetime aggression scores and poorer emotion recognition performance than controls. Higher childhood trauma was associated with higher lifetime aggression and worse emotion recognition performance. However, emotion recognition performance was not associated with lifetime aggression. In this setting, childhood trauma predicts lifetime aggression and poorer emotion recognition, but there is no evidence that emotion recognition ability is related to aggression.
items.authors: van der Walt K, Wootton O, Rokicki J, Vaskinn A, Jonker D, Campbell M, Susser E, Haukvik UK, Gur RC, Stein DJ, Friestad C.
items.title_zh: 南非精神分裂症患者早期逆境、社会认知与攻击性关系研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了生活在南非的精神分裂症患者（PLS）中，早期逆境、社会认知和攻击性之间的关系。研究发现，PLS在童年创伤和终生攻击性评分上显著高于对照组，并且情绪识别能力较差。童年创伤被认为是精神分裂症和攻击性的已知风险因素，并与PLS的认知缺陷严重程度相关。通过对585名PLS和882名对照组参与者的问卷调查，包括《童年创伤问卷》（CTQ）、《宾州情绪识别测试》（ER）和《攻击性历史问卷》（LHA），研究使用t检验和卡方检验评估组间差异，并采用多变量线性回归分析CTQ、ER和LHA之间的关联。这些结果表明，早期逆境可能加剧精神分裂症患者的攻击性行为。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，南非精神分裂症患者的早期逆境与其攻击性行为显著相关，且童年创伤与认知缺陷程度密切相关。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在探讨南非精神分裂症患者（PLS）中早期逆境、社会认知与攻击性之间的关系。研究结果显示，PLS在童年创伤和终生攻击性评分上显著高于对照组，且其情绪识别能力较差。具体而言，研究发现童年创伤被认为是精神分裂症和攻击性的已知风险因素，并且与PLS的认知缺陷严重程度相关。研究样本包括585名PLS和882名对照组参与者，采用问卷调查的方式进行数据收集，使用的工具包括《童年创伤问卷》（CTQ）、《宾州情绪识别测试》（ER）和《攻击性历史问卷》（LHA）。通过t检验和卡方检验评估组间差异，并采用多变量线性回归分析CTQ、ER和LHA之间的关联，结果表明早期逆境可能加剧精神分裂症患者的攻击性行为。这一发现强调了早期逆境对精神健康的深远影响，提示在精神分裂症的干预和治疗中应考虑早期经历的因素，以降低患者的攻击性行为。

items.title: Advanced Oral Delivery Systems for Nutraceuticals.
items.body: Oral delivery is the most preferred route for nutraceuticals due to its convenience and high patient compliance. However, bioavailability is often compromised by poor solubility, instability, and first-pass metabolism in the gastrointestinal tract. This review examines current and emerging oral delivery platforms designed to overcome these barriers and enhance nutraceutical efficacy. Traditional carriers-proteins, lipids, and carbohydrates-highlighting their delivery mechanisms and limitations, are first explored. Advancements in material science have led to novel platforms such as biodegradable polymers, metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), metal-polyphenol networks (MPNs), and 3D printing technologies. Biodegradable polymers improve stability and enable controlled release of bioactives. MOFs offer high surface area and tunable porosity for encapsulating and protecting sensitive compounds. MPNs provide biocompatible, stimuli-responsive systems for targeted nutrient delivery. Meanwhile, 3D printing facilitates the fabrication of personalized delivery systems with precise control over composition and release kinetics, especially when integrated with artificial intelligence (AI) for precision nutrition. By comparing traditional and next-generation strategies, this review outlines key design principles for optimizing oral delivery systems. The transformative potential of these innovations is underscored to improve the bioavailability and therapeutic outcomes of nutraceuticals, ultimately advancing personalized and targeted nutrition solutions.
items.authors: Yang X, Zhang L, Zheng Z, Langer R, Jaklenec A.
items.title_zh: 营养保健品的先进口服给药系统
items.summary_zh: 口服给药是营养保健品（nutraceuticals）最受欢迎的途径，但其生物利用度常因溶解度差、不稳定性和首过代谢而受到影响。本文评述了当前及新兴的口服给药平台，旨在克服这些障碍并增强营养保健品的疗效。首先探讨了传统载体（如蛋白质、脂质和碳水化合物）的给药机制及其局限性。材料科学的进步催生了新型平台，如可生物降解聚合物、金属有机框架（MOFs）、金属-多酚网络（MPNs）和3D打印技术。可生物降解聚合物提高了稳定性并实现了生物活性物质的控制释放。MOFs具有高表面积和可调孔隙率，适合包封和保护敏感化合物。MPNs提供了生物相容性和刺激响应的系统，以实现靶向营养物质的输送。同时，3D打印技术使个性化给药系统的制造成为可能，尤其是与人工智能（AI）结合时，能够精确控制成分和释放动力学。通过比较传统与新一代策略，本文概述了优化口服给药系统的关键设计原则。
items.l1_lead: 本文探讨了新型口服给药系统如何通过先进材料和技术克服传统营养保健品的生物利用度障碍，以提升其疗效和个性化给药能力。
items.l2_summary:
口服给药是营养保健品（nutraceuticals）最常见的给药方式，但其生物利用度常常受到溶解度差、不稳定性和首过代谢等因素的影响。为了解决这些问题，本文评述了当前及新兴的口服给药平台，旨在提升营养保健品的疗效。首先，文章探讨了传统载体（如蛋白质、脂质和碳水化合物）的给药机制及其局限性，这些传统方法在提高生物利用度方面存在一定的不足。

随着材料科学的进步，新型给药平台相继出现，包括可生物降解聚合物、金属有机框架（MOFs）、金属-多酚网络（MPNs）和3D打印技术等。可生物降解聚合物通过提高稳定性和实现生物活性物质的控制释放，显著改善了营养保健品的给药效果。MOFs因其高表面积和可调孔隙率，能够有效包封和保护敏感化合物，进而提升其生物利用度。MPNs则提供了良好的生物相容性和刺激响应能力，使得营养物质的靶向输送成为可能。此外，3D打印技术的应用，尤其是与人工智能（AI）结合后，能够实现个性化给药系统的制造，精确控制成分和释放动力学，从而进一步优化给药效果。

通过对比传统与新一代口服给药策略，本文总结了优化口服给药系统的关键设计原则，强调了新型材料和技术在提升营养保健品生物利用度方面的重要性。这些创新平台不仅克服了传统方法的局限性，还为未来营养保健品的研发和应用提供了新的思路和方向。

items.title: Enhancing immunotherapy with tumour-responsive nanomaterials.
items.body: The targeted delivery of immunotherapies to tumours using tumour-responsive nanomaterials is a promising area of cancer research with the potential to address the limitations of systemic administration such as on-target off-tumour toxicities and a lack of activity owing to the immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment (TME). Attempts to address these challenges include the design and functionalization of nanomaterials capable of releasing their cargoes in response to specific TME characteristics, thus facilitating the targeted delivery of immune-checkpoint inhibitors, cytokines, mRNAs, vaccines and, potentially, chimaeric antigen receptors as well as of agents that modulate the extracellular matrix and induce immunogenic cell death. In this Review, we describe these various research efforts in the context of the dynamic properties of the TME, such as pH, reductive conditions, reactive oxygen species, hypoxia, specific enzymes, high levels of ATP and locoregional aspects, which can be leveraged to enhance the specificity and efficacy of nanomaterial-based immunotherapies. Highlighting preclinical successes and ongoing clinical trials, we evaluate the current landscape and potential of these innovative approaches. We also consider future research directions as well as the most important barriers to successful clinical translation, emphasizing the transformative potential of tumour-responsive nanomaterials in overcoming the barriers that limit the activity of traditional immunotherapies, thus improving patient outcomes.
items.authors: Linderman SW, DeRidder L, Sanjurjo L, Foote MB, Alonso MJ, Kirtane AR, Langer R, Traverso G.
items.title_zh: 利用肿瘤响应纳米材料增强免疫疗法
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了利用肿瘤响应纳米材料实现免疫疗法靶向递送的研究进展。这一领域旨在解决全身给药的局限性，如靶向外的肿瘤毒性和免疫抑制的肿瘤微环境（TME）导致的活性不足。研究者们设计并功能化纳米材料，使其能够根据特定的TME特征释放药物，从而实现免疫检查点抑制剂、细胞因子、mRNA、疫苗及潜在的嵌合抗原受体的靶向递送。此外，纳米材料还可用于调节细胞外基质和诱导免疫原性细胞死亡。文章强调了TME的动态特性（如pH、还原条件、活性氧、缺氧等）在增强纳米材料基础免疫疗法的特异性和有效性方面的应用，评估了当前的研究成果及临床试验，并探讨了未来的研究方向及临床转化的主要障碍。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，肿瘤响应纳米材料能够有效增强免疫疗法的靶向递送，克服传统全身给药的局限性，提高治疗特异性和有效性。
items.l2_summary:
本文评述了利用肿瘤响应纳米材料（tumor-responsive nanomaterials）增强免疫疗法的研究进展，旨在解决全身给药的局限性，包括靶向外的肿瘤毒性和免疫抑制的肿瘤微环境（tumor microenvironment, TME）导致的活性不足。研究者们通过设计和功能化纳米材料，使其能够根据特定的TME特征（如pH、还原条件、活性氧、缺氧等）释放药物，从而实现对免疫检查点抑制剂、细胞因子、mRNA、疫苗及潜在的嵌合抗原受体（CAR）的靶向递送。这种方法不仅提高了药物的靶向性，还能有效降低对正常组织的毒性。

文章强调了TME的动态特性在增强纳米材料基础免疫疗法的特异性和有效性方面的重要应用。通过调节细胞外基质和诱导免疫原性细胞死亡，纳米材料能够进一步改善免疫反应的效果。当前的研究成果显示，利用肿瘤响应纳米材料的免疫疗法在临床试验中展现出良好的前景，但仍面临一些主要障碍，如纳米材料的生物相容性、体内分布和长期安全性等问题。

此外，文章还探讨了未来的研究方向，建议在纳米材料的设计中进一步考虑TME的复杂性，以提高治疗的个体化和精准性。总体而言，肿瘤响应纳米材料在增强免疫疗法方面的应用具有广阔的前景，能够为癌症治疗提供新的思路和方法。

items.title: Adaptive consolidation of active inference: excitatory and inhibitory mechanisms for organizing feedforward and feedback memory systems in sleep.
items.body: Cognitive self-organization rests on activity-dependent plasticity to extend the ontogenetic process of neural differentiation and integration of the cerebral cortex in each act of cognition. This account of neurocognitive growth can be formulated in terms of active inference and learning. The organism regulates synaptic connectivity as it seeks its goals actively, through excitatory, feedforward expectancies that manifest its species-specific affordances. These adaptive expectancies are modified reactively, through inhibitory feedback error-correction to fit and predict environmental encounters. Although adaptive behavior, and concomitant synaptic plasticity, occur during waking, the synaptic architecture requires ongoing consolidation and refinement during sleep. We propose that memory consolidation during sleep is a continuation of the neurodevelopmental process that proceeds through a kind of inversion of waking active inference: NREM sleep first refines the brain's representations of new, unpredicted experiences during waking, implementing inhibitory mechanisms of long-term depression that both differentiate and stabilize new representations for consolidation. REM sleep then updates the organism's generative world model in light of this new learning through excitatory long-term potentiation of synaptic plasticity. REM thereby reconsolidates and integrates the organism's adaptive, feedforward predictions, the Bayesian priors for effective coping.
items.authors: Tucker DM, Luu P, Friston KJ.
items.title_zh: 睡眠中主动推理的适应性巩固机制
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了认知自我组织如何依赖于活动依赖性可塑性，以促进大脑皮层的神经分化和整合。作者提出，生物体在追求目标时，通过兴奋性前馈期望调节突触连接，这些期望反映了物种特有的能力。适应性期望通过抑制性反馈误差修正进行反应性调整，以适应环境。尽管在清醒状态下适应性行为和突触可塑性发生，但突触结构在睡眠中需要持续巩固和完善。作者认为，睡眠中的记忆巩固是神经发育过程的延续，非快速眼动睡眠（NREM）首先通过抑制性机制精炼清醒时的新经验表示，而快速眼动睡眠（REM）则通过兴奋性长期增强更新生物体的生成世界模型，从而重新巩固和整合学习成果。
items.l1_lead: 睡眠中的记忆巩固通过非快速眼动睡眠精炼新经验和快速眼动睡眠更新生物体的世界模型，促进认知自我组织和神经可塑性。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了睡眠中主动推理的适应性巩固机制，重点分析了认知自我组织如何依赖于活动依赖性可塑性，以促进大脑皮层的神经分化和整合。作者指出，生物体在追求目标时，通过兴奋性前馈期望调节突触连接，这些期望反映了物种特有的能力。适应性期望通过抑制性反馈误差修正进行反应性调整，以适应环境变化。尽管在清醒状态下，适应性行为和突触可塑性会发生，但突触结构在睡眠中仍需持续巩固和完善。

作者认为，睡眠中的记忆巩固是神经发育过程的延续，尤其是在非快速眼动睡眠（NREM）阶段，首先通过抑制性机制精炼清醒时的新经验表示。这一过程有助于消除不必要的神经连接，从而提高大脑的效率。随后，在快速眼动睡眠（REM）阶段，兴奋性长期增强机制则更新生物体的生成世界模型，进一步巩固和整合学习成果。这种双阶段的睡眠机制不仅有助于记忆的巩固，还促进了大脑对新信息的整合与应用。

总的来说，本文强调了睡眠在认知功能中的重要性，特别是在适应性学习和记忆巩固方面的作用。通过深入分析睡眠各阶段的不同功能，作者为理解大脑如何在睡眠中处理和整合信息提供了新的视角，揭示了睡眠与认知发展的密切关系。

items.title: Pathfinding: a neurodynamical account of intuition.
items.body: We examine the neurobiology of intuition, a term often inconsistently defined in scientific literature. While researchers generally agree that intuition represents "an experienced-based process resulting in a spontaneous tendency toward a hunch or hypothesis," we establish a firmer neurobiological foundation by framing intuition evolutionarily as a pathfinding mechanism emerging from the brain's optimization of its relationship with the environment. Our review synthesizes empirical findings on intuition's neurobiological basis, including relevant brain networks and their relationship to cognitive states like insight. We propose that unsolved problems dynamically alter attractor landscapes, guiding future intuitions. We investigate "opportunistic assimilation" through nonlinear neurodynamics and identify hippocampal sharp wave ripples as potential neural correlates of intuition, citing their role in creativity, choice, action planning, and abstract thinking. Finally, we explore intuition through two complementary perspectives: the free energy principle, which models brains as minimizing uncertainty through predictive hierarchical coding, and metastable coordination dynamics, describing the brain's simultaneous tendencies toward regional cooperation and functional autonomy. Together, these principles provide a comprehensive neurodynamical account of intuition's neurophenomenology.
items.authors: Kotler S, Mannino M, Friston K, Buzsáki G, Kelso JAS, Dumas G.
items.title_zh: 路径探索：直觉的神经动力学解释
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了直觉的神经生物学，指出直觉是一个基于经验的过程，表现为对直觉或假设的自发倾向。我们将直觉视为一种进化的路径探索机制，源于大脑与环境关系的优化。文章综合了关于直觉神经生物基础的实证研究，包括相关的大脑网络及其与洞察等认知状态的关系。我们提出未解决的问题动态改变吸引子景观，从而引导未来的直觉。通过非线性神经动力学研究“机会性同化”，并识别海马体尖波涟漪作为直觉的潜在神经相关物，强调其在创造力、选择、行动规划和抽象思维中的作用。最后，我们从自由能原理和亚稳态协调动力学两个互补视角探讨直觉，前者将大脑建模为通过预测层级编码最小化不确定性，后者描述大脑在区域合作与功能自主之间的同时倾向。这些原理共同提供了直觉神经现象学的全面神经动力学解释。
items.l1_lead: 直觉是一种基于经验的进化路径探索机制，其神经生物学基础涉及大脑网络与环境关系的优化，强调海马体在创造力和决策中的关键作用。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了直觉的神经生物学，认为直觉是一种基于经验的过程，表现为对直觉或假设的自发倾向。我们将直觉视为一种进化的路径探索机制，其根源在于大脑与环境关系的优化。文章综合了关于直觉神经生物基础的实证研究，揭示了相关的大脑网络及其与洞察（insight）等认知状态之间的关系。研究指出，未解决的问题能够动态改变吸引子景观，从而引导未来的直觉发展。

通过非线性神经动力学的研究，本文探讨了“机会性同化”（opportunistic assimilation），并识别出海马体尖波涟漪（hippocampal sharp-wave ripples）作为直觉的潜在神经相关物，强调其在创造力、选择、行动规划和抽象思维中的重要作用。最后，文章从自由能原理（free energy principle）和亚稳态协调动力学（metastable coordination dynamics）两个互补视角探讨直觉。自由能原理将大脑建模为通过预测层级编码来最小化不确定性，而亚稳态协调动力学则描述了大脑在区域合作与功能自主之间的平衡倾向。这些原理共同为直觉的神经现象学提供了全面的神经动力学解释，揭示了直觉在认知过程中的重要性及其潜在机制。

items.title: Genetic Evidence for a Neuroimmune Model of Schizophrenia.
items.body: Since the early 1900s, clinical and epidemiological observations have suggested a link between schizophrenia and the immune system, yet genetic evidence for a pathophysiological connection has remained elusive. Here, we review evidence for immune involvement from a variety of genetic studies to characterize the contribution of genetic variation in immune genes and pathways to schizophrenia risk. Across studies, the strongest and most consistent associations remain in neuronal pathways, but several studies have revealed involvement of peripheral lymphocyte populations, including CD4+ T cells, mature B cells, and, to a lesser extent, natural killer (NK) cells. Cross-trait genetic analyses are mixed but point to a modest shared genetic architecture between schizophrenia and several immune traits. Collectively, current evidence supports a primarily neuronal genetic architecture for schizophrenia with a modest immunogenetic component. Advancing our understanding of the immune contribution to schizophrenia risk will require integration of genomic, proteomic, and deep immunophenotyping approaches to capture these subtle and dynamic processes. Ultimately, combining genetic, immunologic, and clinical data will be essential for improving diagnostic precision, identifying novel therapeutic targets, and tailoring treatment to individual biological profiles.
items.authors: van der Walt K, Stein DJ, Zoghbi AW.
items.title_zh: 精神分裂症的神经免疫模型的遗传证据
items.summary_zh: 自20世纪初以来，临床和流行病学观察表明精神分裂症与免疫系统之间存在联系，但遗传证据仍然稀缺。本文回顾了多项遗传研究中关于免疫参与的证据，旨在阐明免疫基因和通路的遗传变异对精神分裂症风险的贡献。研究发现，最强和最一致的关联主要集中在神经通路上，但也有研究揭示了外周淋巴细胞群体的参与，包括CD4+ T细胞、成熟B细胞，以及在较小程度上，自然杀伤（NK）细胞。跨性状遗传分析结果不一，但指向精神分裂症与多个免疫特征之间存在适度的共享遗传结构。总体而言，当前证据支持精神分裂症主要由神经遗传结构构成，并具有适度的免疫遗传成分。深入理解免疫对精神分裂症风险的贡献需要整合基因组学、蛋白组学和深度免疫表型分析，以捕捉这些微妙而动态的过程。最终，结合遗传、免疫和临床数据对于提高诊断精度、识别新治疗靶点以及个性化治疗至关重要。
items.l1_lead: 精神分裂症的风险与神经遗传结构密切相关，同时也受到免疫遗传成分的影响，深入研究免疫因素对其贡献将有助于改善诊断和治疗。
items.l2_summary:
自20世纪初以来，精神分裂症（Schizophrenia）与免疫系统之间的关系逐渐引起了临床和流行病学研究者的关注，但遗传证据仍显不足。本文回顾了多项遗传研究中关于免疫参与的证据，旨在探讨免疫基因和通路的遗传变异对精神分裂症风险的影响。研究表明，精神分裂症与免疫系统的关联主要集中在神经通路上，这些通路的遗传变异可能是精神分裂症发病的重要因素。此外，研究还发现外周淋巴细胞群体的参与，包括CD4+ T细胞、成熟B细胞以及在较小程度上，自然杀伤（NK）细胞，这些细胞的功能和数量变化可能与精神分裂症的发生相关。

尽管跨性状遗传分析的结果不尽相同，但总体上指向精神分裂症与多个免疫特征之间存在适度的共享遗传结构。这表明，精神分裂症的遗传基础不仅包括神经遗传结构，还具有一定的免疫遗传成分。为了深入理解免疫对精神分裂症风险的贡献，研究者们建议整合基因组学、蛋白组学和深度免疫表型分析，以捕捉这些复杂而动态的生物过程。最终，将遗传、免疫和临床数据结合起来，对于提高精神分裂症的诊断精度、识别新的治疗靶点以及实现个性化治疗具有重要意义。通过这些研究，未来有望为精神分裂症的预防和治疗提供新的思路和方法。

items.title: New Genomics Discoveries Across the Bipolar Disorder Spectrum Implicate Neurobiological and Developmental Pathways.
items.body: Bipolar disorder (BD) is a highly heritable mental disorder that affects millions of people worldwide. Our understanding of the genetic etiology and biological processes that underlie BD have greatly increased in recent years. Extensive progress has been made in identifying common variant signals for BD, and the polygenic score from the latest genome-wide association study (GWAS) may provide some clinical utility if combined with other risk factors for BD. The role of rare variation in BD remains to be determined, although genes annotated to common variant loci are shown to be enriched for rare variation. BD subtypes have been shown to differ in their genetic architecture, and as such, genetic studies across the subtypes of the BD spectrum will identify subtype-specific signals and reveal subtype-specific biological mechanisms. Despite this, subtype-specific GWAS sample sizes have not increased at the same rate as BD cases, and more concerted efforts are required to obtain this information for participants included in future BD GWASs. Moreover, assessment of culture, geography, and other systematic differences that may impact patient assessment will be necessary to ensure accurate inclusion of diverse ancestral groups and global representation in genetic studies of BD moving forward.

items.title_zh: 新发现揭示双相障碍的神经生物学与发育路径
items.summary_zh: 双相障碍（Bipolar Disorder, BD）是一种高度遗传的精神疾病，影响全球数百万人。近年来，我们对BD的遗传病因及其生物过程的理解显著提高。研究已在识别BD的常见变异信号方面取得了重要进展，最新的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中的多基因评分若与其他风险因素结合，可能具有一定的临床应用价值。尽管尚未确定稀有变异在BD中的作用，但与常见变异位点相关的基因显示出稀有变异的富集。BD亚型在遗传结构上存在差异，因此对BD谱系各亚型的遗传研究将识别特定信号并揭示特定的生物机制。然而，亚型特异性GWAS的样本量未能与BD病例的增长同步，未来需要更多努力以获取相关信息。此外，评估文化、地理及其他可能影响患者评估的系统性差异，对于确保在BD的遗传研究中准确纳入多样的祖先群体和全球代表性至关重要。
items.l1_lead: 双相障碍的遗传病因和生物机制研究取得进展，亚型差异显著，未来需加强样本量和多样性，以推动临床应用和理解。
items.l2_summary:
双相障碍（Bipolar Disorder, BD）是一种具有高度遗传性的精神疾病，影响着全球数以百万计的人。近年来，科学界对BD的遗传病因及其生物学过程的理解有了显著提升。研究者们在识别BD的常见变异信号方面取得了重要进展，尤其是在最新的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中，发现多基因评分与其他风险因素结合时，可能具有一定的临床应用价值。这一发现为BD的早期诊断和个性化治疗提供了新的思路。

尽管稀有变异在BD中的具体作用尚未明确，但研究显示，与常见变异位点相关的基因中，稀有变异的富集现象值得关注。BD的不同亚型在遗传结构上存在差异，因此，针对BD谱系各亚型的遗传研究将有助于识别特定信号，并揭示相应的生物机制。然而，目前亚型特异性GWAS的样本量未能与BD病例的增长保持同步，这表明在未来的研究中需要更多的努力，以获取更为丰富和准确的信息。

此外，评估文化、地理及其他可能影响患者评估的系统性差异，对于确保在BD的遗传研究中准确纳入多样的祖先群体和全球代表性至关重要。这一方面的研究将有助于更全面地理解BD的遗传背景，从而推动该领域的科学进步和临床应用。因此，未来的研究不仅需要关注遗传变异的识别，还应重视多样性和代表性的纳入，以便更好地服务于全球范围内的BD患者。

items.title: A beautiful loop: An active inference theory of consciousness.
items.body: Can active inference model consciousness? We offer three conditions implying that it can. The first condition is the simulation of a world model, which determines what can be known or acted upon; namely an epistemic field. The second is inferential competition to enter the world model. Only the inferences that coherently reduce long-term uncertainty win, evincing a selection for consciousness that we call Bayesian binding. The third is epistemic depth, which is the recurrent sharing of the Bayesian beliefs throughout the system. Due to this recursive loop in a hierarchical system (such as a brain) the world model contains the knowledge that it exists. This is distinct from self-consciousness, because the world model knows itself non-locally and continuously evidences this knowing (i.e., field-evidencing). Formally, we propose a hyper-model for precision-control, whose latent states (or parameters) encode and control the overall structure and weighting rules for all layers of inference. These globally integrated preferences for precision enact the epistemic agency and flexibility reminiscent of general intelligence. This Beautiful Loop Theory is also deeply revealing about altered states, meditation, and the full spectrum of conscious experience.
items.authors: Laukkonen R, Friston K, Chandaria S.
items.title_zh: 美丽的循环：主动推断理论与意识
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了主动推断（active inference）是否能够建模意识，并提出了三个条件。首先是世界模型的模拟，决定了可知或可行动的内容，即认知领域（epistemic field）。其次是推理竞争，只有那些能够一致减少长期不确定性的推理才能进入世界模型，这一过程被称为贝叶斯绑定（Bayesian binding）。第三是认知深度，指的是贝叶斯信念在系统中的反复共享。由于这种在层级系统（如大脑）中的递归循环，世界模型包含了其存在的知识。这与自我意识不同，因为世界模型以非局部的方式自我认知并持续证实这一认知。我们提出了一种超模型（hyper-model）用于精确控制，其潜在状态（或参数）编码和控制所有推理层次的整体结构和权重规则。这种全球整合的精确偏好体现了认知代理（epistemic agency）和灵活性，类似于一般智能。美丽循环理论对改变状态、冥想和意识体验的全谱也有深刻的启示。
items.l1_lead: 主动推断理论通过世界模型的模拟、推理竞争和认知深度，揭示了意识的形成机制，并提出超模型以整合认知代理与灵活性，具有重要的应用潜力。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了主动推断（active inference）在建模意识方面的潜力，并提出了三个关键条件。首先，世界模型的模拟是基础，它决定了可知或可行动的内容，形成了认知领域（epistemic field）。这一模型不仅是对外部世界的反映，还涉及个体如何理解和应对环境。其次，推理竞争是另一个重要因素，只有那些能够有效减少长期不确定性的推理才能被纳入世界模型，这一过程被称为贝叶斯绑定（Bayesian binding）。通过这种方式，个体能够在复杂的环境中筛选出最为相关的信息，从而优化其决策过程。最后，认知深度指的是贝叶斯信念在系统内部的反复共享，这种递归循环在层级系统（如大脑）中尤为明显，使得世界模型不仅包含了对外部世界的知识，还反映了个体对自身存在的理解。

与自我意识不同，世界模型以非局部的方式进行自我认知，并持续验证这一认知的准确性。为此，本文提出了一种超模型（hyper-model），用于精确控制其潜在状态（或参数），并编码和控制所有推理层次的整体结构和权重规则。这种全球整合的精确偏好不仅体现了认知代理（epistemic agency）的特征，还展示了灵活性，类似于一般智能的表现。美丽循环理论因此为理解意识的变化、冥想状态以及意识体验的全谱提供了深刻的启示，强调了在复杂认知过程中，个体如何通过主动推断不断调整和优化其对世界的理解与反应。

items.title: A survey on neuro-mimetic deep learning via predictive coding.
items.body: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly becoming one of the key technologies of this century. The majority of results in AI thus far have been achieved using deep neural networks trained with a learning algorithm called error backpropagation, always considered biologically implausible. To this end, recent works have studied learning algorithms for deep neural networks inspired by the neurosciences. One such theory, called predictive coding (PC), has shown promising properties that make it potentially valuable for the machine learning community: it can model information processing in different areas of the brain, can be used in control and robotics, has a solid mathematical foundation in variational inference, and performs its computations asynchronously. Inspired by such properties, works that propose novel PC-like algorithms are starting to be present in multiple sub-fields of machine learning and AI at large. Here, we survey such efforts by first providing a broad overview of the history of PC to provide common ground for the understanding of the recent developments, then by describing current efforts and results, and concluding with a large discussion of possible implications and ways forward.
items.journal: Neural networks : the official journal of the International Neural Network Society
items.authors: Salvatori T, Mali A, Buckley CL, Lukasiewicz T, Rao RPN, Friston K, Ororbia A.
items.title_zh: 神经仿生深度学习的预测编码研究综述
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正迅速成为本世纪的关键技术。迄今为止，大多数AI成果依赖于使用误差反向传播（error backpropagation）算法训练的深度神经网络，这种方法被认为在生物学上不太可信。为此，近期研究探索了受神经科学启发的深度神经网络学习算法。其中，预测编码（predictive coding, PC）理论展现出潜在的价值，能够模拟大脑不同区域的信息处理，适用于控制和机器人技术，具有坚实的变分推断数学基础，并且能够异步执行计算。受此启发，提出新型PC类算法的研究开始在多个机器学习和AI子领域涌现。本文首先回顾了预测编码的历史，为理解近期发展提供共同基础，接着描述当前的研究进展和成果，最后讨论其可能的影响及未来发展方向。
items.l1_lead: 预测编码理论在神经仿生深度学习中展现出潜在价值，能够有效模拟大脑信息处理，推动AI和机器人技术的发展。
items.l2_summary:
人工智能（AI）正迅速成为本世纪的关键技术，然而，现有的许多AI成果主要依赖于误差反向传播（error backpropagation）算法训练的深度神经网络，这种方法在生物学上被认为不够可信。因此，近期的研究开始探索受神经科学启发的深度神经网络学习算法，其中预测编码（predictive coding, PC）理论展现出显著的潜力。预测编码理论能够模拟大脑不同区域的信息处理，适用于控制和机器人技术，并且具备坚实的变分推断数学基础，能够实现异步计算。

在这一背景下，研究者们开始提出新型的PC类算法，这些算法在多个机器学习和AI子领域中逐渐涌现。本文首先回顾了预测编码的历史，为理解近期的发展提供了共同基础。接着，文章描述了当前在这一领域的研究进展和成果，强调了预测编码在信息处理中的重要性及其在实际应用中的潜力。最后，讨论了预测编码理论可能带来的影响以及未来的发展方向，指出这一理论有望推动AI技术的进一步演进。

总体来看，预测编码作为一种新兴的学习算法，凭借其生物学启发的特性和强大的数学基础，正在为深度学习领域带来新的视角和方法，预示着AI技术在未来可能会朝着更加智能和高效的方向发展。

items.title: Problematic usage of the internet: Converging and diverging terminologies and constructs.
items.body: Problematic usage of the internet (PUI) is an increasing global concern, leading to significant negative impacts in various levels. PUI is an umbrella term comprised of subcategories, including online gaming disorder, online gambling disorder, online buying-shopping disorder, online compulsive sexual behavior disorder, problematic usage of social media, cyberchondria, cyberbullying, and digital hoarding. With respect to the diversity of these categories, a factor that further impedes the field of PUI is not recognizing these subcategories under the PUI. To estimate the state of the field, we conducted a systematic review on a sample time frame, 2022-2023, and we found that among 2,497 relevant papers, only 13% of the studies on PUI subcategories used PUI as an umbrella term. Establishing PUI as an overarching terminology, as we do with substance use disorder (SUD) as a term while respecting the diversities within its subcategories, would synergize research efforts, facilitate comparisons, and inform treatment strategies. As technology continues to evolve, terminological refinement is critical to maintaining relevance and accessibility for researchers and the broader community.
items.authors: Zare-Bidoky M, Baldacchino AM, Baldacchino AM, Demetrovics Z, Fineberg NA, Kamali M, Khazaal Y, Potenza MN, Stein DJ, Ekhtiari H.
items.title_zh: 互联网问题使用的术语与构建的趋同与分歧
items.summary_zh: 互联网问题使用（Problematic usage of the internet, PUI）日益成为全球关注的议题，给各个层面带来了显著的负面影响。PUI是一个涵盖多个子类别的总称，包括网络游戏障碍、网络赌博障碍、在线购物障碍、强迫性网络性行为障碍、社交媒体问题使用、网络健康焦虑、网络欺凌和数字囤积等。研究发现，在2022-2023年间的2497篇相关论文中，仅有13%的研究将PUI作为总称使用。将PUI确立为一个总的术语，类似于物质使用障碍（Substance Use Disorder, SUD），能够促进研究的协同、便于比较，并为治疗策略提供信息。随着技术的不断发展，术语的细化对于保持研究的相关性和可及性至关重要。
items.l1_lead: 将互联网问题使用（PUI）确立为总称有助于促进研究协同、便于比较，并为治疗策略提供信息，随着技术发展，术语细化至关重要。
items.l2_summary: 互联网问题使用（Problematic usage of the internet, PUI）已成为全球关注的热点议题，给社会的各个层面带来了显著的负面影响。PUI是一个涵盖多个子类别的总称，包括网络游戏障碍、网络赌博障碍、在线购物障碍、强迫性网络性行为障碍、社交媒体问题使用、网络健康焦虑、网络欺凌和数字囤积等。根据对2022-2023年间2497篇相关论文的研究，仅有13%的研究将PUI作为一个总称使用，这表明在学术界对这一概念的统一性和系统性认识仍显不足。将PUI确立为一个总的术语，类似于物质使用障碍（Substance Use Disorder, SUD），不仅能够促进研究的协同，便于不同研究之间的比较，还能为治疗策略的制定提供重要的信息支持。随着技术的不断发展，互联网使用问题的术语细化显得尤为重要，这对于保持研究的相关性和可及性至关重要。因此，推动PUI的系统化研究和应用，将有助于更好地理解和应对互联网带来的各种问题。

items.title: Nanotechnology for CAR T cells and tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte therapies.
items.body: Adoptive T-cell therapies, and particularly CAR T cells and tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes, have transformed cancer treatment by selectively targeting malignant cells. Despite their clinical success, these therapies face substantial challenges, including costly manufacturing processes and tumour-imposed barriers that limit efficacy. Advances in understanding the nanoscale mechanisms governing T-cell activation and the role of the tumour microenvironment in restricting T-cell responses have driven the development of nanotechnology-based strategies that integrate key chemical and physical cues. Here we provide a brief overview of the current state of CAR T and tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte therapies and discuss nanotechnology strategies to enhance their ex vivo production, in vivo performance and the direct in vivo generation of CAR T cells. We highlight nanotechnology's transformative potential to overcome existing challenges, broaden therapeutic applications and identify factors that will shape the future of nanotechnology for CAR T and tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte therapies.
items.authors: Lafuente-Gómez N, Kang S, Mooney DJ.
items.title_zh: 纳米技术在CAR T细胞与肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞疗法中的应用
items.summary_zh: 采用性T细胞疗法，特别是CAR T细胞和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞，已通过选择性靶向恶性细胞改变了癌症治疗。尽管这些疗法在临床上取得了成功，但仍面临制造成本高和肿瘤所带来的障碍等重大挑战。对T细胞激活的纳米尺度机制及肿瘤微环境对T细胞反应限制作用的理解进展，推动了基于纳米技术的策略的发展，这些策略整合了关键的化学和物理信号。本文简要概述了CAR T细胞和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞疗法的现状，并讨论了增强其体外生产、体内表现及直接体内生成CAR T细胞的纳米技术策略。我们强调了纳米技术在克服现有挑战、拓宽治疗应用及确定未来发展方向方面的变革潜力。
items.l1_lead: 纳米技术在CAR T细胞和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞疗法中具有重要应用潜力，可有效克服制造成本和肿瘤微环境带来的挑战，推动癌症治疗的发展。
items.l2_summary:
纳米技术在CAR T细胞（嵌合抗原受体T细胞）和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TIL）疗法中的应用，正在为癌症治疗带来新的希望。这些细胞疗法通过选择性靶向恶性细胞，已经在临床上取得了一定的成功。然而，制造成本高昂和肿瘤微环境对T细胞反应的限制，仍然是当前面临的重大挑战。近年来，对T细胞激活的纳米尺度机制的深入理解，以及肿瘤微环境对T细胞反应的影响，推动了基于纳米技术的策略的发展。这些策略通过整合关键的化学和物理信号，旨在提高CAR T细胞和TIL的疗效。

本文概述了CAR T细胞和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞疗法的现状，重点讨论了如何利用纳米技术增强这些疗法的体外生产和体内表现。具体而言，纳米技术可以通过改善T细胞的激活和扩增，提升其在肿瘤微环境中的生存能力，从而增强治疗效果。此外，纳米技术还为直接在体内生成CAR T细胞提供了新的思路，这可能会进一步降低治疗成本并提高治疗的可及性。

总的来说，纳米技术在克服现有挑战、拓宽治疗应用及确定未来发展方向方面展现出巨大的变革潜力。通过不断探索和优化纳米技术在细胞疗法中的应用，有望实现更高效、更经济的癌症治疗方案，为患者带来更好的预后。

items.title: On the minimal theory of consciousness implicit in active inference.
items.body: The multifaceted nature of subjective experience poses a challenge to the study of consciousness. Traditional neuroscientific approaches often concentrate on isolated facets, such as perceptual awareness or the global state of consciousness and construct a theory around the relevant empirical paradigms and findings. Theories of consciousness are, therefore, often difficult to compare; indeed, there might be little overlap in the phenomena such theories aim to explain. Here, we take a different approach: starting with active inference, a first principles framework for modelling behaviour as (approximate) Bayesian inference, and building up to a minimal theory of consciousness, which emerges from the shared features of computational models derived under active inference. We review a body of work applying active inference models to the study of consciousness and argue that there is implicit in all these models a small set of theoretical commitments that point to a minimal (and testable) theory of consciousness.
items.authors: Whyte CJ, Corcoran AW, Robinson J, Smith R, Moran RJ, Parr T, Friston KJ, Seth AK, Hohwy J.
items.title_zh: 主动推断中的意识最小理论探讨
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了主观体验的多面性对意识研究的挑战，指出传统神经科学方法往往集中于孤立的方面，如感知意识或意识的整体状态，导致不同意识理论之间难以比较。我们提出一种不同的方法，从主动推断（active inference）出发，构建一个最小的意识理论，该理论源于在主动推断下推导的计算模型的共同特征。我们回顾了将主动推断模型应用于意识研究的相关工作，并认为这些模型隐含了一小组理论承诺，指向一个最小（且可测试）的意识理论。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种基于主动推断的最小意识理论，旨在克服传统神经科学方法对意识研究的局限性，强调不同意识理论之间的可比较性。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了主观体验的多面性对意识研究所带来的挑战，指出传统神经科学方法往往集中于孤立的方面，例如感知意识或意识的整体状态，这种方法使得不同意识理论之间的比较变得困难。为了应对这一问题，作者提出了一种新的研究方法，基于主动推断（active inference）理论，构建了一个最小的意识理论。该理论的基础在于通过主动推断推导出的计算模型的共同特征，这些特征为理解意识提供了新的视角。

在回顾将主动推断模型应用于意识研究的相关工作时，作者发现这些模型隐含了一组理论承诺，指向一个最小且可测试的意识理论。这一理论的提出不仅为意识的研究提供了新的框架，也为未来的实验设计和理论验证奠定了基础。通过这种方法，研究者能够更系统地探讨意识的本质及其运作机制，从而推动意识科学的发展。

总的来说，本文强调了在意识研究中采用主动推断的必要性，认为这一方法能够有效整合不同的意识理论，提供更为清晰和可操作的研究路径。通过构建最小意识理论，研究者能够在复杂的主观体验中找到共通点，从而为理解意识的多样性和复杂性提供新的思路。

items.title: Delivery of macromolecular drugs: An update.
items.body: In 2019, in this journal, I discussed approaches for controlling the movement of molecules, in particular macromolecules, with an emphasis on how this enabled advances in the field of drug delivery - a field that has impacted billions of people worldwide. Since 2019, there have been advances in our work and this field including a striking demonstration in which drug delivery nanoparticles were crucial to the success of mRNA therapies and the Covid-19 vaccine. In this paper, I provide updates in such areas as i) developing new methods for oral drug delivery systems, ii) delivery of molecules to specific sites of the body, iii) new types of delivery systems, and iv) examples of machine learning/artificial intelligence in these areas. I also discuss advances in mRNA technology as it relates to drug delivery and the development of nanoparticles to protect and deliver vaccines, which saved and improved the lives of hundreds of millions of people throughout the world.
items.title_zh: 大分子药物递送的最新进展
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了大分子药物递送领域的最新进展，重点讨论了口服药物递送系统的新方法、靶向递送技术、新型递送系统以及机器学习/人工智能在这些领域的应用。自2019年以来，药物递送纳米颗粒在mRNA疗法和新冠疫苗中的成功应用，标志着该领域的重大突破。此外，文章还探讨了mRNA技术在药物递送中的进展，以及纳米颗粒在保护和递送疫苗方面的开发，这些技术拯救并改善了全球数亿人的生活。
items.l1_lead: 大分子药物递送领域取得显著进展，特别是在口服系统、靶向技术和纳米颗粒应用方面，为全球健康带来积极影响。
items.l2_summary:
本文回顾了大分子药物递送领域的最新进展，特别关注口服药物递送系统的新方法、靶向递送技术、新型递送系统以及机器学习/人工智能在这些领域的应用。自2019年以来，药物递送纳米颗粒（nanoparticles）在mRNA（信使RNA）疗法和新冠疫苗中的成功应用，标志着该领域的重大突破。这些纳米颗粒不仅提高了药物的生物利用度，还改善了药物的稳定性和靶向性，使得治疗效果显著增强。

文章进一步探讨了mRNA技术在药物递送中的进展，强调了其在疫苗开发中的重要性。mRNA疫苗的成功应用，尤其是在新冠疫情期间，展示了这一技术在快速应对公共卫生危机中的潜力。纳米颗粒在保护和递送疫苗方面的开发，极大地提升了疫苗的有效性和安全性，拯救并改善了全球数亿人的生活。

此外，文章还提到，随着机器学习和人工智能技术的不断进步，这些工具在药物递送系统的设计和优化中发挥了越来越重要的作用。这些技术能够分析大量数据，预测药物的行为，从而加速新药的研发过程，提高药物递送的效率和精准度。

综上所述，大分子药物递送领域的最新进展不仅推动了新型药物的研发，也为改善全球公共健康提供了新的解决方案。随着技术的不断进步，未来的药物递送系统将更加高效、精准，为患者带来更多福音。

items.title: Computational whole-body-exposome models for global precision brain health.
items.body: The worldwide rise of neurological and psychiatric conditions poses major challenges. However, current global research remains fragmented, dominated by limited cohorts and poorly integrated datasets that disconnect whole-body health, exposome, and brain health. Theories rarely unify brain measures with extracerebral factors or capture heterogeneity in individual trajectories. We introduce multimodal diversity, a non-linear, non-simplistic causal and ecological construct integrating data representation, whole-body and exposomic factors, and computational modeling to address this situated, embedded, and embodied complexity. This heuristic metamodel integrates global, multilevel data into personalized predictions fostering population inclusion, multimodal integration, diagnostic precision, and equitable, context-sensitive advances in brain health.
items.authors: Ibáñez A, Duran-Aniotz C, Migeot J, Báez S, Fittipaldi S, Coronel-Oliveros C, Eyre HA, Udeh-Momoh C, Zetterberg H, Alladi S, Sandi C, Robertson IH, Franzen S, Farombi T, Montalvo Ortiz JL, Seshadri S, Court F, Valdes-Sos
